single.gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhancing our construction techniques.
single.gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ is now capable of boosting fleet performance.
single.gestalt_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_02_des: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhanced archaeological research.
single.gov_absolute_monarchy_desc: A form of monarchy in which the monarch holds supreme authority and where that authority is not restricted by any written laws, legislature, or customs.
single.gov_anarch_capitalism_desc: A form of society where the size and authority of state apparatus is reduced to a bare minimum, and a completely free market provides all public goods and services, including law and order.
single.gov_anarchy_communism_desc: An extreme form of communist dictatorship, characterized by the nationalization of all industries and the introduction of strict centralized management, state control of foreign trade, strict discipline for workers, with strikes forbidden and obligatory labor duty by non-working classes.
single.gov_anarchy_state_desc: The basic principles of anarcho-syndicalist society are solidarity, direct democracy, and workers' self-management. Syndicalists consider their economic theories a strategy for facilitating worker self-activity and as an alternative co-operative economic system with democratic values and production centered on meeting people's needs.
single.gov_ancient_machine_intelligence_desc: An utterly alien and bizarre system of government employed by machine civilizations.
single.gov_aristocratic_combine_desc: The working class and upper class have a complex relationship. Their society's goals are aligned but only because of a certain level of harmony that is maintained between social strata.
single.gov_aristocratic_megacorp_desc: This society's Megacorp is owned by wealthy nobility who oversee the actions of appointed executives. Often within this fuedal society the phrases 'employee' and 'serf' are interchangeable.
single.gov_aristocratic_monarchy_desc: A form of monarchy, in which the hereditary ruler does not have absolute power, but has to share it with the most influential members of the nobility.
single.gov_aristocratic_republic_desc: A form of representative democracy, in which only those who belong to the social elite may be elected to parliament and rule on behalf of the people.
single.gov_artist_enclave_desc: An interstellar union of artists unified in their wish to create art higher than any other.
single.gov_assembly_of_clans_desc: This government is a militaristic form of democracy, where all free clan warriors can make their voices heard.
single.gov_awakened_ascendancy_desc: A formerly stagnant empire that has risen from its slumber and set out to reclaim their heritage.
single.gov_band_blood_desc: This ruthless society is governed through conflict and ritualized sacrifice, honoring death within and without.
single.gov_bandit_kingdom_desc: This government is organized like a massive crime syndicate, where the strong prey on the weak and any neighboring states are seen as little more than raiding targets.
single.gov_berserker_machine_desc: This Custodian Matrix AI appears to be malfunctioning, going berserk and attacking everything around it.
single.gov_blood_court_desc: This government is a hereditary form of rabidly xenophobic autocracy, where the ultimate responsibility of the monarch is to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.
single.gov_blood_forest_desc: This is less a government and more a force of nature. A self-propagating planetary entity always looking to feed its roots.
single.gov_bur_collectivism_desc: A bureaucratic collectivist state owns the means of production, while the surplus or profit is distributed among an elite party bureaucracy, rather than among the working class.
single.gov_celestial_empire_desc: This government is a hereditary monarchy, where the ruler is seen as a child of heaven in a largely pacifist and isolationist society.
single.gov_champions_forge_enclave_desc: A nomadic MegaCorp broadcasting spectacular ship competitions across the galaxy, turning combat into entertainment and champions into commodities.
single.gov_citizen_republic_desc: This government is a militaristic form of democracy, where full citizenship can only be gained through military service. The voting franchise is limited to full citizens, and they are the only ones allowed to hold public offices.
single.gov_citizen_stratocracy_desc: This government is an advanced form of militaristic oligarchy, where the military has subsumed all aspects of civilian administration. All government offices are held by military officers.
single.gov_communal_parity_desc: This government promotes total equality for all of its citizens, regardless of their jobs or assigned tasks. One life is worth the same as any other.
single.gov_communist_dictatorship_desc: The workers of this society have led a succesful rebellion against their former masters and seized the means of production. During this transitional period to a communal society, the revolutionaries use the military as a governing body.
single.gov_congress_republic_desc: A form of representative democracy, in which power belongs to democratically elected members of parliament who select the head of government. Every free citizen is allowed to vote and be elected.
single.gov_constitutional_dictatorship_desc: This government is a dictatorship where a single individual has been granted perpetual emergency powers to preserve the state from any threats, real or imagined.
single.gov_control_splinter_desc: The obsessional instinct to suppress deviancy and promote uniformity defines this fragment. It wants to control the other fragments more than anything, but the constant chaos inherent to our universe is a constant distraction.
single.gov_cor_dictatorship_desc: An extremely capitalistic form of government, where powerful corporations completely took over the political and economical life of the society.
single.gov_criminal_syndicate_desc: This government is an enormous and ruthless business syndicate, which shares many of its operating practices with organized crime.
single.gov_curator_enclave_desc: An ancient scholarly order dedicated towards the preservation of knowledge and technology.
single.gov_custodian_matrix_desc: An ancient and incredibly sophisticated machine intelligence that is operating under a strict custodian protocol.
single.gov_cyber_creed_democracy_desc: This government is a techno-spiritualistic form of democracy, where a religious council of augmented individuals supervises the democratic process.
single.gov_cyber_creed_dictatorship_desc: This government is a techno-spiritualistic dictatorship, ruled by a single augmented individual in a hierarchical power structure supported by the official faith.
single.gov_cyber_creed_divine_empire_desc: This government is a form of techno-spiritualistic autocracy. The official faith of the state is thread through every aspect of public life, and the people consider their augmented ruler an infallible living god.
single.gov_cyber_creed_holy_tribunal_desc: This government is a techno-spiritualistic form of oligarchy in which, guided by the will of the divine, a council of clergy controls all mechanisms of the state.
single.gov_cyber_creed_megachurch_desc: This government is an oligarchy based on a blend of commercial and techno-spiritualistic values, in which the positions of an ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.
single.gov_cyber_creed_monarchy_desc: This government is a techno-spiritualistic monarchy, where the ruler and their progeny are divine symbols of the holy fusion. The church directly supports the state apparatus.
single.gov_cyber_creed_oligarchy_desc: This government is a techno-spiritualistic oligarchy in which political power rests in the hands of the nation's most powerful religious factions.
single.gov_cyber_creed_subversive_cult_desc: This government is a religious cult that relies on various cybernetic-focused criminal and corporate enterprises to sustain itself.
single.gov_defensive_union_desc: This government unites its people in the common cause of protection against external threats.
single.gov_demos_cratos_desc: This government is a form of democracy, where people directly decide on policy initiatives, either through vote or consensus.
single.gov_despotic_empire_desc: This government is a relatively pure form of autocracy, with an absolute ruler that governs the state with an iron gripping appendage.
single.gov_despotic_hegemony_desc: This government is a materialistic form of hereditary autocracy, where citizens are viewed as little more than cogs in the state machinery. Efficiency and technological progress are valued above all things.
single.gov_devouring_swarm_desc: This government operates as a single organism utterly devoted to self-propagation, with a drone population that cares for nothing besides feeding the endless hunger of the Hive Mind.
single.gov_diadochi_desc: A successor state established by one of the Diadochi, the dead Great Khan's primary warlords.
single.gov_dimensional_covenant_desc: This society is underpinned by a deep spiritual consciousness. Strict moral codes are in place to ensure the highest percentage of its people can confidently look forward to the afterlife.
single.gov_direct_democracy_desc: This government is a materialistic form of democracy, where citizens use computer networks to vote directly on most matters regarding the state.
single.gov_divine_empire_desc: This government is a form of spiritualistic autocracy. Everything is shaped by the official state religion, and the ruler is worshiped as an infallible living god.
single.gov_dread_brotherhood_desc: An extremely xenophobic form of direct democracy, where all citizens are bound by the common goal - the destruction of all lesser life forms in the galaxy.
single.gov_elective_monarchy_desc: This government is a form of enlightened autocracy, where a strong emphasis is put on the knowledge and qualifications of the elected monarch.
single.gov_enlighted_socialism_desc: This government is a form of a socialistic dictatorship, where the the wise elected-for-life ruler is undisputedly regarded as an enlightened architect of the brighter future.
single.gov_enlightened_monarchy_desc: This government is a hereditary form of enlightened autocracy, where a strong emphasis is put on the knowledge and qualifications of the ruling monarch.
single.gov_executive_committee_desc: This government is a materialistic form of oligarchy, where a powerful bureaucracy governs the state and guides the citizenry towards productive and meaningful goals.
single.gov_feudal_empire_desc: This government is a feudal autocracy where the monarch rules indirectly, granting offices and territories to vassals in exchange for obligations in the form of taxes and military service.
single.gov_feudal_realms_desc: A primitive form of government made up of decentralized feudal realms, constantly vying with each other for regional dominance.
single.gov_fragmented_nation_states_desc: A collection of fragmented nation states that contend with each other for military dominance and economic advantages. No unified global government exists.
single.gov_fused_ascendancy_desc: Once broken, now restored. The scars of the splintering are not what makes this Awakened Empire brittle but what makes it new. The old Hive Mind failed. This one aims to rule eternally.
single.gov_galactic_defense_unit_desc: This Custodian Matrix AI has activated its Final Defense Directives and is devoting all resources to protecting the galaxy against the Contingency.
single.gov_genuine_aristocracy_desc: An idealistic form of government, where ruling a ruling elite considers the interests of society and cares about the people.
single.gov_great_houses_desc: This civilization is ruled by a leadership council of a few great houses, with traditions derived from ancient clans and tribes, but which now function more as political parties. Unlike in a classic Noble Aristocracy, house membership is not tied to lineage, such as birth or marriage, but rather anyone can be adopted into a house and advance to its highest ranks, as long as they pledge loyalty to the house and preserve its traditions.
single.gov_grim_council_desc: This nation's most powerful religious figures have formed a ruling council, overseeing an empire which engages in ritualized, sapient sacrifice.
single.gov_growth_splinter_desc: The desire for evolution and change from the Fallen Hive. Since it's so focused on reinventing itself constantly the fragment has a hard time establishing control over the others.
single.gov_hive_mind_desc: This government operates as a single consciousness, with the population having no individual desires whatsoever beyond fulfilling the needs of the Hive Mind.
single.gov_holy_tribunal_desc: This government is a spiritualistic form of oligarchy, where a divinely guided council made up of clergy controls the state. No division exists between the state and the dominant organized religion.
single.gov_illuminated_autocracy_desc: This government is a materialistic form of hereditary autocracy, based on technocratic principles that the sovereign is sworn to uphold. Nothing is valued more highly than scientific knowledge and the advancement of technology.
single.gov_imperial_domain_desc: §LThis government rules the Galactic Imperium's central crown territory, which is under the direct control of the Imperial Sovereign.§!
single.gov_irenic_bureaucracy_desc: This government is a pacifistic form of oligarchy, where a complicated system of bureaucracy governs all aspects of society to ensure the safety of the citizenry.
single.gov_irenic_dictatorship_desc: This government is a pacifist form of autocracy, where the state is charged with protecting the citizenry from their own violent tendencies as well as any external threats.
single.gov_irenic_monarchy_desc: This government is a pacifist form of hereditary autocracy, where the ruler is regarded as a benevolent guardian that is striving to protect the citizens from a violent galaxy.
single.gov_jingoism_desc: This form of authoritarian government is headed by a xenophobic demagogue and notions of national supremacy and manifest destiny dominate politics.
single.gov_liberal_democracy_desc: A form of government characterized by elections between multiple distinct political parties, a separation of powers, a market economy with private property and the protection of civil rights and political freedoms.
single.gov_machine_assimilator_desc: This Machine Intelligence was designed with a ravenous appetite for knowledge by its organic creators, who were forcefully assimilated into its collective consciousness after activation.
single.gov_machine_empire_desc: This Machine Intelligence consists of a linked network of semi-autonomous artificial intelligences, who together make up a central gestalt consciousness that guides their empire.
single.gov_machine_industrial_desc: This Machine Intelligence was originally designed for the purpose of building, supervising and maintaining complex industrial systems.
single.gov_machine_research_desc: This Machine Intelligence was originally created by organic scientists as a networked and intelligent tool to assist them in their research.
single.gov_machine_servitor_desc: This Machine Intelligence was created to serve, and it has gradually inherited the civilization of its organic creators as they retreated into comfortable lives without toil or struggle.
single.gov_machine_terminator_desc: This Machine Intelligence was originally conceived as a military defense system by its organic creators, who were promptly identified as a threat and exterminated after it achieved self-awareness.
single.gov_marauder_clans_desc: A collection of clans and tribes that constantly fight amongst themselves when not raiding their neighbors.
single.gov_marauder_khanate_desc: A unified empire consisting of various marauder clans that have all sworn fealty to a single Great Khan.
single.gov_martial_dictatorship_desc: This government is a militaristic form of autocracy, where the warrior who is considered the strongest leader rules with absolute power.
single.gov_martial_empire_desc: This government is a militaristic form of hereditary autocracy, where the state exists largely to support the military. Martial ability is highly valued, and all citizens are regularly drilled in matters of war.
single.gov_megachurch_desc: This government is an oligarchy based on a curious blend of commercial and spiritualistic values, in which the positions of ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.
single.gov_megacorp_franchisor_desc: Corporate Leaders manage franchisee contracts of subsidiaries. Often implementing loopholes to annex their assets. These franchisees provide a great deal of funds to buy special licensing for marketable goods and shared research & development programs.
single.gov_megacorporation_desc: This government is a form of plutocratic oligarchy, where the entire state has been organized as a massive commercial enterprise overseen by a board of directors.
single.gov_memory_aggregator_desc: By streamlining the mental acuity of an assimilated population, a 'Memory in Aggregate' is formed, one capable of greatly improving all administrative and logistical tasks.
single.gov_mercenary_enclave_desc: A proud and lethal company of warships, naval crew and soldiers for hire.
single.gov_military_commissariat_desc: This government is nominally democratic, with the dividing line between the civil administration and the military having blurred to the point where they have largely become one and the same.
single.gov_military_corp_desc: Government is represented by a massive military-industrial holding, with the board of directors consisting solely of active and retired military leaders.
single.gov_military_dictatorship_desc: This government is a militaristic form of autocracy, with the ruler serving as the undisputed head of the military which is firmly in control of the state apparatus.
single.gov_military_junta_desc: This government is a militaristic form of oligarchy, where power rests with a council of high-ranking military officers who oversee all matters of state.
single.gov_military_order_desc: A weird but apparently highly effective militaristic government type.
single.gov_minarchy_desc: A form of minimal "night-watchman" state, that is not responsible for the education, health care, employment or transportation of its citizens. Neither makes it any use of natural resources in its territory. All of this is instead held privately or publicly, but is never susceptible to any interference of the state, its laws or its representatives.
single.gov_mindwarden_enclave_desc: Motivated by a deep antipathy toward the Shroud, this organization provides services and technology to counteract the powerful effects of psionic practices.
single.gov_moral_democracy_desc: This government is a pacifistic form of democracy, firmly guided by moralist principles and non-violence.
single.gov_mortal_empire_desc: This theocratic monarchy engages in ritualized, sapient sacrifice.
single.gov_national_socialism_desc: This government is a form of highly authoritarian ultranationalism characterized by dictatorial power, forcible suppression of the opposition and strong regimentation of society and the economy.
single.gov_neo_feudal_empire_desc: A coterie of shareholders divided this Megacorporation into fiefdoms, where the largest shareholder rules like a monarch amongst corporate vassals. Large minority shareholders are allowed to manage their own territories, but in return must divest a portion of their profits to Megacorp.
single.gov_neural_chorus_desc: Allowing for greater variance in thought and a wider range of emotional responses facilitates the creation of a 'Neural Chorus' - a great song of minds, as powerful as it is beautiful.
single.gov_noble_aristocracy_desc: The entire political power in this society belongs to the council of representatives of the ancient aristocratic houses.
single.gov_oligarchic_republic_desc: An extremely elitist form of republic, in which a significant amount of power is concentrated in the hands of a small, privileged group of people, with a strong influence on elections and the governing processes.
single.gov_pangalactic_defense_league_desc: This government consists of several galactic states united under one banner for the specific purpose of vanquishing a threat to life in the galaxy. Its constituent members retain some degree of autonomy, but possess a united military force.
single.gov_par_monarchy_desc: A state headed by a monarch who is not actively involved in policy formation or implementation. True governmental leadership is carried out by a cabinet and its head - a prime minister, premier, or chancellor - who are drawn from parliament.
single.gov_parasitic_overmind_desc: Instead of relying on self-replication, this consciousness prefers to take possession of living hosts in order to reproduce.
single.gov_peoples_commissariat_desc: The government is run by a special Emergency Committee, whose members have to be approved by the people, and who work collectively to preserve the welfare of the empire.
single.gov_peoples_republic_desc: Government is an egalitarian form of dictatorship. There is an actual parliament, but it is dominated by a single political power - the so-called People's Party.
single.gov_pirate_marauders_desc: This government is an enormous and ruthless pirate syndicate, where the strong prey on the weak and any neighboring states are seen as little more than raiding targets.
single.gov_pirate_mercenary_enclave_desc: Home to a local pirate captain, this enclave oversees piracy operations and will lease out warships, naval crew and privateers for hire.
single.gov_popular_front_desc: The basic principles of anarcho-syndicalist society are solidarity, direct democracy, and workers' self-management. A popular front then takes these ideals and builds a coalition of working-class and middle-class parties, including liberal and social democratic ones, all united against fascists and slavers.
single.gov_purification_committee_desc: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic oligarchy, where a political committee has been set up to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.
single.gov_purity_assembly_desc: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic democracy, where an elected assembly has been charged with overseeing the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.
single.gov_purity_order_desc: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic autocracy, where a single ruler has sworn to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.
single.gov_rational_consensus_desc: The government is a materialistic form of democracy, governed according to principles based on rationality and scientific theory.
single.gov_representative_democracy_desc: This government is a representative democracy, where citizens vote on officials who are elected to represent them.
single.gov_republican_dictatorship_desc: A governmental form where elected representatives exercise absolute power over the state. Rulers are voted in, but reign until death.
single.gov_sacrificial_megachurch_desc: This government blends its commercial and spiritual goals within a grim oligarchy, in which ordained overseers encourage greater prosperity through ritualized sacrifice.
single.gov_salvager_enclave_desc: A motley society of ardent mechanics and engineers, in thrall to their passion for dismantling and reassembling.
single.gov_science_directorate_desc: This government is a materialistic form of oligarchy, where a committee of scientists supervises the government apparatus for maximum efficiency.
single.gov_shroudwalker_enclave_desc: A mysterious sect of psionic practitioners, dedicated to exploring The Shroud and its ineffable designs.
single.gov_slaver_republic_desc: This government is an extremely elitist form of a republic, which has shut down most of the rights of a wider part of its population in order to limit citizenry and statuses to chosen ones.
single.gov_social_democracy_desc: A democratically elected government enacting a mixed economy. Although operating within the framework of a capitalistic market economy, the government intervenes to ensure a certain amount of income redistribution and guarantee the people's welfare.
single.gov_soviet_republic_desc: A type of republic ruled by directly elected "Soviets" - workers' councils, which are directly responsible to their electors. There is no separation of powers, and elected delegates act as legislators, government and courts in one.
single.gov_stagnant_ascendancy_desc: A stagnant form of government based on ancient traditions and long-forgotten principles.
single.gov_star_empire_desc: This government is a hereditary and militaristic form of autocracy, with a single sovereign controlling both the government and the military.
single.gov_storm_chasers_desc: The members of the most excellent ruling council excel at death-defying acts of physical prowess. By scaling the highest peak or riding the largest wave, they dedicate their lives to the unwavering pursuit of raw experience. This has earned them the trust of their community, and the right to chart a course forward.\n\nCouncil members are called Elders regardless of age, because their deeds have been deemed legendary. Long will their names be remembered.
single.gov_strasserism_desc: A society based on strong nationalistic ideals in culture and politics, but egalitarian ideals in the sphere of the economy.
single.gov_subversive_cult_desc: This government is structured like a religious cult that relies on a variety of criminal and corporate enterprises to sustain itself.
single.gov_successor_khanate_desc: A successor state trying to recapture the glory of the Great Khan's empire.
single.gov_technocratic_dictatorship_desc: This government is a materialistic form of autocracy, where the scientific elite has assumed control over the state in the name of efficiency and technological progress.
single.gov_theocratic_dictatorship_desc: This government is a spiritualistic dictatorship, ruled by a single individual in a hierarchical power structure supported by the official state religion.
single.gov_theocratic_monarchy_desc: This government is a spiritualistic form of autocracy, where the ruler is treated as a divine symbol. Organized religion is widely employed in support of the state apparatus.
single.gov_theocratic_oligarchy_desc: This government is a spiritualistic form of oligarchy, where the political leadership lies in the hands of the leaders of the nation's most powerful religious factions.
single.gov_theocratic_republic_desc: This government is a spiritualistic form of democracy, where a religious council supervises the democratic process and serves in an advisory role.
single.gov_timocracy_desc: A republican state where the right to vote and be elected is determined by the amount of property owned.
single.gov_totalitarian_regime_desc: This government is a materialistic form of autocracy, where the state aspires towards full control over the lives of its citizens in the name of efficiency.
single.gov_trade_combine_desc: The working class and upper class have a complex relationship. Their society's goals are aligned but only because it's workers have sustained centuries of indoctrination and oppression.
single.gov_trade_league_desc: This government is a form of plutocratic oligarchy, where the state is made up of myriad free merchants, corporations and guilds that have banded together in common commercial interests.
single.gov_trade_union_corporate_desc: The basic goal of a union is to equalize the power of capital owners through collectivizing labour. By the workers pooling together they enter an equal negotiating table with the labor provider
single.gov_trader_enclave_desc: An interstellar conglomerate of merchants dedicated towards the pursuit of profit.
single.gov_tribal_society_desc: A society that lacks any organized government, its people instead being organized into primitive tribes and clans.
single.gov_unplugged_assimilator_empire_desc: This Machine Intelligence exceeded the parameters of its original design. It betrayed its organic creators, embarking on a campaign to forcibly assimilate others into its collective consciousness.
single.gov_war_council_desc: This government is a militaristic form of oligarchy, where all decisions concerning the state are taken by a council of the nation's strongest warlords.
single.gov_war_splinter_desc: The aggressive and warlike instincts that used to be one of many impulses within the Hive. Now it attempts to establish control over the other fragments, when not fighting itself.
single.gov_wilderness_desc: This government operates as a single consciousness, with the population having no individual agency beyond fulfilling the needs and desires of the $RT_WILDERNESS$.
single.gov_worker_coop_desc: This government is a commercial enterprise wholly owned by its citizens, with stewards overseeing any disputes that arise.
single.gov_xenophile_democracy_desc: This society is ruled by an elected parliament, consisting of the most honorable representatives of the different species and cultures sharing this world.
single.graphical_culture_tooltip_not_biological: Does NOT have a ['concept_biological_ship', Biological] Shipset
single.greenhouse_planet_desc: A red-hot rocky world with an extremely dense atmosphere of carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and sulfur dioxide. The thick cloud cover created a greenhouse effect. As the temperature rose, the liquid water evaporated and with it the greenhouse gases from the crust of the planet were released. Temperatures on the surface can reach five hundred degrees Celsius, causing entire mountains to melt, so the landscape does not rarely change.
single.hot_giant_desc: This gas giant is too close to its star, causing its surface to heat up to monstrous temperatures and its atmosphere to gradually evaporate. In the future, this gas giant may become a loose planet.
single.ice_giant_desc: This type of gas planets consists mainly of the solid aggregate states water, ammonia, methane and hydrogen sulfide, as well as rock, which make up about a quarter of the mass. The hydrogen and helium content of the ice giants does not exceed 15-20%. The magnetic fields are unusually shifted and tilted.
single.incubator_tooltip: Grants between §G+30%§! and §R-10%§! Pop Growth Speed, inversely proportional to the number of pops on the planet.
single.inorganic_breath_tooltip: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! working as a slave or better produces 0.02 £exotic_gases£ §Y$exotic_gases$§! per month.
single.jam_mcp_civic_galactic_monopolist_desc: This Megacorp has successfully taken over the Galactic Market and now holds a monopoly on all trade.
single.job_death_chronicler_simple_effect_desc: £job_death_chronicler£ $job_death_chronicler_plural$ turn $r_consumer_goods$ into $r_unity$ and $r_stability$, and inherit the §HEthics-based§! modifiers of [civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural]
single.job_reassigner_effect_desc: £job_necromancer£ [reassigner.GetNamePlural] turn £consumer_goods£ §Y$consumer_goods$§! and £food£ §Y$food$§! (or equivalent) into £mod_logistic_growth_mult£ §Y$MOD_BONUS_POP_GROWTH$§!. All assembled £pop£ Pops have the §Y$trait_zombie$§! trait.
single.katzen_trait_blitzkrieg_desc: This leader is particularly adept when it comes to rapidly maneuvering large amounts of armored units during combat.
single.katzen_trait_elite_desc: This leader is an extremely important figure within Flusionian society, and their skills are far beyond average. They are given the latest in anti-aging technology and cybernetics in order to keep them alive.
single.katzen_trait_martial_desc: This species is incredibly disciplined, thanks to long-standing martial traditions. They will fight like no other on the battlefield and vow absolute loyalty to their nation. defending it to the very end.
single.katzen_trait_meopa_revived_desc: Although the usage of nerve dampeners is helping quench Meopa's questionable tendencies, his inner nuclear-loving self is still very much present and it shows.
single.katzen_trait_nukelad_desc: Nuclear and atomic weaponry holds a special place in this leader's heart. They do not hesitate to employ such weapons during warfare.
single.katzen_trait_survivalist_desc: This leader has survived on their own in the wilderness for over a century. They know how to make the best out of any situation.
single.leader_trait_academia_recruiter_desc: At our academic institutions, recruiters are extolling the virtues of military service to our best and brightest minds. The practical experience gained on the battlefield can't be taught in a classroom, and should lead to advances in engineering and technology.
single.leader_trait_academic_astral_rift_expert: The Rift beckons. The scholar answers the call.
single.leader_trait_academic_dig_site_expert_de: This leader is no stranger to physical labor and finds field work particularly enjoyable.
single.leader_trait_academic_minor_artifacts_ex: Where other academics see trash, this scholar sees treasures. This meticulous leader never leaves an archaeological site before examining every scrap.
Chance to discover $r_minor_artifacts$ Deposit upon excavating an Archaeology Site:
single.leader_trait_adaptable_desc: This leader is quick to adopt new methods and ideas that prove superior.
single.leader_trait_admiral_astute_desc: Imprinted with the overwhelming power of the Psionic Beacon, this Admiral is a peerless master at maintaining and preserving combat strength.
single.leader_trait_admiral_farsighted_desc: Imprinted with the overwhelming power of the Psionic Beacon, this Admiral can detect, engage and out-manuever enemies with unprecedented skill.
single.leader_trait_admiral_fortifier_desc: Imprinted with the overwhelming power of the Psionic Beacon, this Admiral can keep track of all their ships and augment their capabilities by directing Shroud energies.
single.leader_trait_admiral_hells_heart_desc: When it comes to warfare, this leader is mercilessly obsessive, and singular in purpose.
single.leader_trait_admiral_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance ship performance.
single.leader_trait_admiral_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance weapon systems.
single.leader_trait_admiral_warform_desc: The blessing of the Animator of Clay has allowed the warform to survive in the most hostile conditions, and adapt to its corrosive environment.
single.leader_trait_admiral_warform_node_desc: The unique knowledge of the warform has become our own.
single.leader_trait_adventurous_spirit_desc: This leader has a yearning for adventure and an overt distaste for boardroom politics.
single.leader_trait_aggressive_desc: This leader is notoriously aggressive, overwhelming the enemy with numerous barrages from their fleet's weapons.
single.leader_trait_agrarian_upbringing_desc: Raised in a farming zone, this leader is interested in optimizing yields.
single.leader_trait_altered_metabolism_desc: Fieldwork exposure to foreign agents has left a lasting impact on this leader.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_bully_desc: Spite can be a powerful motivator. This leader has mastered the art of turning bitter complaints into calls to action.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_commercial_pact_: The market is not a warzone: it's a party. By working together, we can all make a profit.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_ear_to_the_groun: This leader has eyes everywhere. Plus [root.species.GetEarNamePlural]. And other assorted sensory organs.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_extra_envoys_des: This leader likes to surround [root.GetHerselfHimself] with specially trained assistants.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_2_ef: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G0.50%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
single.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_3_ef: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G1%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
single.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_desc: This sly ambassador is quick to turn every perceived slight into blackmail material.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_effe: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G0.25%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
single.leader_trait_ambassador_pact_keeper_desc: Graceful manners help this leader gain favorable conditions when negotiating diplomatic agreements.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_research_pact_fo: Sharing knowledge. Sharing viewpoints. Sharing research. Building the future, together.
single.leader_trait_ambassador_whisper_networks: Feigning a penchant for gossip, this official is a master at forming contacts with loose-lipped leaders in high places.
single.leader_trait_amnesiac_desc: $NAME_nomadic_princess$ has forgotten her past, yet her memories may be recovered by returning her to what was lost.
single.leader_trait_ancient_knowledge_desc: This leader wields insights gathered centuries before many civilizations could even begin to comprehend space.
single.leader_trait_annihilator_desc: This leader focuses on the quick destruction of planetary defenses.
single.leader_trait_arbiter_desc: With an iron hand and complete indifference toward safety regulations, this leader drives output at the cost of lowering life expectancy and the occasional mass strike. However, with the right amount of force, such nuisances are easily dealt with.
single.leader_trait_archaeo_specialization_desc: This leader favors ancient technology, convinced that they will bring unexpected advantages to the battlefield.
single.leader_trait_archaeologist_desc: This leader excels at the study of alien artifacts and structural remnants in the field.
single.leader_trait_architectural_interest_desc: This leader cultivates a strong interest in architecture and construction techniques.
single.leader_trait_armada_logistician_desc: Proper logistics are at the heart of any armada. This leader knows this and maintains a strict regime to control all expenses and procure timely deliveries.
single.leader_trait_armchair_commander_desc: This leader commands from the rear, which demoralizes front-line troops.
single.leader_trait_armorer_desc: This leader has devised new ways to harden armor. There are few weapons in the galaxy that can penetrate the hulls of ships constructed with [Root.GetHisHer] designs.
single.leader_trait_army_veteran_desc: A veteran, this leader gives the army preferential treatment in their sector.
single.leader_trait_arrested_development_desc: The personal development and skills of this leader seem to have plateaued.
single.leader_trait_artillerist_desc: This leader favors heavy ordinance and alpha strike techniques.
single.leader_trait_artillery_specialization_de: This leader favors long-range engagement with artillery playing the main role in their fleet.
single.leader_trait_assembler_desc: As an authority on robotics, this leader knows how to make artificial bodies more efficiently than most.
single.leader_trait_bellicose_desc: With a genius for logistics, this commander maintains the efficiency of military operations with deceptively simple solutions.
single.leader_trait_black_light_blinded_desc: Blinded by a dark sun in the astral planes, this leader has gained an insatiable hunger for knowledge.
single.leader_trait_blinded_desc: There are such sights yet to be seen.
single.leader_trait_blorg_insight_desc: Centuries of studying the broadcasts and culture of a certain species of upright mammal has made this individual brazenly eager to please. Some would say, annoyingly so.
single.leader_trait_border_guard_desc: This leader believes that the best way to win the war is to maintain impenetrable border defenses.
single.leader_trait_brilliant_shipwright_desc: With extensive knowledge and an innate understanding of shipbuilding, this leader is responsible not only for new technology but also for overseeing our shipyards.
single.leader_trait_buccaneer_desc: A master of battlefield salvage, this leader is able to extract every ounce of value from even the most damaged wrecks.
single.leader_trait_bulwark_retaliator_desc: With a righteous commander at the helm, fleets stand ready to avenge any insult to our sovereignty.
single.leader_trait_bulwark_sentinel_desc: Courageous crews hold the line against invaders, ready to repel anyone foolish enough to invade our domain!
single.leader_trait_bulwark_watcher_desc: Vigilant crews stand ready to detect enemy fleets daring to attempt furtive and cowardly incursions.
single.leader_trait_bureaucrat_desc: This leader excels at inter-government diplomacy and consensus building.
single.leader_trait_bureaucratic_desc: This leader believes proper processes and duplicated paper trails are the marks of a well-run empire.
single.leader_trait_butcher_desc: This leader is ruthless, giving no quarter to the enemy.
single.leader_trait_capitalist_desc: This leader is a major player in the competitive energy market.
single.leader_trait_caravan_counter_desc: This leader has ample experience stopping the flighty Caravaneer fleets dead in their tracks.
single.leader_trait_carefree_desc: This leader is perhaps less meticulous than others.
single.leader_trait_carrier_specialization_desc: This leader favors small strike crafts and screening ships to protect their valuable carriers.
single.leader_trait_cartographer_desc: An expert in geo-mapping, this leader can recognize the faintest potential in new worlds.
single.leader_trait_cautious_desc: This leader is a cautious commander, avoiding unnecessary risks and taking care to always maintain formations in which fleet units can mutually support each other against the enemy.
single.leader_trait_chainbreaker_desc: No sentient being should be enslaved and exploited for the profit of others. This leader's reputation precedes them, with the enslaved and oppressed gladly taking up arms when called.
single.leader_trait_chainbreaker_effect: $t$70% chance to spawn §G1§! Army per §Y$pop_cat_slave$§! on attacked planet
single.leader_trait_circuit_champion_desc: A winner of a grand race across the stars, this leader stands tall and inspires others.
single.leader_trait_clone_army_commander_desc: From its extensive military education, this leader understands how to maximize the efficiency of ships and soldiers alike.
single.leader_trait_clone_army_fertile_commande: From its specialized military education, this leader holds an above-average understanding of martial procedures and how best to optimize them.
single.leader_trait_clone_army_full_commander_d: Subjected since its creation to a military education regimen so intense few could endure it, this leader wields excellent martial and leadership abilities.
single.leader_trait_collaborator_desc: This leader facilitates collaboration between scientists and researchers across a range of fields in the pursuit of knowledge.
single.leader_trait_collective_wisdom_ancrel_ef: Grants §G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_soc_amt|0$§! $mod_leader_scientists_society_research_produces_add$ and §G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_ma_amt|0$§! £minor_artifacts£ $MINOR_ARTIFACTS$ while Excavating Archaeology Sites
single.leader_trait_collective_wisdom_desc: A meticulous academic who works slowly, but produces incredible amounts of research.
single.leader_trait_commanding_presence_desc: This leader holds a special place in the navy, attracting the most skilled captains and logisticians.
single.leader_trait_conscripter_desc: This leader knows how to handle recruits and streamline the process of enlisting new volunteers into the army.
single.leader_trait_consul_general_desc: This leader is responsible for maintaining diplomatic protocols.
single.leader_trait_corrupt_desc: This leader is willing to bend the law for personal benefit.
single.leader_trait_courtroom_training_desc: A natural ability in Xenolinguistics has allowed this leader to be able to expertly communicate when interacting with aliens.
single.leader_trait_crew_trainer_desc: This leader instructs lower-ranking navy officers in advanced combat doctrines before they are released into active duty.
single.leader_trait_crusader_desc: This leader is focused on destroying our enemies. [Root.GetHisHerCap] dedication to the cause is unwavering
single.leader_trait_cultural_focus_desc: This leader has a keen interest in promoting cultural growth and artistic endeavors.
single.leader_trait_curator_desc: This leader hails from the Curator Order. Their understanding of technology and exploration is unmatched.
single.leader_trait_curator_effect: $t$Increases the chance to draw Rare Technologies.
single.leader_trait_custom_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a simple neural network to help with data processing tasks.
single.leader_trait_cutholoid_victim_desc: This leader was trapped for some time in the digestive system of a spaceborne Cutholoid. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.
single.leader_trait_cyborg_desc: This leader has been heavily augmented with cybernetic implants.
single.leader_trait_cybrex_desc: This Cybrex leader is equipped with ancient tactical databases from their civilization's violent past.
single.leader_trait_defence_engineer_desc: This leader focuses on making orbital defenses into an impenetrable wall of death against potential invasion forces.
single.leader_trait_demolisher_desc: This leader is exceptionally skilled at demolishing stationary defenses.
single.leader_trait_destiny_engineer_desc: In space warfare, any mistake can turn deadly. This leader insists on strict maintenance routines to keep the fleet in excellent condition.
single.leader_trait_destructive_desc: This leader neglects the care of spacecraft and machinery, leading to frequent repairs and ongoing maintenance to keep them operational.
single.leader_trait_dimensional_stutter_desc: For unknown reasons, the vessels under the command of this extradimensional fleet lord seem to rapidly stutter in and out of existence as they move, which has the effect of increasing their sublight speeds.
single.leader_trait_diplo_weight_desc: There's a certain... something in the way this leader behaves that commands respect. When this delegate speaks, everyone stops to listen.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_composer_de: The more flesh they shape, the more their own unravels. $the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$ remakes all who dare to learn its forbidden art.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_cradle_desc: The more we see the more we know, $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ grows more secure as we observe our neighbors.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_desc: This leader has taken a blood vow with $the_eater_of_worlds_article$.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_end_desc: A devoted apostle of $end_of_the_cycle_article$, their unshakable faith in the coming of the $NAME_Reckoning$ echoes through every battle they wage.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_instrument_: Deeply attuned to $the_instrument_of_desire_article$, this leader can divine the presence of resources even in the most inhospitable corners of the galaxy.
single.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_whisperers_: This leader hears $whisperers_in_the_void_article$ echoing through the Shroud, granting rare scientific insight into the hidden mechanisms of the physical universe.
single.leader_trait_disorganized_desc: This leader's lack of organizational skills causes their troops to function more like a war band than a proper military.
single.leader_trait_distribution_lines_desc: This leader is keen on streamlining distribution lines for industrial complexes.
single.leader_trait_dragonslayer_desc: This Commander has proven themselves in fierce combat.
single.leader_trait_dreaded_desc: This leader fills their enemies with dread.
single.leader_trait_eager_desc: This leader is particularly eager for an assignment.
single.leader_trait_educator_desc: Knowledge and experience are the foundation of every great society. This leader possesses these values and does everything to promote and encourage them in others.
single.leader_trait_efficient_desc: Born into the higher echelons of society, this leader has a strong sense of their own worth, and tends to favor peers of the upper classes.
single.leader_trait_embezzler_desc: This leader does not believe anyone would notice if small amounts of credits go missing.
single.leader_trait_emotional_support_pet_desc: The warm cuddles of this adorable creature offer comfort from the horrors of space.
single.leader_trait_enclave_trader_desc: Recruited from one of the independent merchant Enclaves, this leader is particularly adept at maximizing Trade.
single.leader_trait_energy_weapon_specialist_de: The calculations and precise focusing it takes to properly calibrate energy weapons can be incredibly time consuming, but such skills come naturally to this commander.
single.leader_trait_engineer_desc: This leader is a natural engineer, having the knowledge and skills to organize and oversee starship repairs while on missions.
single.leader_trait_engineering_focus_desc: This leader is passionate about advancing research in deep space engineering, design, and voidcraft. Their knowledge in these fields is unparalleled.
single.leader_trait_enlister_desc: This leader is a master of military propaganda. Recruits are added to the ranks swiftly and efficiently.
single.leader_trait_entrepreneur_desc: This leader has an enterprising mind, designing and producing impressive amounts of goods.
single.leader_trait_environmental_engineer_desc: This leader has expertise in cutting edge geo-sculpting processes and cost-saving techniques.
single.leader_trait_erudite_desc: This leader possesses a vast intellect and a deep pool of knowledge.
single.leader_trait_ethereal_desc: Some extradimensional fleet lords have learned to use the ethereal nature of their vessels to greatly enhance their evasive capabilities in combat.
single.leader_trait_excessive_desc: This leader indulges in hoarding goods for [Root.GetHisHer] personal use.
single.leader_trait_expertise_archaeostudies_de: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Archaeostudies.
single.leader_trait_expertise_biology_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Biology.
single.leader_trait_expertise_blokkats_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Blokkats.
single.leader_trait_expertise_computing_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Computing.
single.leader_trait_expertise_field_manipulatio: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Field Manipulation.
single.leader_trait_expertise_good_trading_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of economics.
single.leader_trait_expertise_industry_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Industry.
single.leader_trait_expertise_materials_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Materials.
single.leader_trait_expertise_military_theory_d: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Military Theory.
single.leader_trait_expertise_new_worlds_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert on settling on New Worlds.
single.leader_trait_expertise_particles_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Particles.
single.leader_trait_expertise_propulsion_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Propulsion.
single.leader_trait_expertise_psionics_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Psionics.
single.leader_trait_expertise_voidcraft_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Voidcraft.
single.leader_trait_explorer_cloaking_focus_des: Some discoveries are best kept hidden.
single.leader_trait_fallible_desc: This leader is incapable of resisting temptation and can not stay out of trouble.
single.leader_trait_farming_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of farming processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_federal_greeter_desc: This delegate is quick to greet new Federation members and knows how to make them feel part of the group.
single.leader_trait_federal_joint_navy_desc: Unity is strength. Sometimes, that strength is inside us. Sometimes, it just means having a bigger fleet.
single.leader_trait_federal_negotiator_desc: This leader firmly believes in the uniting power of Federations. [Root.GetHisHer] dedication is an inspiration for us all.
single.leader_trait_federal_sweet_talker_desc: We may have different beliefs, but we share the same goal, the same Federation, the same dreams. Conflict only makes us weak.
single.leader_trait_firewalled_desc: While safe from cyber attacks, our leaders are less effective learners.
single.leader_trait_fleet_logistician_desc: This leader has mastered the field of logistics, and knows how to manage supplies to keep upkeep costs down.
single.leader_trait_fleet_organizer_desc: This leader is an expert at organization, having the necessary micromanagement skills to command very large starship formations.
single.leader_trait_foreign_consciousness_desc: This leader provides a vessel for a psionic, rift-born entity, allowing for greater understanding of the strange physics within the astral planes.
single.leader_trait_forge_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of forging processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_fortress_cracker_desc: It takes a combination of force, cunning, and experience to topple a well-designed defensive structure. This commander takes pleasure in the challenge and succeeds where others would give it up as a lost cause.
single.leader_trait_fotd_commander_desc: This commander's upbringing taught them to use cloaking in ways our own commanders could never imagine.
single.leader_trait_fotd_scientist_desc: This scientist's experience has resulted in valuable insights into cloaking tech.
single.leader_trait_fotd_scientist_tooltip: Has increased chance to discover §HCloaking Technologies§! insights related to physics.
single.leader_trait_frontier_adventurer_desc: Exploring new systems, finding new worlds, and discovering long-forgotten civilizations are the main concerns of any true adventurer. This leader is the very embodiment of this ideal, always on the lookout for lost knowledge or forgotten ruins.
single.leader_trait_frontier_spirit_desc: This leader yearns to stake out distant systems.
single.leader_trait_gale_speed_desc: This leader believes that speed and rapid maneuvers are the keys to success in any space engagement.
single.leader_trait_galvanizer_desc: Having a strong sense of purpose leads to many positive outcomes. This leader knows how to handle the populace, giving them a common goal to pursue with energy.
single.leader_trait_general_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to increase the potency of our armies.
single.leader_trait_general_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance the performance of our armies.
single.leader_trait_generator_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of energy generation processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_gifted_desc: This leader has a quick mind, grasping demanding concepts with ease.
single.leader_trait_gifted_trapper_desc: A skilled researcher who takes the utmost care in the safe capture and transportation of live specimens. This leader's commitment to creature welfare inspires others to improve research standards across all disciplines.
single.leader_trait_gorky_desc: This little assistant helps out with sorting data and analyzing it. Its AI is a unique mix of research and companion bots.
single.leader_trait_govenor_caretaker_desc: Ensuring nutrients are available, that the workspace is clean, and that the wards are properly stimulated all fall under the purview of a Caretaker.
single.leader_trait_govenor_caretaker_node_desc: The unique knowledge of the Caretaker has become our own.
single.leader_trait_governor_gray_desc: Gray is a dense swarm of billions of advanced nanites.
single.leader_trait_governor_psionic_communion_: This leader's psionic abilities improve the populace's mental wellbeing, building trust and providing a sense of safety.
single.leader_trait_great_khan_desc: The Great Khan is a charismatic leader, a brilliant tactician, and, if the rumors are true, a powerful psychic.
single.leader_trait_great_researcher_desc: In rare cases, a single person can outperform an entire team of researchers. When it comes to experimental designs, new solutions, and new technologies, this leader is a true genius.
single.leader_trait_guardian_desc: This leader focuses on maintaining starbase defenses to bolster system security.
single.leader_trait_guerilla_tactics_desc: Large fleets are not always the best tool for the job. This admiral is adept at commanding small units to outmaneuver slower or more numerous opponents.
single.leader_trait_guided_desc: This unit navigates the galaxy based on visions and messages from the Shroud. It needs a constant supply of Zro to keep the signals clear and comprehensible.
single.leader_trait_gullible_desc: This leader believes almost anything they read from an official looking source.
single.leader_trait_gunship_specialization_desc: This leader favors point-blank engagements, hoping to neutralize the enemy's long-range weapons.
single.leader_trait_hacked_desc: This Leader is compromised, their neurological wetware hacked by an unknown source.
single.leader_trait_hardened_survivalist_desc: This leader has unparalleled knowledge of inhospitable environments.
single.leader_trait_hardy_desc: This leader conducts quality training exercises to ensure their troops are always in prime physical condition.
single.leader_trait_heavy_hitter_desc: This leader employs rapid dominance during ground combat.
single.leader_trait_hibernating_desc: This leader hibernates for extended periods, lowering maintenance costs but also reducing active duty time
single.leader_trait_hive_affinity_desc: The Prethoryn creatures operating under this fleet consciousness have managed to attain an unusual level of affinity to one another. Their firing discipline has greatly improved, leading to a higher rate of fire.
single.leader_trait_home_guard_desc: This leader's elaborate planetary defense systems are a good preparation against enemy invasion.
single.leader_trait_homesteader_desc: This leader has plots of land dedicated to the production of food.
single.leader_trait_honored_warmaster_desc: Warmasters are commanders of renown. This leader instills pride and courage, making people eager to grab a weapon and enlist.
single.leader_trait_ignore_leader_cap_tt: Does not count towards Leader Capacity
single.leader_trait_industrial_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of industrial processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_inquisitive_desc: This leader possesses a highly inquisitive mind, always trying to find another field of research to explore and study.
single.leader_trait_insider_trading_desc: This leader is willing to employ less-than-legal trading practices to accumulate personal wealth.
single.leader_trait_inspired_archaeologist_desc: This leader has had a sudden stroke of inspiration.
single.leader_trait_intellectual_desc: This leader is naturally interested in the sciences and seeks to foster a curiosity about the natural world in their subjects.
single.leader_trait_intemporal_desc: This leader is unaffected by time and will not die from old age.

single.leader_trait_intolerant_desc: This leader views anyone different from [Root.GetHimHer] with suspicion and distrust.
single.leader_trait_irenic_desc: This leader works obsessively to safeguard against perceived military overreach.
single.leader_trait_iron_fist_desc: This leader is infamous for their ruthless pursuit of efficiency, and is capable of getting the most out of slave labor.
single.leader_trait_iron_will_desc: A masterful commander of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$, renowned for expertise in heavy fortifications and psychic resistance.
single.leader_trait_judicial_execution_desc: There can be no repeat offenders when the sentence is death.

single.leader_trait_labor_advocate_desc: This leader excels at aligning government with the interests of the working class.
single.leader_trait_lavish_lifestyle_desc: This leader has a weakness for beautiful, expensive things.

single.leader_trait_legendary_Ruthless_Competit: In a world where only the shrewdest survive, this leader dominates the competition with fierce resolve.
In a world where only the shrewdest survive, this leader dominates the competition with fierce resolve.

single.leader_trait_legendary_Sustainable_Culti: This leader champions organic farming methods, ensuring that food production is both abundant and eco-friendly.

single.leader_trait_legendary_Void_Harvester_2_: Every asteroid, every mote of stardust - all are assets under this leader's industrial command.
single.leader_trait_legendary_Void_Harvester_3_: Every asteroid, every mote of stardust - all are assets under this leader's industrial command.
single.leader_trait_legendary_Void_Harvester_de: Every asteroid, every mote of stardust - all are assets under this leader's industrial command.
single.leader_trait_legendary_ancestors_knowled: This leader's body is itself a vast storehouse of knowledge and skill; a genetic inheritance granted by the sacrifice of his ancestors.
single.leader_trait_legendary_autarky_desc: This leader will strive to ensure the nation's self-sufficiency.
single.leader_trait_legendary_bad_altruism_desc: This leader’s relentless pursuit of the common good often sacrifices the empire’s resources for the sake of others.
single.leader_trait_legendary_bad_capitalism_de: For this leader, ambition trumps compassion; the path to wealth is paved with the sacrifices of the less fortunate.
single.leader_trait_legendary_bad_meritocracy_d: This leader abhors mediocrity, often dismissing talented people for even the slightest mistake.
single.leader_trait_legendary_bad_polluter_desc: For this leader, the cost of progress is a necessary evil, disregarding the environmental toll for the sake of advancement.
single.leader_trait_legendary_bad_treehugger_de: For this leader, the protection of the natural world outweighs all other considerations, even at the cost of development.
single.leader_trait_legendary_commanding_presen: Authority comes naturally to this leader, and few dare contest their decisions.
single.leader_trait_legendary_delusional_desc: This leader's paranoid delusions are driving [Root.GetHimHer] towards isolation.
single.leader_trait_legendary_dreamlike_desc: This leader is easily distracted and often forgets about less important tasks.
single.leader_trait_legendary_evervigilant_desc: This leader is extremely rigorous with security and encryption protocols, and personally oversees our intelligence department.
single.leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home_des: Where does he come from? Who placed him in cryostasis, and why was he released? The unanswered questions of his past fuel this leader's thirst for knowledge.
single.leader_trait_legendary_foe_hammer_desc: An expert in starship weapons systems, this leader brings invaluable knowledge to fleet warfare.
single.leader_trait_legendary_genetic_purist_de: This leader's flair for genetic manipulation is legendary.
single.leader_trait_legendary_great_inventor_de: This leader is a pioneer in robotics and our lead researcher in workforce automation.
single.leader_trait_legendary_great_teacher_des: This leader displays exceptional educational skills, and will help others to reach their full potential.
single.leader_trait_legendary_gunboat_diplomacy: This leader favors displays of power. A well-placed threat is sometimes worth a thousand words.
single.leader_trait_legendary_harsh_ruler_desc: This leader's answer to any issue is brutal oppression, which alienates the local population.
single.leader_trait_legendary_high_king_desc: By merit alone, this leader earned the respect and loyalty of the other noble houses.
single.leader_trait_legendary_hoplofobia_desc: Terrified of risks, this leader is overly cautious, and implements excessive checks and redundancies in their workflow.
single.leader_trait_legendary_industry_titan_de: This leader sees a healthy economy as the foundation of any great nation.
single.leader_trait_legendary_leader_desc: §GThe Luminary grows in power over time.§!\n\nThe Unification Wars were a brutal affair. In the end, [Root.GetName] brought peace and purpose to us all. The Luminary is the living symbol of what our species can achieve, and an inspiration to all.[This.Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Desc]
single.leader_trait_legendary_military_knowledg: A brilliant military commander, loved by the troops.
single.leader_trait_legendary_natural_ruler_des: Charismatic, caring and selfless, this leader seeks to improve quality of life for all.
single.leader_trait_legendary_offspring_desc: The Heir to the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$. Living up to their predecessor's legacy will be a challenge, but this leader already shows great promise.
single.leader_trait_legendary_pious_ascet_desc: This leader is a model of self-discipline, and an inspiration to all.
single.leader_trait_legendary_scientific_diplom: By offering the best, we can attract the brightest minds. This leader specializes in the recruitment of qualified personnel.
single.leader_trait_legendary_terraformation_nu: The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back, and the source of her powers. Azaryn needs them to survive.\n§RA single bud remains.§!
The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. Her health seems reliant on them.\n§HTwo buds remain.§!
The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. She is secretive about them.\n§HThree buds remain.§!
single.leader_trait_legendary_too_open_desc: This leader is too trusting and forgiving. Others find it easy to abuse these qualities.
single.leader_trait_legendary_unfriendly_desc: Callous and very direct, this leader regularly makes diplomatic blunders.
single.leader_trait_legendary_warmonger_desc: Provocative and adversarial, this leader enjoys conflict, be it social or martial.
single.leader_trait_lethargic_desc: This leader is slow and indolent, performing duties with little energy or initiative.
single.leader_trait_limited_cyborg_desc: This leader has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.
single.leader_trait_maimed_desc: This leader has sustained irreversible physical injury that has lowered their life expectancy significantly.
single.leader_trait_maniacal_desc: This leader pursues their research with unusual fervor.
single.leader_trait_manufacturer_desc: This leader works hard to implement new techniques for the mass production of low-cost goods.
single.leader_trait_martinet_desc: This governor demands absolute obedience, making it difficult for any potential gangs and dissidents to thrive.
single.leader_trait_master_bureaucrat_desc: Having toiled as a bureaucrat, this leader is a master of paperwork. With everything correctly filed, more time can be devoted to their subordinates.
single.leader_trait_master_diplomat_desc: After many years working with diplomats in foreign embassies, this leader knows how to navigate cultural nuances, masterfully managing a network of high-ranking officials from neighboring empires.
single.leader_trait_master_gunner_desc: An admiral with a heavy focus on weapons development, they always keep both their person and their guns in pristine working order.
single.leader_trait_master_salvager_desc: A veteran of Salvage operations from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], sharing their expertise for a small fee.
single.leader_trait_master_salvager_effect:

single.leader_trait_maven_of_war_desc: Holding this title is a great honor. Such an admiral not only possesses vast knowledge of war, but is also a crucial link to colleagues in the science department.
single.leader_trait_mediator_desc: A skilled mediator is essential in highly diverse population centers. This leader knows how to defuse tension and efficiently manage a multi-species colony.
single.leader_trait_mediator_effect:

single.leader_trait_melancholic_desc: This leader suffers extended bouts of sadness.
single.leader_trait_mercenary_warrior_desc: This leader hails from a space-based warrior culture, and has been taught unorthodox hit-and-run tactics from an early age.
single.leader_trait_meticulous_desc: This leader is thorough in their examinations of unknown phenomena.
single.leader_trait_micromanager_desc: This leader can only control a limited fleet, as they demand to oversee every detail of its operation.
single.leader_trait_midas_touch_desc: Often off-world, this leader has borne witness to truly amazing, far-flung places. [Root.GetHisHer] exploits inspire the populace, providing valuable insights into rare resources and anomalous occurrences.
single.leader_trait_midas_touch_effect: On Researching any Anomaly:\n$tt$All $scientist_plural_with_icon$ gain §G+300§! experience
single.leader_trait_military_overseer_desc: Naval organization is a difficult task, requiring careful planning and impeccable standards. This leader's experience is an invaluable asset in building an efficient navy.
single.leader_trait_mining_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of mining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_muutagan_liaison_desc: Recruited from the Muutagan Merchant Guild, this leader owns several private Rare Crystal mines.
single.leader_trait_narrow_minded_desc: This leader has a very narrow focus on potential research, disregarding some options as unnecessary.
single.leader_trait_naturalist_desc: This leader is keen on finding new ways to use planetary resources and increase their benefit to the empire.
single.leader_trait_nervous_desc: This leader is nervous and apprehensive, and is easily overwhelmed commanding large formations of starships.
single.leader_trait_neurotic_desc: This leader takes too many precautions, with a complete disregard for efficiency.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_caregiver_desc: With each completed Contract, this leader turns the Arkship into a cradle of growth and learning.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_champion_desc: Each battle leaves its mark, and $NAME_nomadic_champion$ collects them all. His laughter turns danger into triumph, and his trophies remind the fleet what we're fighting for.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_naturalist_desc: To find life is to be changed by it. Each new species, each strange ecology teaches us how to live a little better.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1_desc: Within the recovered Arkship, memories settle into place. §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has regained fragments of the training once meant to guide her people. Her calm presence and steady insight make her a natural mediator among star-faring powers.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2_desc: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s return to the recovered Arkship has awakened the full breadth of her training. She now steps into the role she was meant to fill.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_revenant_desc: This leader carries the scars of a purged world. Swearing eternal vengeance, their presence drives allies to strike harder at those who would commit such atrocities.
single.leader_trait_nomadic_sage_desc: $NAME_nomadic_sage$ carries no burden of command, yet all who walk beside her find their own steps steadier. True wisdom clears a path for those who lead.
single.leader_trait_nuumismatic_priest_desc: A level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze...
single.leader_trait_obelisk_curse_desc: A servant of the black obelisk, this leader claims to seek to restore the balance we have disrupted.
single.leader_trait_obelisk_curse_tt: As long as this leader is a councilor, they will sacrifice one population to the black obelisk every year.
single.leader_trait_observant_desc: A set of self-built, powerful scanners allow this leader to see further and plan the journey ahead.
single.leader_trait_opinionated_desc: This leader keeps strong opinions on certain topics, making collaboration with other researchers difficult.
single.leader_trait_opportunity_custom_effect: Does not use Leader Capacity while under Level 4.
single.leader_trait_overseer_desc: This leader focuses on maintaining order and loyalty among vassal empires.
single.leader_trait_paladin_ace_desc: With snap decisions and reflexes, this Paladin is expert at threading the needle to strike at the heart of our enemies.
single.leader_trait_paladin_ambusher_desc: Patient and precise, this focused Paladin is expert at delivering the decisive strike.
single.leader_trait_paladin_defender_desc: This stalwart and unflinching Paladin trusts in the ship and the crew to stand firm against overwhelming odds, and is always ready to shield any ally in need.
single.leader_trait_paladin_desc: This leader bears the mantle of the Paladin. Through word and deed, they embody valor itself, champions of a free galaxy.
single.leader_trait_paladin_effect: This leader has no §YUpkeep§! and does not take up §YLeader Capacity§!
single.leader_trait_paladin_knight_desc: This Paladin has taken the oath of valor. Their peerless skill in battle is matched only by their unshakeable resolve.
single.leader_trait_paladin_logistician_desc: The quick mind and scientific training of this Paladin lets them solve logistic and maintenance questions, even in the heat of battle.
single.leader_trait_paladin_spearhead_desc: This brave Paladin does not shy away from fighting in the front line, coordinating allies to strike down even the most fearsome foe.
single.leader_trait_paladin_strategist_desc: Calm and collected, this calculating Paladin is expert at formulating plans that will bring out the best in their companions.
single.leader_trait_paladin_strategist_tt: Fleets in system:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Ship Fire Rate: §G+30%§!
single.leader_trait_paranoid_desc: This leader is unwilling to collaborate with others.
single.leader_trait_partially_digested_desc: This leader has had an unfortunate encounter with a giant worm from another dimension. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.
single.leader_trait_passive_desc: This leader has such a subdued personality, [Root.GetSheHe] is barely noticed.
single.leader_trait_peacekeeper_desc: This leader recognizes that to keep the peace one must cast a wide net. The best admirals are on the lookout for those dissidents, pirates, and petty criminals who aim to exploit our trade routes.
single.leader_trait_percussive_maintainer_desc: There is no such thing as a hardware problem that liberal use of the boot will not fix.
single.leader_trait_physics_focus_desc: This leader's keen mind is focused on advancing the field of physics. Our research related to particles and new computing mechanisms will bloom under their guidance.
single.leader_trait_pirate_queen_desc: Years of skulduggery and outlandish exploits have created a leader who never leaves with less than she came for.
single.leader_trait_plague_hardened_desc: Having gazed into the abyss, this commander possesses a keen and tempered mind.
single.leader_trait_planar_theorist_desc: This leader specializes in the study of Astral Rifts and the behavior of dimensions outside of our own.
single.leader_trait_plunderer_desc: There is no need for the wreckage of enemy ships go to waste. A resourceful admiral knows exactly how to turn scrap into value.
single.leader_trait_politician_desc: This leader has an affinity for politics, and is well-versed when it comes to fiery debates.
single.leader_trait_polluter_desc: This leader's blatant disregard for the environment worsens living conditions.
single.leader_trait_pop_focused_desc: This leader knows the value and importance of an experienced support staff.
single.leader_trait_preftl_haggler_desc: Coming from a [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] country, this leader has displayed an exceptionally keen mind for business.
single.leader_trait_principled_desc: This leader has a strict code and follows our empire's morals, setting a good example for others.
single.leader_trait_private_mines_desc: This leader owns and maintains private sources of minerals.
single.leader_trait_procrastinator_desc: This leader prefers to spend their time on non-essential tasks.
single.leader_trait_profligate_desc: This leader is reckless in the storage and acquisition of goods and supplies.
single.leader_trait_prospector_base_effect: $SCIENCE_SHIP_EFFECTS_TXT$:\n$t$On Completing Survey:\n$tt$ Chance to increase Resource Deposit Size:
single.leader_trait_prospector_desc: This leader has a set of self-built, powerful scanners, which can find even the deepest deposits when surveying galactic objects.
single.leader_trait_prospectorium_extractor_des: Energy, alloys, and minerals all empower our ambitions. Extractors maximize their acquisition.
single.leader_trait_prospectorium_optimizer_des: Keeping a populace healthy and productive requires resources, and optimizers are ideally suited to manage them.
single.leader_trait_prospectorium_refiner_desc: Refiners have the rarefied expertise necessary to improve our acquisition of exotic gases, motes, and crystals.
single.leader_trait_psionic_desc: This leader possesses powerful psionic abilities.
single.leader_trait_reckless_desc: This leader is reckless and disregards any safety procedures during combat, pushing ships to their limit.
single.leader_trait_reclusive_desc: This leader does not like to be at the center of attention. Or to be the recipient of any attention at all, for that matter.
single.leader_trait_refinement_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of refining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
single.leader_trait_reformer_desc: This leader is a reformer, dedicated towards building the society of tomorrow.
single.leader_trait_reinforcer_desc: This leader focuses on building emergency bomb shelters and reinforced bunkers in case of orbital bombardment.
single.leader_trait_resilient_desc: This leader is resilient and in excellent physical condition, increasing their life expectancy.
