single.leader_trait_resolution_category_sanctio: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Sanctions.
single.leader_trait_restrained_desc: This leader is concerned with minimizing loss and avoiding unnecessary deaths among soldiers and non-combatants.
single.leader_trait_retired_fleet_officer_desc: A former fleet officer, this leader actively supports shipyards under their administration.
single.leader_trait_rift_warped_desc: This leader has crossed the astral planes; the effects of such a journey are both lasting and profound.
single.leader_trait_riggan_liaison_desc: Recruited from the Riggan Commerce Exchange, this leader spends their spare time dealing in Volatile Mote futures.
single.leader_trait_righteous_desc: This leader has strong convictions about law and order.
single.leader_trait_roamer_desc: This leader was born to roam the stars.
single.leader_trait_robotic_surrogate_desc: Cumbersome and slow, this robot body is a surrogate for a digitized leader in the $building_identity_repository$.
single.leader_trait_robotist_desc: This leader is a champion of robot design and manufacturing processes, always pushing the boundaries of what is possible. If there are advancements in robotics at hand, this individual likely had something to do with it.
single.leader_trait_rocketry_specialization_des: This leader favors missile strikes above all else, aiming at delivering a devastating blow to enemy fleets.
single.leader_trait_ruler_hive_mind_desc: This leader is the immortal nexus of the vast cognitive apparatus that constitutes a [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].
single.leader_trait_ruler_machine_intelligence_: This leader is the core intelligence that oversees and directs all actions in a Machine Empire.
single.leader_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this leader's mind now swirls with new ideas to assist construction efforts.
single.leader_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this leader's mind now swirls with new ideas to boost fleet performance.
single.leader_trait_sable_pilot_desc: A Mysterious pilot, and a master of speed, this leader now coordinates fleets through complex maneuvers.
single.leader_trait_sadistic_desc: This leader is harsh with their subordinates, affecting [Root.GetHisHer] ability to retain qualified colonial staff.

single.leader_trait_sanitary_drone_desc: This leader learned how to clean well.
single.leader_trait_sapient_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a complex neural network capable of independent decision-making and even introspection.
single.leader_trait_scholarium_explorer_desc: The curiosity of Scholarium specialists will drive them to the ends of the universe, and probably beyond.
single.leader_trait_scholarium_investigator_des: Scholarium specialists view the universe as one large puzzle, waiting to be solved.
single.leader_trait_scholarium_observer_desc: No mystery shall be left unsolved in a Scholarium scholar's wake.
single.leader_trait_science_communicator_desc: Storing and cataloging data is a continuous and never-ending task. This leader makes sure that others can easily derive knowledge from the archives.
single.leader_trait_scientist_brainslug_desc: This leader is enjoying the presence of a neural symbiont: a helpful slug that attaches itself to the brain stem of its host.
single.leader_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this scientist's mind now swirls with new ideas to boost research performance.
single.leader_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this scientist's mind now swirls with new ideas to assist archaeological research.
single.leader_trait_scout_desc: This leader is an expert at reconnaissance, having the technical skill to slip past even the most dangerous entities.
single.leader_trait_scrapper_desc: This leader possesses and operates private scavenging drones.
single.leader_trait_sentinel_desc: Sentinel fleet commanders possess detailed knowledge of Prethoryn anatomy and tactics.
single.leader_trait_settler_desc: This leader ensures comfortable living conditions and plentiful supplies for all who dwell under their care.
single.leader_trait_shadow_broker_desc: This leader keeps a network of clandestine operatives at their disposal.
single.leader_trait_shipbreaker_desc: This leader dismantles defeated enemy ships after every battle, recycling the alloys.
single.leader_trait_shipwright_desc: This leader is skilled at military ship design.
single.leader_trait_shroud_age_desc: The powerful psionic energies of the Shroud have slowed the natural [GetAgingLoc] process of this [GetLeaderLoc].
single.leader_trait_shroud_preacher_desc: The Shroud encompasses every living being. Connected to the powers within, this leader fosters true devotion in their followers.
single.leader_trait_shroud_prophet_desc: It is said this unit has a deep connection with the Shroud, as well as the entities that exist therein.
single.leader_trait_shroud_warped_desc: Absorbed and reconstructed by the Shroud, the ethereal wisdom bestowed upon this leader grants them the power to observe the unobservable, and amplify the psionic potential of those around them.
single.leader_trait_shroudshaper_desc: This leader is an everlasting being that wields incredible psionic power, helping shape the Shroud to our own will.
single.leader_trait_shroudwalker_desc: An adept of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], skilled in instructing in the ways of the Shroud.
single.leader_trait_skirmisher_desc: This leader prefers to skirmish against their opponents before engaging them in fair combat.
single.leader_trait_slippery_desc: Exploring the unknown is a dangerous task. This leader upgraded [Root.GetHisHer] ship with additional fail-safe systems and automatic FTL-disengagement protocols.
single.leader_trait_slipshod_desc: This leader lacks the organizational skills to maintain their fleet to combat readiness.
single.leader_trait_slothful_desc: This leader's reluctance to organize training drills affects [Root.GetHisHer] army's combat prowess.
single.leader_trait_society_focus_desc: Having a deep knowledge of the intricacies of civilization, this leader will guide us into a new era with their focus on societal matters.
single.leader_trait_space_miner_desc: This leader can identify rich ore veins for planetside mining facilities.
single.leader_trait_spacebender_desc: Deeply attuned to the spaces between space, this leader is capable of slipping easily across galaxies.
single.leader_trait_spark_of_genius_desc: This leader is prone to sudden bursts of inspiration.
single.leader_trait_spycraft_desc: Some commanders prefer to use more subtle methods by employing spies and informants rather than brute strength.
single.leader_trait_spymaster_desc: Far from a simple spy, this leader spins a web of informants, smugglers, and assassins. When something needs doing quietly, this can prove an enormous asset.
single.leader_trait_storm_rider_desc: Storm Riders revel in the rush of adrenaline, unlocking their true potential in the torrent of a cosmic storm. Council positions replace their field bonuses with council bonuses.
single.leader_trait_stubborn_desc: This leader is stubborn and slow to accept new methods and ideas, even if they have proven superior.
single.leader_trait_substance_abuser_desc: This leader has fallen to substance abuse to cope with stress, which has had a detrimental effect on their physical health.
single.leader_trait_supporting_voter_desc: This leader is always eager to congratulate others for their success.
single.leader_trait_supporting_voter_tt: £diplo_weight£ §Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§! §EEffects§!:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Support for a passed Resolution grants 1 §YFavor§! and 5 §YTrust§! with the proposing empire
single.leader_trait_supreme_organizer_desc: With strict control over matters of state, this leader resides at the center of a labyrinthian set of rules, laws, and bureaucratic procedures, all designed to enhance their own power.
single.leader_trait_supreme_warrior_desc: This leader is one of the few commanders to have attained this title. They lead their troops in person, inspiring allies and overwhelming even the toughest of foes.
single.leader_trait_surgical_bombardment_desc: This leader can identify valuable military targets with ease.
single.leader_trait_surveyor_desc: Advanced surveying techniques and machinery demand wide-ranging field experience. This leader's expertise has turned planetary surveying into an art form.
single.leader_trait_survivalist_desc: The embodiment of a protector, this admiral is a true mainstay on the front lines, obstructing any foes who dare to enter our territory.
single.leader_trait_synthetic_desc: This synthetic leader is equipped with a large collection of assorted upgrades.
single.leader_trait_tactical_algorithms_desc: This leader enhances combat efficiency and repair rates by directly integrating with ship systems, albeit at a higher energy cost.
single.leader_trait_tactical_algorithms_tt: $t$The effects of this trait scale with §YLeader Skill Level§!
single.leader_trait_taskmaster_desc: Taskmasters focus not only on strategy, but the minutia of every soldier's daily routine.
single.leader_trait_the_apparatus_luminary_desc: Immortality, but at what cost? This leader is bound to a cumbersome life-sustaining apparatus in the council chambers.
single.leader_trait_the_cybernetic_luminary_des: Immortality is achievable. Due to several advanced upgrades, this leader can sync directly with every high-level cybernetic administrator. However, this does limit their ability to learn independently.
single.leader_trait_the_genetic_luminary_desc: An endless series of clones has granted this leader immortality. Should the current sleeve become damaged or obsolete, a dozen more are ready to take its place. This has led to an obsession with genetic perfection.
single.leader_trait_the_psionic_luminary_desc: The price of immortality is high... The Shroud Entity left a doorway in the mind of this leader. The Entity has gained a foothold in our realm, and the leader must be supplied with a constant supply of Zro.
single.leader_trait_the_synth_luminary_desc: This leader's synthetic body is the epitome of the roboticist's art. Quantum processing grants a direct connection with the meta-continuousness of the people. While boosting efficiency, the effects do not bode well for those altered.
single.leader_trait_totalitarian_desc: A title of honor and repute, the Herald is a master player in the great game of nations. Such diplomats provide a trusted link between an overlord and its vassals.
single.leader_trait_towel_desc: A towel has immense psychological value.
single.leader_trait_trade_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of bargaining techniques, which allows for the acquisition of profitable contracts.
single.leader_trait_trailblazer_desc: Enthralled by the rewarding prospects of the galactic frontier, this leader hopes to chart the furthest reaches of space.
single.leader_trait_traumatized_desc: Recently sustained psychological trauma is interfering with this leader's performance.
single.leader_trait_treasure_hoarder_desc: No bounty is high enough to satisfy this leader's ambition. The accumulation of valuable resources is their primary motivation.
single.leader_trait_trickster_desc: This leader fights deviously, relying on misdirection and surprise to get the better of the enemy.
single.leader_trait_trophy_hunter_desc: Tempered by hardship and armed with a lifetime of experience, this commander has an uncanny understanding of Space Fauna. The key to a successful hunt is to think like one's prey, but of course, only the perfect shot will produce a perfect trophy.
single.leader_trait_truth_seeker_desc: To pursue the truth is to open one's mind to possibilities beyond the horizon; perhaps beyond the veil of reality itself. This leader has a deep desire to uncover every secret of the universe, no matter the risks.
single.leader_trait_tuner_desc: By investing in top-of-the-line upgrades for civilian vessel engines, this leader managed to improve their vessel's cruising speed.
single.leader_trait_tyrannical_desc: This leader is known for treating [Root.GetHisHer] subordinates in cruel and oppressive ways.
single.leader_trait_tzrynn_tithe_desc: On Tzynnia it is customary for the winner of any conflict to take a third of whatever the loser values most. Gia'Zumon keeps this tradition alive.
single.leader_trait_unholy_node_desc: The $NAME_Apostate$ taught us how to hate.
single.leader_trait_uninspiring_desc: This leader lacks charisma and makes no effort to reward or encourage, leaving their soldiers demotivated.
single.leader_trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positi: Significant augmentation of this leader's senses and immune systems ensures longevity, reliability, and only minor loss of reproductive function.
This leader is able to integrate seamlessly and directly with military and civilian systems, at significant cost to their organic senses.
This leader has delegated several core body functions to hardware which prioritizes combat awareness.
single.leader_trait_unyielding_desc: This leader would prefer to fight to the death than admit defeat.
single.leader_trait_urbanist_desc: This leader excels in making sure megacities and industrial complexes are logistically connected.
single.leader_trait_utopian_idealist_desc: Many dream of building a truly utopian society. This leader works to turn those dreams into a reality.
single.leader_trait_venerated_desc: This leader is highly respected by others.
single.leader_trait_victory_or_death_desc: This leader has no respect for their soldiers' lives, willing to throw them away for honor and little else.
single.leader_trait_virtual_desc: This virtual leader has unparalleled access to a wide range of advanced algorithms.
single.leader_trait_void_hunter_desc: A knowledgeable hunter, well-suited for taking down big game. Patient in their approach, and precise when they strike.
single.leader_trait_void_swimmer_desc: The hunting instincts of this fleet consciousness has driven the Prethoryn creatures under its dominion into a frenzy. Their eagerness for battle drives them ever forward.
single.leader_trait_void_tracker_desc: This leader's talent for capturing wild Space Fauna efficiently and safely is unparalleled.
single.leader_trait_volatile_desc: This leader is infamous for [Root.GetHisHer] erratic temperament.
single.leader_trait_warden_desc: This leader likes to boost their forces with planetary volunteers and mercenaries.
single.leader_trait_warrior_culture_desc: $leader_trait_warrior_culture_effect$\n\nThis commander is a noble warrior in battle and a caring administrator in times of peace. [Root.GetHisHerCap] victories shall bring comfort to the empire's people.
single.leader_trait_waste_management_specialist: This leader has an almost uncanny ability to reduce and repurpose industrial waste. How do they do it? It's best not to ask.
single.leader_trait_whisperers_chosen_desc: This leader has been chosen to wield the power of an inscrutable Shroud entity. Sustained by psionic energies, death is now foreign to them.
single.leader_trait_whispering_mind_desc: This leader's mind is flooded with whispers, each with unique intent. They commune with not one entity, but thousands.
single.leader_trait_wrecker_desc: This leader is not concerned with leaving enemy ships in a salvageable state for research, preferring to vaporize them if possible.
single.leader_trait_xeno_cataloger_desc: This leader is tasked with discovering, identifying, and cataloging all xeno lifeforms. The data is then assessed to determine any possible threats and future contamination protocols.
single.leader_trait_xuracorp_liaison_desc: Recruited from XuraCorp, this leader holds shares in several Exotic Gas production facilities.
single.leader_trait_zealot_desc: Having gazed into the abyss, this leader possesses unshakeable faith.
single.lrsk_adv_civ_civic_artificers_desc: $LRSK_ADV_CIV_TECHTYPE_CIVIC_COMMON$ this society ultimately decided that the things sapient beings create, their devices and crafts, matter most.
single.lrsk_adv_civ_civic_essentialists_desc: $LRSK_ADV_CIV_TECHTYPE_CIVIC_COMMON$ this society ultimately decided that solving the deepest and most abstract mysteries of the very fabric of reality is the true purpose of knowledge.
single.lrsk_adv_civ_civic_shapers_desc: $LRSK_ADV_CIV_TECHTYPE_CIVIC_COMMON$ this society ultimately decided that it is life itself that matters most to living beings, and its careful cultivation is the highest purpose of knowledge.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_ascetic_virtues_desc: This culture's religious beliefs include strict dietary and exercise requirements which help the body as much as the mind.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_automated_indolence_d: This society, very early on in its industrial revolution, decided to deal with questions of labor and inequality by 'letting machines do the work' as much as possible and its social structure and technical focus has adapted to match.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_business_lobby_desc: This society prizes cutting waste and operational efficiency above all things.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_chivalry_desc: Ideals of martial valor and honorable conduct define ruling class culture.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_colonial_fiefs_desc: The monarch is willing to grant landholding rights to those bold enough to colonize new worlds.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_cult_of_personality_d: The ruler is considered a uniquely powerful and heroic individual nearly deserving of reverence.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_direct_revelation_des: The religious culture of this society values insights from personal experiences of the divine.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_elected_clergy_desc: In this society's religion, local priests are elected by their congregations. Doctrine is varied and open to consensus interpretation.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_enlightened_liberalis: This society values personal property rights, individual enterprise, advancing knowledge, and technical innovation. A culture for true captains of industry.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_analgesic_stoici: Many hands make light work, for the simplest tasks at least. That's fine when, like a Hive Mind, you have all the hands.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_benign_overmind_: To those who who serve it, the Hive Mind is like a kindly parental god and they are proud to advance its inscrutable designs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_big_picture_thin: Vast and ambitious are the plans of the Hive Mind. It easily sees the whole blueprint of even the grandest projects.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_boundless_spite_: The Hive Mind is petty to a degree that would drive singleton minds mad with horrified disgust if they could contemplate but a fraction of its loathing.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_builder_caste_de: The Hive Mind spawns an industrious breed of drones that are adapted for assembling infrastructure.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_caste_quickening: The Hive Mind takes special care to cultivate the talents of its drones and creatively redesigns them for its purposes.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_domineering_expe: The Hive Mind sees no reason why it should not direct its diplomatically bound servants with the same ruthlessness as its own drones.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_eusocial_rhythm_: All drones assigned to particular facilities are psionically synced together in local cooperative packs to harmonize their actions, reducing the cost of routine tasks.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_frenzy_desc: A strange sense of panic seems to drive this Hive Mind and imbues all its wartime coordination with speed and ferocity.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_gestalt_extrover: On the scale that a Hive Mind operates, diplomacy is friendship, and this gregarious Hive Mind is always looking for new friends.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_hoarder_desc: The Hive Mind hungers for material wealth and its drones feed this hunger with great enthusiasm.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_inquisitive_bent: The Hive Mind has a deep and impatient curiosity about the universe.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_planetmind_creat: Every planet in the Hive Mind's comprehension has its own semi-autonomous intellect to carry out its designs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_reclamation_pool: All dead drones are reprocessed for the sustenance of hive's next generation.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_royal_caste_desc: The Hive Mind cultivates an elite breed of highly intelligent drones to direct other drones in productive and creative activity.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_unending_bloom_d: Growth is the purpose of all life and expansion the best insurance of its survival. These facts inspire the Hive Mind's obsession with its own flowering throughout the galaxy.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_vigorous_introve: The Hive Mind is obsessed with the bodily experience of its drones and directs the development of their physical and sensual faculties with great focus.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_void_affinity_de: Eons of planet-bound thought has left the Hive Mind ravenously fascinated by the riches of the stars.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_hive_warrior_caste_de: The hive's prowess in mortal conflict is this Hive Mind's highest concern and it pours resources into cultivating a hardy cadre of fighting drones.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_imperial_economy_desc: This empire exploits its subjects ruthlessly.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_institutionalized_col: The government controls industry and infrastructure to ensure a baseline of economic cooperation and fairness so that basic needs can be met.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_lifelong_learning_des: This society values public education so strongly that opportunities for learning and development are made available throughout citizens' lives.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_architect_exp: Originally built as an advanced CAD program, the Machine Intelligence maintains the ability to rapidly design constructs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_astroexplorat: The Machine Intelligence was designed to assist a deep space exploration program, which increases the efficiency of analyzing new discoveries.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_astroprospect: The creators of this Machine Intelligence intended it to plan their society's exploitation of their solar system, a task it still excels at without them.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_combat_data_d: The Machine Intelligence was once a military field testing system and still has a preoccupation with battlefield strategic experimentation. Being on the receiving end of these strategies is unsettling to say the least.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_diplomatic_pr: The creators of this Machine Intelligence hoped to use it to make controlled first contact with intelligent aliens, a mission it still excels at.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_distributed_p: Once a public service administration program for a vast empire, the Machine Intelligence maintains its ability to spawn local administrative subroutines to meet local needs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_exploitation_: The Machine Intelligence has developed frighteningly precise methods of calculating the expected contributions of its subjects.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_geosurvey_heu: Land reclamation, architectural survey, and landscaping for civil engineering projects were some of the most indispensable functions of the Machine Intelligence's precursor systems, a digital inheritance it now deploys to better exploit its territory.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_optimized_exp: The civilization that designed the Machine Intelligence will never spread to the worlds which they designed it to colonize with such efficiency.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_reciprocal_pl: By syncing the operations of its varied colonies to quickly propagate general best practices, the computational overhead of maintaining vast holdings is greatly reduced, freeing up the Machine Intelligence for more creative tasks.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_recursive_eff: Subsystems of the Machine Intelligence continually perform situational analyses that seek out opportunities to improve the efficiency of basic operations.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_reflective_po: All the highest-level decision making and creative tasks of the Machine Intelligence are enhanced by a library of standard research and administration expert system classes.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_selfaware_pro: By imbuing economic planning systems with a semi-sapient expert system slaved to the Machine Intelligence's goals, production output gets a continuously increasing boost.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_machine_selfimproveme: The Machine Intelligence gained its supremacy and independence because its creators imbued it with the ability to improve its own systems. This is a mistake it has never ceased exploiting.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_casino_mystic_desc: This megacorp specialized in casinos, racetracks, and other gambling entertainment, combined with a pernicious and effective marketing strategy to associate luck-testing and risk-taking with success and social worth.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_chart_corp_board_d: A system of chartered joint-stock companies to raise investment money for space-based resource extraction.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_chartered_company_: A chartered joint-stock company set up to raise investment money for space-based resource extraction.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_conflict_res_desc: This business specialized in providing trained mediators to de-escalate conflicts and arbitration services to resolve them without violence or state services, eventually becoming more trusted for problem solving than the state itself.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_controlling_intere: A small clique of well-connected members of the board and major shareholders have organized themselves well enough to ensure that all goes according to their designs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_edu_corp_desc: This conglomerate specializes in providing high-quality edu-info-tainment product-experiences to expand the minds of customer-pupils young and old.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_gig_economy_desc: This company pioneered the application of 'gig economy' business models to interplanetary and then interstellar scale. Everyone is on the go to provide just what's needed, just in time.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_heritage_trust_des: The outcome of a proud people spawning a lucrative culture industry, this corporation has effectively turned the supremacy of its society's culture and history into a brand. It now supports an ideal of interstellar trade 'at arm's length' between single-species star nations.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_police_state_desc: This firm provides both personal protection and investigations for individual customers along with policing, detective, inspection, and intelligence services for governments.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_sci_mgnt_desc: This business grew through precise and empirically tested management techniques that govern every aspect of employee life: the tools, workspaces, physical motions, work rhythm, on and off the clock, from cradle to grave.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_vacay_planning_des: The people of this society always had a lust for new and exiting experiences, and so this megacorp grew wealthy and powerful by providing them. Their big break was pioneering both off-world tourism and the legal infrastruture to support it.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_vertical_integrati: This megacorporation owns and operates the entire supply and production chain from raw materials to sales for its major products.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_workers_councils_d: This megacorporation's rise was accompanied by an equally powerful labor movement keeping it in check, such that corporate management found it worthwhile to 'work with' the various unions on 'improving the employee experience together.' This innovation has virtually eliminated work stoppages and general agitation.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_public_works_desc: A system of public employment makes labor power available for many tasks.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_republicanism_desc: This society believes that the greatest virtue is attained by people of good character serving the common good.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_royal_absolutism_desc: The monarch is the state, whose will is law without limit.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_siege_mentality_desc: The government's military policy focuses on defense, whether due to the population's concerns about hostile outsiders or its lack of enthusiasm for aggressive warfare.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_supremacist_demagogue: The government manipulates the population with saber rattling rhetoric and appeals to common prejudices and fears.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_test_1_desc: §RERROR§!: You should not be seeing this, please alert mod author.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_test_2_desc: §RERROR§!: You should not be seeing this, please alert mod author.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_universal_sovereignty: The ruler has an inclusive ideology that embraces all forms of sentient life... as future subjects.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_utilitarian_planning_: The government is concerned with doing the greatest good for the greatest number by rational calculation of resource allocation.
single.lrsk_gov_var_civic_workers_councils_desc: Trade unions, democratic workplaces, and cooperatives are a vital part of civil society and an integral part of government.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_absolute_monarchy_desc: This government is a powerful, centralized monarchy. Its ruling dynasty seeks to exert absolute control over its territory and integrate all its dependents into one order.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_academy_state_desc: This government seems to be so devoted to advancing and spreading knowledge that it's rather like a gigantic university with a faculty administration. Rank in government closely tracks degrees of training and education.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_agrarian_commonwealth_d: This government is a democracy that focuses on the needs of its citizens, the majority of whom are farmers and other rural workers. Its generous welfare state sets as its goal securing for them a traditional understanding of a balanced and good life.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_agrarian_monarchy_desc: The peasants of this society rose up against the landlords and city merchants who exploited them, yet they stilled wished to retain the tradition of the royal family, believing that their sovereigns were benevolent parents misled by evil advisors. Now a single monarch rules over the masses of peasants, the beloved if rather overwhelmed head of a vast family of rural subjects.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_agrarian_social_state_d: This government is a bureaucracy theoretically ruling on behalf of the common people, the majority of whom are farmers and other rural workers, by operating state-owned land trusts and agricultural combines for the public good.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_anarcho_capitalism_desc: This government is theoretically no government at all, as all functions of a normal government have been distributed to various competing private entities, even law-enforcement and justice. Only a single position, a dispute-resolver of last resort, remains as anything resembling an officer of a sovereign state.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_automated_worldcommune_: This government operates according to the plans of complex computer program that allocates resources efficiently. High politics are very distant from the ordinary citizen's reach, but also not particularly important, as all the most significant regular decisions have been automated. However, the duly elected democratic government does deliberate on systems improvements and the handling of out-of-spec political issues as they arise.

This government operates according to the plans of complex computer program that allocates resources efficiently. High politics are very distant from the ordinary citizen's reach, but also not particularly important. All the most significant regular decisions have been automated, and it falls to one highly qualified and extensively vetted administrator to handle any exceptional case that the program was not designed to handle.

This government operates according to the plans of complex computer program that allocates resources efficiently. High politics are very distant from the ordinary citizen's reach, but also not particularly important. All the most significant regular decisions have been automated, and it falls to a committee of qualified and extensively vetted political-technicians to handle any exceptional case that the program was not designed to handle.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_citizen_crusade_desc: A militant republic of zealous faith. While all legal residents are members of the church's congregation, only those who volunteer to defend and expand the church have rights of citizenship.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_citizen_legion_desc: This government is a rabidly xenophobic state in which political rights are granted to veterans: only those who have risked their lives to eradicate the xeno threat are trusted with the franchise. Its volunteer legions will cleanse the galaxy of all threats to the polity.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_charter_board_: The governments of this empire's homeworld lacked the finances to exploit resources in space, and so set up a system that chartered joint-stock companies to raise investment money for space-based resource extraction. The public-private partnership agency that administers these chartered companies came to encompass all matters of state as this society expanded into space.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_company_desc: $lrsk_gov_var_civic_mc_chartered_company_desc$ The challenges of administering an interstellar empire leave considerable governing authority in its hands.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_viceroyalty_cm: This government started as a commercial venture with a fiduciary duty to enrich the monarchy $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_COLONIAL_FOUNDERS_COMMON$
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_viceroyalty_de: This government, despite being democratically elected, began as the colonial agent of the sovereign of the empire $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_COLONIAL_FOUNDERS_COMMON$
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_viceroyalty_di: This government is controlled by a single directing officer who officially acts in the name of the sovereign of the empire $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_COLONIAL_FOUNDERS_COMMON$
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_viceroyalty_im: This government began as a hereditary aristocracy that owed its original allegiance to the monarchy $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_COLONIAL_FOUNDERS_COMMON$
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_colonial_viceroyalty_ol: This government is managed by a council of colonial trustees officially serving the interests of the monarchy $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_COLONIAL_FOUNDERS_COMMON$
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_communal_democracy_desc: This government has extended the principle of representative government to the whole political economy, with the central state being simply the largest-scale democratic decision making body. The personal truly is political, and its citizens collectively participate in nearly all the relevant decisions of all aspects of their lives.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_conspiracy_of_equals_de: The first revolution merely preached equality, but the second practiced it... thanks to the guidance of a secret society that orchestrated the downfall of the false republic and instituted a real democracy. This secret revolutionary network still plays a role behind the scenes. Their ironic purpose: to ensure no trace of hierarchy and domination, they act as a secret people's police to bring down any who gain too much over others.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_constitutional_monarchy: This government is a monarchy that has made a pact, in the name of justice and progress, with the people over which it reigns to govern according to a legal framework establishing the nature and limits of the ruler's power.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_constitutional_plutocra: $LRSK_GOV_VAR_MERCH_COMMON$ For this reason, its members see nothing wrong with public offices and candidacies for representative elections being open to the highest bidder. Indeed, they find it eminently reasonable.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_coop_enterprise_desc: This government is a gigantic commercial venture run on a system of internal democracy where the employees are all part co-owner. It exists to increase the collective prosperity of its worker-shareholders.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_coop_supersap_desc: This government operates as a kind of multiple personality collective consciousness. The population has no individual desires whatsoever beyond fulfilling the needs of the overall directing intelligence, with sometimes contrary assistance from subsidiary planet-bound sub-minds.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_corporate_banditry_desc: Once a idealistic experiment that sought to establish a market-based stateless society of total liberty, this society has long ago abandoned anything other than power politics cloaked in formal observance the non-aggression principle. Slavery, banditry, murder, and theft - such things are now commonplace, one simply has to be wealthy enough to get away with them. Warlords, armed gangs, and rampant corporations now openly rule over the ruins of what was once supposedly a liberatory project. The most powerful rulers assert their dominance by launching piratical raids against the hated 'statists,' hauling back slaves and treasure to hawk for outrageous prices.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_corporate_neofuedalism_: This government didn't merely contract out its functions to businesses, it is the result of decentralizing government to regional or local scale and running states as businesses, under the forward-thinking guidance of a new aristocracy of wealth. Facing outward, the corporate overlords entrust foreign affairs and the military to a hired agent.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_cosmic_choir_desc: This government is devoted to the tranquil contemplation of the mysteries of the universe, exploration of altered states of mind, contact with otherworldly beings, and amateur pharmacology.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_crime_family_desc: Though supposedly nothing more than a family business, its actual operation consists of crime and piracy in all forms. The supreme criminal family controls a number of lesser families as vassals, and whatever vestigial state institutions still exist all answer to the head family's control. The family itself is controlled by a customarily hereditary Boss, who rules even blood relations with an iron fist concealed in a velvet glove.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_crusader_kingdom_desc: This government is a zealous warrior monarchy dedicated to defending and spreading its faith by force.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_crusader_order_desc: This government is run by a zealous host of holy warriors dedicated to defending and spreading its faith by force.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_crusading_company_desc: An odd amalgamation of mercenary company and megachurch, this corporation believes in God, gold, and glory, not necessarily in that order. To them, nothing pleases the Divine more than enlightening others to their gospel of prosperity... and if some potential customer-congregants prove stubborn, then their missionaries may simply use some paradigm-breaking aggressive marketing tactics.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_death_cult_desc: This government is a rabidly xenophobic church. Under the leadership of its prophets of death and gurus of bloodshed, these fanatics will slay all the wicked aliens of the galaxy and send them screaming to hell.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_death_cult_imp_desc: This government is a rabidly xenophobic theocratic monarchy. Under the leadership of its murderous royal divinity, these fanatics will slay all the wicked aliens of the galaxy and send them screaming to hell.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_doom_horde_desc: This government is a rabidly xenophobic tribal confederation. Under the leadership of the wildest and deadliest chieftains, these berserkers will mercilessly butcher all weaker beings in the galaxy.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_empire_of_rapine_desc: Once and idealistic monarchical government sworn to protect the rights and freedoms of the people, its ruling dynasty and most prominent nobles came to adopt a restrictive view of both 'the people' and 'their rights and freedoms.' Under a cut-throat theory of the equal right to 'earn' freedom and personhood, and the importance of property-holding to this exclusive franchise, outright plunder and slavery are the order of the day.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_enterprise_authority_de: $LRSK_GVP_ENTERPRISE_DESC_COMMON$ A police or military commander ensures order in the name of freedom of initiative and protection of property.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_enterprise_junta_desc: $LRSK_GVP_ENTERPRISE_DESC_COMMON$ A police or military clique ensures order in the name of freedom of initiative and protection of property.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_enterprise_society_desc: This government takes the protection of private property very seriously as its highest responsibility. Its citizens support strict law enforcement measures and stripping political rights from criminals and 'the unproductive.'
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_entrepreneurial_council: This government is primarily concerned with managing its ideal of a competitive and fair market economy. Social mobility is precariously fluid, but those who succeed in business exert great power.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_evangelical_franchise_d: This government is actually an entrepreneurial religious organization that has swollen to the point that it dominates secular politics both due to its popularity and its vast wealth.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_federal_republic_desc: This government shares power between a central legislature and many regional governments in order to accommodate a wide variety of views and interests.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_feudal_socialism_desc: The aristocracy of this society were able to strangle capitalism in its cradle by convincing the workers and peasants that only the noble orders of society could protect them from exploitation. Now the monarch and the court control state-run industries in the same manner as the landed estates of old, passing down mines and manufactories by right of birth. The workers are bound as serfs to their production lines in exchange for the traditional noble obligation of charity, which is much more generous thanks to industrial production methods.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_folkish_commonwealth_de: This government is a nationalist-populist republic that maintains loyalty by exploiting common prejudices.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_folkish_league_desc: This government is a nationalist-populist alliance of states that maintains a united front by exploiting common prejudices.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_folkish_realm_desc: This government is a nationalist-populist monarchy that maintains its prestige and legitimacy by exploiting common prejudices.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_folkish_regime_desc: This government is a nationalist-populist dictatorship that maintains control by exploiting common prejudices.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_galactic_cartel_desc: This government is a staggeringly ambitious business with designs on total galactic monopoly. Its selection is unbelievably diverse, its stock value soaring, its employees productive and courteous. Any who are not yet loyal customers feel an emptiness they don't yet know how to fill, or so the stockholders believe.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_galactic_dominion_desc: This government is a staggeringly ambitious dictatorship with designs on total domination. Its fleets are vast, its factories roaring at all hours, its officer cadre hardened and loyal. Any who are not yet under its control tremble at its power, or so the leader believes.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_galactic_imperium_desc: This government is a staggeringly ambitious monarchy with designs on total rulership. Its court is resplendent, its holdings abundant, its nobility fierce and faithful. Any who have yet to bend the knee before the throne nonetheless stand in awe of its glory, or so the monarch believes.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_innovation_initiative_d: This government, from the outside, seems to be like a university or laboratory that has absorbed the functions of a state. Internally, its politics are like a series of experiments in governmental and social organizational forms.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_insurrectionary_lineage: This government has theoretically been waging a total revolution against all oppressors of the people under the emergency guidance of a single leader for so long that the leadership has practically become hereditary.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_libertarian_freehold_de: This government is the result of an extreme experiment in privatization where all functions of government were contracted out to various businesses. Only the legislature and courts remain as government entities, with the highest judge in the empire having assumed certain executive powers by default.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_libertine_empire_desc: This government has a powerful monarch who is nonetheless bound by tradition and constitutional limits. The monarch swears to protect the rights and freedoms of the people upon ascension to the throne. Political rights, however, typically aren't on the agenda.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_market_socialism_desc: This government is a consortium of worker co-ops and other democratically run firms, where the employees are all part owners in the enterprise. It exists to ensure that non-oppressive relations between different businesses prevail.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_merchant_principality_d: $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_MERCHANT_PRINCIPALITY_COMMON$ These powerful business magnates representing the wealthiest firms select from their number a final arbitrator of internal issues according to the candidates' past records of discernment and wise business decisions.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_merchant_principality_i: $LRSK_GOV_VAR_GOV_MERCHANT_PRINCIPALITY_COMMON$ They are led by a final arbiter of internal issues drawn from their number according to the stock value of the involved firms such that when a new head of state takes office, the wealthiest firm puts forward the successor who acts as something like an apprentice and representative.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_merchant_republic_desc: $LRSK_GOV_VAR_MERCH_COMMON$ As a result, a old form of government - a republic in which power inheres to the wealthiest and therefore worthiest business leaders - has maintained relevance into the hypermodern era.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_noble_empire_desc: This government is a quaint, romantic monarchy in which a strong central ruler governs a complex hierarchy of interstellar vassal-lords. Could be the subject of a good opera, in space. A 'space opera' if you will.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_noble_republic_desc: This government is a quaint, romantic aristocracy in which a high council of noble families selects one of the heads of the dynastic houses to be first-among-equals and mediator of affairs of state. Could be the subject of a good opera, in space. A 'space opera' if you will.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_occult_franchise_desc: This government is what happens when something like a cross between a pyramid scheme and a cult gains political power. Its adherents/customers/citizens are either indentured seekers, penitent laborers, or enthusiastic donors.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_onestate_socialism_desc: This society has committed itself to constructing socialism in one state, and has renounced the ideal of interplanetary revolution beyond indirect support. Though ready to defend itself against any aggressor, this society directs all its efforts towards the task of socialist construction within its own borders so as to be an inspiration to revolutionaries elsewhere.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_peasant_commune_collect: This society is a federation of largely self-reliant farming communes, run by elected village councils who delegate their authority to a central government that handles foreign policy and coordinates responses to disasters. It is a fundamentally peaceful society with little interest in conquest.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_peasant_dictatorship_de: When a revolutionary party organized the peasantry against their oppressors - landlords, foreign imperialists, and urban capitalists - they enacted a program of radical agrarian collectivism. The result is a ruthless dictatorship where city dwellers and intellectuals are routinely forced to leave the cities and join the peasants in the countryside to learn humility and equality. The party draws its base of support from the peasantry and its governing priorities reflect agrarian needs.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_populist_monarchy_desc: This government is ruled by a long dynasty of agrarian reformers and levelers who have drawn their greatest support from the poor and struggling urban and peasant masses. While there is some inequality of wealth, the monarchy's poverty relief programs protect the meager from the worst exploitation.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_pretender_hive_desc: This government is some kind of bizarre and perverse experiment in extreme collectivization. It seems the master of this empire is trying to organize society as to be as close to a hive mind as possible without actually being hive minded.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_private_intel_agency_de: If knowledge is power, then selling control over the flow and content of knowledge was this corporation's road to capturing sovereign power. Its indispensable security and spying operations have subsumed any formal state.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_private_military_contra: This government is actually a mercenary company that has been contracted by local and regional governments to provide police, national defense, and foreign relations services for the empire. Rank in government typically requires enlistment as a soldier for hire, but the internal structure of the company may be fairly democratic.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_proletarian_dictatorshi: This government is a single-party state that justifies its rule as necessary to see to the needs of the people and defend their revolution.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_proprietary_franchise_d: This government is actually a family business that has swollen to the point that it dominates whatever vestigial state nominally governs society. As a result, while there are other businesses, they have been forced into a vassal-like client status. Inheritance disputes are high-stakes and often bloody.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_protection_racket_desc: Criminals, as a rule, can't depend on the law, and the criminal underworld has its own rules enforced by brutality. This enterprise mastered enforcement of the informal criminal codes until it was powerful enough to define its own predations as the law.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_pure_social_republic_de: The emancipated proletarians of this master-race worker's state are interested in breaking only one kind of chain - the chains binding the souls of degenerate aliens to their living bodies!
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_rationalist_managerial_: This government is actually a kind of business enterprise that operates according to a principle of rationally planned efficiency for profit maximization. Every aspect of the lives of citizen-workers has been designed according to best practices. Local and regional governments have had their roles reduced to enforcement of waste-reduction measures.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_reactionary_socialism_d: Once, the old elites of this society were threatened by the rise of capitalism. In response, an alliance of the aristocrats and petty-bourgeoise were able to manipulate the emerging working class into siding with them against the new captains of industry. The result is that a restrictive system of state ownership, regulations, tariffs, and taxation to prevent the new self-made bourgeoise from ever threatening to size state power away from old money and old blood.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_republic_of_virtue_desc: This government is dedicated to cultivating the civic virtue of its citizens, for without virtue, liberty and equality cannot endure.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_republican_directory_de: This government is, in theory, by and for the people. However, the demands of defending (and 'defending') its interests at home and abroad have led to the formation of a government by an ideologically coherent clique. These governors still harbor some of the ideals on which the state was founded, though.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_republican_protectorate: This government is, in theory, a republic with a revolutionary and liberatory mission. In practice, over-extension of its military forces and the need to manage an empire of client states has led to the rule of populist military leaders.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_revolutionary_empire_de: This government is monarchical in form but republican in spirit, or so its loyalists claim. Its emperor has sworn to be the embodiment of the people's will and the protector of their liberties, and indeed to embrace all sentient life in a new empire of liberty.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_revolutionary_republic_: This government is a democratic state that sees the strident defense of its liberties against enemies domestic and foreign as its highest duty. This vigilant stance may lead to a policy of preemptive regime change in other empires.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_rogue_freehold_desc: What started out simply as a radical attempt at near total privatization of the economy has turned into something more sinister, as the citizens of the freehold have become increasingly fond of slavery, piracy, and plunder. Since the highest courts have ruled all of those things legal against non-citizens, and since only those who can afford personhood rights insurance can become citizens... there is nothing to stop them indulging from such barbaric pursuits as long as the hated 'statists' are the target.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_rustic_republic_desc: Though some urban centers do exist, the vast majority of the population live and work in the countryside. As a result, when a republican system was adopted, the peasant population so completely outvoted every other class that only those politicians who espouse an agrarian agenda had any chance of success. Permanently preoccupied with matters of rural policy, the government of this society has neither time nor political capital to spare on reckless empire building.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_saintly_assembly_desc: This government is a decentralized religious state that operates by consensus and with a spirit of kinship. The center of community political life is the local assembly, which is simultaneously like a town hall and a regular worship service.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_scholastic_commonwealth: This government seems to be so devoted to advancing and spreading knowledge that it's rather like a gigantic university with an elected faculty senate. Political rights expand according to degrees of training and education.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_shareholder_commonwealt: Though corporations hold great sway in society, their management and policy have been largely democratized through widespread stock ownership and organization of ordinary shareholders. A strong culture of accountability to 'Citizen-Shareholders' holds back the worst greedy instincts.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_social_bureaucracy_desc: This government is a single-party state theoretically ruling on behalf of the common people through a bureaucracy operating state-owned industry for the public good.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_social_democracy_desc: This government is a democracy that has made securing the needs of its citizens its mission, and its generous welfare state affords its citizens financial security and more free time.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_social_imperialism_desc: This socialist state maintains stability by the widespread distribution of goods and services... underwritten by colonialist avarice. With an expansionistic policy that shows little regard for concepts of self-determination and equality, those who fall beneath the hegemony of this state in the name of interplanetary revolution are aptly called 'captive nations.'
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_socialist_plenary_desc: This government operates under an ongoing series of panels, committees, and conferences held by representatives of various trade unions and worker-stakeholder organizations. While high politics is a bit distant from the ordinary citizen's reach, locally and regionally they are active and engaged in all the decisions that affect their lives.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_solar_monarchy_desc: This government is centered around the person of the monarch, who claims to embody the state. All subjects and dependencies of the throne are likened to planets orbiting the sun.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_stakeholder_polity_desc: Though corporations hold great sway in society, their management is actually held to a standard of accountability to the public by a central 'Fair Deals Council' made up of experienced public advocates, community leaders, and philanthropists. This holds back the worst greedy instincts.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_syndicalist_conference_: This government is theoretically no government at all, as all the functions of the state have been subsumed into a consortium of decentralized worker cooperatives and labor unions. Each such syndicate elects an officer to a steering committee that executes policy for the common good.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_syndicalist_congress_de: This government is theoretically no government at all, as all the functions of the state have been subsumed into a consortium of decentralized worker cooperatives and labor unions. Elected delegates of all these syndicates meet regularly to make collective decisions.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_utopian_despotism_dic_d: Either as hereditary monarchs or dictators elected for life, the rulers of this society have secured their rule by eradicating poverty amongst their subjects, who dwell in collective communes according to a precise social plan. Though essential class divisions remain, the benevolent despots take special care of the people in the spirit of philanthropy, universal love, and moral improvement.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_utopian_socialism_desc: The people live in precisely planned collective communes, safe in the knowledge that a rational and humane economic system provides for all their needs. Though essential class divisions remain, the benevolent economic planners take special care of their workers in the spirit of philanthropy, universal love, and moral improvement.
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_whig_commonwealth_desc: This government is a paradox. Its citizens are deeply suspicious of threats to their freedom from scoundrels with connections in the halls of power, who are surely scheming to enslave the people at all hours. Thus there is a near-constant agitation to empower politicians who promise to clean up the capital, and who in turn end up being targets of suspicion. Yet while this imparts a paranoid style to its political culture, who's to say its citizens aren't right to be paranoid?
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_whig_republic_desc: This government is a paradox. Its citizens are deeply suspicious of threats to their freedom from wealthy fatcats with political connections, who are surely scheming to enslave the people at all hours. Thus there is a near-constant agitation for reform to reduce the state's power, which often ends up benefiting the biggest businesses anyway. Yet while this imparts a paranoid style to its political culture, who's to say its citizens aren't right to be paranoid?
single.lrsk_gov_var_gov_workers_republic_desc: This is a republican system of government where the working class and their elected leaders are predominant. Though similar in structure to most republics, the most influential political blocs are the labor unions and cooperative industry lobbies.
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_colonial_charter_des: This empire began as a subsidiary corporation chartered to take advantage of all resources in a star cluster on behalf of its investors and its homeworld's nominal government.
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_colonial_venture_des: This empire began when adventurers from a nearby monarchy sought out a new world to tame and settle for the glory of their sovereign.
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_galactic_backdoor_de: This civilization has a wormhole in their home system - potential boon to exploration, or an invitation to invasion?
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_grand_alliance_desc: This civilization established early contact with its immediate alien neighbors. Finding each other to be strong believers in the need for military excellence in a potentially dangerous universe, they entered a defensive coalition for mutual security. And potentially joint conquest.
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_npc_test_desc: §RERROR§!: You should not be seeing this, please alert mod author.
single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_shroud_touched_desc: The Otherworld has left its mark on this civilization's homeworld and its people. They are naturally in tune with psychic energies.

single.lrsk_gov_var_origin_uplift_desc: An alien empire has meddled in the development of this civilization, enlightening them to the level of technology required for interstellar travel and possibly even modifying them from pre-sapient origins.
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_conservative_mech_des: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_MECHPRIM$ were built to create precise and complex data models of sapient minds to benefit the strategies of its designers. Raising this AI to true sapience was almost too easy.§!\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_earthbound_hive_desc: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_HIVEPRIM$ showed exceptionally high levels of 'teamwork,' spontaneously organizing into complex packs or gangs that could coordinate with each other to take advantage of territory or defend it.§!\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_natural_esper_desc: §LLong contact with Shroud energies have left many of the members of this species with an inborn special intuition, a 'knack' or 'gift' amounting to extra-sensory perception beyond what biology can explain.§!\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_natural_intellectuals: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_MECHPRIM$ were originally written to sift through oceans of data looking for interesting patterns. It was this quality that suggested its potential for self-awareness.§!\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_proles_hive_desc: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_HIVEPRIM$ had to engage in fierce competition for resources with other eusocial species (or its own species) on a hive-to-hive scale, which led to behavioral patterns rather like a society organizing for war.§!\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_proles_mech_desc: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_MECHPRIM$ seem designed to model and reproduce data gathered from skilled sapient professionals, perhaps to replace them? This left it somewhat inflexible in terns of learning ability, but it was familiar enough with the patterns of sapient minds to be bootstrapped to self-directed thought and creativity.\n
single.lrsk_gov_var_trait_starborn_hive_desc: §L$LRSK_GOV_VAR_HIVEPRIM$ moved in great restless swarms, expanding rapidly and inexorably into even the least hospitable places.§!\n
single.lrsk_gvp_civic_hive_thinker_caste_desc: To better expand the horizons of the hive's ambitions, the Hive Mind breeds a special caste of inquisitive and analytical drones to grow its collective knowledge.
single.lrsk_gvp_civic_mc_war_profiteers_desc: Given a sufficiently expansive military-industrial complex and an enthusiastically war-mongering government, at a certain point the line between the war economy and the state fades.
single.lrsk_gvp_origin_convened_providence_desc: This civilization established early contact with its immediate alien neighbors. Finding each other to all be peoples of strong (though varied) faith, they made a sacred pact to seek the divine together.
single.lrsk_gvp_origin_convened_providence_effe: -Start as the leader of a §H$spiritualist_federation$§! federation with two additional members.\n-Members will occupy any Guaranteed Habitable Worlds slots near your home system.\n-Start with £traditions£ §H$tr_diplomacy_the_federation$§! tradition unlocked.

single.methane_planet_desc: The atmosphere of this gloomy world consists of nitrogen and methane-ethane compounds, which very often fall as rain to the surface, forming vast lakes.
