single.origin_alderson_desc: You are the remnant of a long forgotten civilization, living in the vast expanse of an $name_alderson$ built by unknown precursors. The other slices harbor intelligent life, but they have not returned to the stars.
single.origin_alderson_effects:
Start on a $pc_alderson_slice_gaia_shattered$, a ruined part of a colossal $name_alderson$.
- Species habitability is set to §L$pc_alderson_slice_gaia$§!.
- §RThere will be no systems with guaranteed habitable worlds nearby§!.
- Two powerful Pre-FTL nations will spawn alongside you on other sections of the Alderson.
single.origin_arc_welders_desc: Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.\n\nThe galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.
single.origin_awakened_desc: Facing extinction, the last bastions of this once great empire chose to seal themselves within grand stasis chambers and wait for a safer era to resurface. Eons have passed, and the stars of our former empire are once again empty and ready to be reconquered.
single.origin_birch_desc: This civilization's world view was shattered when a massive asteroid impact punctured a hole in their sky. Realizing that their world is a vast and ancient megastructure, they have turned inward in search of a way to save their decaying home.
single.origin_birch_effects:
- Start with a §H$pc_origin_birch$§! in the §HGalactic Core§! as your homeworld.
- The §HGalactic Core§! starts open to the galaxy.
- Start with the §H"$giga_situation_birch_origin$"§! Situation.
- Gain access to unique §H$district_giga_origin_birch_lab_plural$§! on your homeworld, which can be upgraded through §HExploration§!.
- Unlock powerful modifiers for your homeworld through §HExploration§!.
- The §H$pc_origin_birch$§! can be repaired, unlocking special §H$pc_birch$§! £district£ §HInsula§! and §HSector§! Districts.
- Habitability Preference set to §H$trait_pc_birch_preference$§!, making settlement on most planets much harder.
- A nearby planet may hold the key to further colonization.

§RMultiple people cannot use this Origin. Any empires with this origin after the first will be generate with $origin_default$ instead.§!
single.origin_clone_army_desc: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.
single.origin_common_ground_desc: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.
single.origin_cosmic_dawn_desc: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.
single.origin_cybernetic_creed_desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_cybernetic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.
single.origin_default_desc: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.
single.origin_default_nomads_desc: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.
single.origin_default_pre_ftl_desc: This civilization has yet to become spacefaring, however with a little encouragement or a great deal of time they may yet become an actor on the galactic stage.
single.origin_demonic_incursion_desc: Lead by a corrupted champion, this empire emerged from a dimensional portal and has vowed to lay waste to this reality.
single.origin_derelict_evolution_desc: Millions of years ago, a highly developed race of space travelers left their automata on the surface of the blooming planet. Civilization disappeared, and self-replicating machines continued to fulfill the tasks of their creators. Subsequently, competition for resource sources arose between different groups of automata. The command centers were constantly improving themselves in deadly combat with each other. On a planet completely purged of organic life, only the most powerful machine intelligence remained, which had already directed its gaze to the stars.
single.origin_doomsday_desc: §RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!\nThis civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.
single.origin_eawaf_sirens_splinter_desc: This nation was founded by survivors who were once enthralled by the Sirens.
single.origin_elysium_desc: This civilization believes that the best way to rule the masses is from a safe vantage point.
single.origin_elysium_effects:
- Start with your capital on an §H$name_orb_elysium$§! orbiting your homeworld, and the technology to build more
- Newly settled colonies immediately start construction of an $name_orb_elysium$ if they are able to support one
- Colonies which are able to support an $name_orb_elysium$ but are lacking §Rsuffer penalties§!
- Unable to decommission $name_orb_elysium$ stations
- £job_giga_elysium_controller£ $job_giga_elysium_controller$ Jobs also improve resource output
- Greatly reduced £alloys£ $alloys$ upkeep for $name_orb_elysium$ capital buildings
- Needs fewer pops to upgrade capital buildings on worlds with an $name_orb_elysium$

§PNote: Planets with an $name_orb_elysium$ work very differently to normal worlds, getting most of their jobs from their planetary designation. This origin significantly changes normal play.§!
single.origin_endbringers_desc: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.
single.origin_enlightened_desc: The natural development of this civilization was greatly accelerated by the interference of another party, who helped them become a spacefaring culture.
single.origin_equatorial_shipyard_desc: Having evolved on a ring around the scorching heat of a molten world, dwindling water and food supplies have forced this species to leave their home system.
single.origin_equatorial_shipyard_effects: Start on an Equatorial Shipyard around a molten world.\n- Gain access to £society_research£ §L$tech_hydroponics$§! technology if not a machine species.
single.origin_evolutionary_predators_desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].§!\n\nThis species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.
single.origin_expanse_desc: Rapidly running out of resources and significant overpopulation, pushed this civilization to enter space very early, without FTL technology. The period of colonization of the most promising uninhabited worlds in the system, ended in a deep civilizational crisis. At the moment when the disagreement, caused by complex social problems, between the homeworld and the colonies reached a peak, the hyperdrive was invented.
single.origin_fallen_empire_desc: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.
single.origin_fear_of_the_dark_desc: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so great that a newly-terraformed planet was granted to the fearmongers.
single.origin_flat_world_desc: For hundreds of years, your people argued about the geometrical properties of your homeworld. Having photographic evidence was not enough for people who believed that the earth was spherical and the evidences were fabricated. The truth only became clear when your civilization achieved civilian stellar flight.
single.origin_flat_world_effects: Homeworld is a §Y$pc_flat_world$§!\nHabitability preference is set to §Y$trait_pc_continental_preference$§!
single.origin_forever_cruise_desc: $cannot_settle$\nThe Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.
single.origin_forever_cruise_effects:
- Nomadic Origin
- Start with Situation: ['concept_situation_passenger_satisfaction']
- Start with a §HCrew§! and a §HPassenger§! species
- Unique £district£ Arkship District: ['district:district_ark_forever_cruise']
- Unique Job: ['concept_job_cruise_crew_overseer']
- Available £zone£ Arkship District Specializations:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- ['concept_forever_cruise_district_specializations']
- Available Buildings:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- ['concept_forever_cruise_buildings']
single.origin_forsaken_desc: Several centuries ago, space civilization expelled unwanted fellow tribesmen from their empire. They were thrown onto a desolate and lifeless planet to die a horrible death of hunger and hardship. Many died, but the planet turned out to be an abandoned mining colony and the survivors managed to find shelter in underground shelters. Forged by the harsh conditions in their new homeworld, they were able to found their own civilization.
single.origin_frameworld_desc: This highly centralized civilization inhabits a sprawling orbital station complex constructed by their forebears in the distant past. Expanding it further could bring them great benefits, but losing it would destroy them utterly.
single.origin_fruitful_desc: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.
single.origin_gas_giant_desc: During this empire's early space age their homeworld was struck by a stray comet. Already possessed enough infrastructure in space to survive temporarily, a gas giant mining station became their new home. Over the years the gas giant has fulfilled their needs many times over, bringing new insights into the various gases that occur in the galaxy. Due to an abundance of exotic gases during this empire's development, improved industrial techniques using these gases have been refined, albeit with a reliance on these gases for even the most basic industry.
single.origin_gas_giant_robot_desc: During this empire's early space age their homeworld was struck by a stray comet. Already possessed enough infrastructure in space to survive temporarily, a gas giant mining station became their new home. Over the years the gas giant has fulfilled their needs many times over, bringing new insights into the various gases that occur in the galaxy. Due to an abundance of exotic gases during this empire's development, improved industrial techniques using these gases have been refined, albeit with a reliance on these gases for even the most basic industry.
single.origin_great_ring_desc: When this star collapsed into a black hole, it destroyed the inner ringworld and the precursor civilization that built it. The outer ring, however, survived without much damage and, eventually, new life emerged on it, warmed up by the pale light of the black hole's accretion disk.
single.origin_hegemon_desc: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.
single.origin_hegemon_npc_desc: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they were subordinated to one of those neighbors, who masterminded the birth of an interstellar union with them as its leader.
single.origin_heirs_of_the_khan_desc: $cannot_settle$\nOnce the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.
single.origin_here_be_dragons_desc: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the stars remains to be seen.
single.origin_hke_desc: This civilization is the result of a myriad of splinters states attempting to reform the Katzenartig Imperium.
single.origin_imperial_vassal_desc: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.
single.origin_imperial_vassal_overlord_desc: An ambitious overlord who has spent considerable time and efforts in subduing their closest neighbors to serve their every need. They are slowly growing more indolent as they devolve more and more responsibility to their vassals.
single.origin_incohesive_desc: This civilisation developed entirely on an isolated world, in a space far away from space.
single.origin_incohesive_effect_desc:
- Start within the §LWormhole-Cohesive Cluster§!, alongside a neighbouring Black Hole system with a ruined §LEHOF Alpha§!.
- Also granted some progress into EHOF technology, which will allow you to restore the EHOF early.

§RSLOW START DUE TO LACK OF NEIGHBOURING PLANETS OR DEPOSITS. NOT BALANCED FOR MULTIPLAYER.§!
single.origin_interstellar_ring_desc: No one knows who had build this ringworld, slowly drifting in the dark void between the stars, but a young civilization is calling this place home. And now they are ready to enter the greater galaxy.
single.origin_katzen_civil_war_desc: This nation has emerged following the collapse of the centralized Katzenartig Imperium. They claim to be the legitimate successor to the Katzen state, and wish to reunify the former Katzen lands under their rule.
single.origin_katzen_rebels_desc: This nation has rebelled from the §YKatzenartig Imperium§!, in an attempt to end the §YKaiser§!'s rule over their people.
single.origin_katzen_splinter_desc: This nation was originally part of the greater §YKatzenartig Imperium§!, and seceded upon the Imperium's catastrophic collapse following the fall of §YFlusion§!.
single.origin_khan_successor_desc: This civilization arose out of the ashes of the Great Khan's mighty empire.
single.origin_legendary_leader_death_desc: Amidst political turmoil, and without the Luminary's guidance, the people must make their own way in the galaxy.
single.origin_legendary_leader_desc: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.
single.origin_legendary_leader_no_gov_change: Can't change Authority with Under One Rule Origin
single.origin_liberated_desc: This civilization came into being after being liberated from another empire.
single.origin_life_seeded_desc: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.
single.origin_lithoid_desc: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.
single.origin_lost_colony_desc: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.
single.origin_machine_desc: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.
single.origin_mechanists_desc: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.
single.origin_mindwardens_desc:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.
single.origin_necrophage_desc: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.
single.origin_nomad_tooltip_default_effects: - Nomadic Origin\n- Start with an additional §HLogistic Ship§!\n
single.origin_nomadic_purger_desc: A temporary nomadic government overseeing worlds as they are purged of planetbound life.
single.origin_nomadic_settled_desc: This empire was founded by the settlement of the population of an Arkship onto a new world.
single.origin_nomadic_subject_desc: The remains of a nomadic civilization, left to roam the stars while ruled from a new world.
single.origin_overtuned_desc: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.
single.origin_pangalactic_desc: This empire is the result of an incredible galactic effort to stop an empire from unleashing a hyperweapon.
single.origin_penrose_ring_desc: This civilization inhabits a §H$ringworld_uppercase$§! around a now ruined §H$penrose_sphere_2$§! built countless millennia ago. Whether the $penrose_sphere_2$ at the systems center failed on its own or was destroyed by outside assailants is a fact long since lost to this civilisation, they return to the stars nonetheless.
single.origin_penrose_ring_effects: - $HOMEWORLD$ ['concept_pc_shattered_ring']$NEW_LINE$- $HOME_SYSTEM$ ['concept_giga_relic_penrose_sphere']$NEW_LINE$- ['concept_guaranteed_colonies']: Replaced with Colonizable Ring World Segments that have £blocker£ §RBlockers§! decreasing £mod_pop_environment_tolerance£ Habitability $NEW_LINE$- $SPECIES_TRAITS$ ['concept_ring_preference']
single.origin_planetary_computer_desc: With most of its data lost, the robotic species originally created to take care of this planet-scale computer is now on its own.
single.origin_planetary_computer_effects: Start on a Planetary Computing Complex.
single.origin_post_apocalyptic_desc: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.
single.origin_post_apocalyptic_machines_desc: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.
single.origin_primal_calling_desc: The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...\n\nThis civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.
single.origin_primitive_player_atomic_age_desc: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an Atomic Age. They have harnessed the power of the atom, but not yet made it into space. Nuclear weapons may be prolific, and could result in a sudden extinction event.

single.origin_primitive_player_early_space_age_: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$\nThis civilization has entered an Early Space Age. Primitive satellites are orbiting their homeworld, and the first manned space missions have been concluded in low orbit. They will soon be ready to leave their world.

single.origin_primitive_player_industrial_age_d: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an early Industrial Age. Electricity and internal combustion engines are gradually coming into widespread use, while urbanization increases at a rapid pace.

single.origin_primitive_player_machine_age_desc: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of a Machine Age, considered a later part of the Industrial Age. Their factories are mass-producing goods and vehicles, and air travel is becoming commonplace.
single.origin_primitive_player_machine_age_nega:
Guarantees atleast one ['concept_advanced_empires', Advanced AI Empire]

-Space Age
single.origin_primitive_player_pre_industrial_a: This civilization resides in a pre-industrial era, it will be a long while until they reach into the stars.

Guarantees atleast one ['concept_advanced_empires', Advanced AI Empire]

single.origin_progenitor_hive_desc: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.
single.origin_red_giant_desc: This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.\n\nCan they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?
single.origin_remnants_desc: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.
single.origin_riftworld_desc: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.
single.origin_sacred_path_desc: $cannot_settle$\nThese nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?
single.origin_sacred_path_effects: - Nomadic Origin\n- Unique Arkship District: ['concept_zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims']\n- Unique Jobs: ['concept_job_sacred_path_elite'], ['concept_job_sacred_path_specialist'], ['concept_job_sacred_path_civilian']
single.origin_scion_desc: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.
single.origin_sentient_planet_desc: In the vast expanses of the great cosmos, a thinking crystalline structure has formed in the bowels of a lifeless rocky planet. For millions of years she grew, forming an extensive neural network, until she regained consciousness. The offspring of this crystalline structure together form a single collective superintelligence. This Supermind seeks to grow and develop, expanding itself to new and new worlds.
single.origin_separatists_desc: This civilization came into being when it rebelled and seceded from another empire.
single.origin_shattered_ring_desc: This civilization inhabits a §HRing World§! built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.
single.origin_shoulders_of_giants_desc: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.
single.origin_shroud_forged_desc: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the $auth_machine_intelligence$, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.
single.origin_shroudwalker_apprentice_desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nLong before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.
single.origin_slavers_desc: From the moment the Board of Directors at $NAME_MSI_country$ first delivered our civilization to the stars, we have understood that the galaxy was too beautiful not to be shared. Since then, we have worked tirelessly to help less developed civilizations achieve FTL travel.\n\nEnlightenment may not be free. But at $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, it is always worth the cost.
single.origin_squareworld_desc: This species evolved on a segment of a physics-defying Square Ringworld. The other segments have decayed into complete uninhabitability, so the denizens of the final life-supporting segment have decided to go out on their own to try to fix what's left of the rest of their home.
single.origin_star_slingshot_desc: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) §H$quantum_catapult_1$§!.
single.origin_starlit_citadel_desc: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the §H$dsc_name$§!.
single.origin_storm_chasers_desc: There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.\n\nAt its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.
single.origin_subterranean_machines_desc: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versatile and unwavering community of machines.
single.origin_syncretic_evolution_desc: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.
single.origin_synthetic_fertility_desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_synthetic_ascension'].§!\n\nOnce a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

single.origin_toxic_knights_desc: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created to search for the Toxic God, and although many things have changed, the quest continues.

single.origin_treasure_hunters_desc: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.
single.origin_tree_of_life_desc: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.
single.origin_twilight_ones_desc: The civilization of this wonderful world has adapted to live between light and darkness, heat and cold. They literally lead a life on the edge.
single.origin_unplugged_desc: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$\nAbruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.
single.origin_void_dwellers_desc: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.
single.origin_void_machines_desc: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbital habitats scattered throughout their home system.
single.origin_wilderness_desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_purity_ascension'].§!\n\nThis entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.
single.paluush_trait_grandbunny_desc: The Grandbunny is an immensely powerful Paluush psyker, who watches over Paluushia and protects it from external threats.
single.pc_a_star_desc: These relatively young white or bluish-white main-sequence stars are typically among the most visible to the naked eye. They are large and rotate very quickly, but will eventually evolve into slower and cooler red giants.
single.pc_a_super_star_desc: These very young and incredibly hot stars belong to the type of blue supergiants that are at a relatively transient stage of the evolution of the star, so they are rare. As a rule, a massive star ends its existence with a supernova explosion, but some continue to evolve and eventually turn into white dwarfs.
single.pc_ae_star_desc: Herbig Stars are young stars of the spectral classes A and B, which have not yet entered the main sequence. They have a mass exceeding solar mass from 2 to 8 times and are usually surrounded by a protoplanetary disc. The protoplanetary or near-star disk dissipates over the course of roughly 10 million years, partially falling into the star, partly forming planets due to accretion and partially being blown outward by stellar winds. The temperature in the core of these stars is not yet sufficient to maintain a thermonuclear reaction, which will ignite about 100 million years after the formation of the star. The main source of their energy is gravitational compression. These young systems are like a boiling cauldron, in which ships and stations are subject to heavy wear and tear from constant meteoric bombardement.
single.pc_ai_desc: Rocky world covered with artificial structures. The thin atmosphere consists mostly of industrial pollutants. There are strong energy emissions coming from across the entire surface, but no organic life signs.
single.pc_alderson_slice_gaia_desc: A gargantuan slice of an $name_alderson$ stretching across an entire solar system, capable of supporting a truly gigantic population and the industry to match it.
single.pc_alderson_slice_gaia_shattered_desc: A dysfunctional, colossal segment of an $name_alderson$.
single.pc_alpine_desc: Mountainous world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Snow covers the mountaintops, and frozen-over lakes dot the valleys. While the planet experiences minimal seasonal variations, the still-liquid water beneath the frozen surface of the lakes is enough to sustain some hardy vegetation.
single.pc_arctic_desc: Frigid, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The poles are big, and significant water deposits can be found permanently frozen as glacial ice. However, the planet experiences seasonal variations and the equatorial band is covered by vegetation.
single.pc_arid_desc: Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.
single.pc_ark_desc: Our world became our ship and our ship became our world.
single.pc_asteroid_desc: A larger asteroid or planetoid standing out in the dense cluster of smaller bodies.
single.pc_astral_scar_desc: This is an anomalous fold in space and time. Strange material leaks from its edges, but we cannot penetrate any further.
single.pc_b_star_desc: The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.
single.pc_b_super_star_desc: These very young and incredibly hot stars belong to the type of blue supergiants that are at a relatively transient stage of the evolution of the star, so they are rare. As a rule, a massive star ends its existence with a supernova explosion, but some continue to evolve and eventually turn into white dwarfs.
single.pc_barren_cold_desc: Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.
single.pc_barren_desc: Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.
single.pc_birch_desc: Comprising hundreds of concentric layers arranged around a supermassive black hole, the $pc_birch$ is the largest conceivable example of a Shell World - an artificial structure with multiple solid shells around a gravity source. With trillions of planets worth of usable land, it can support an effectively unlimited population.
single.pc_black_hole_desc: Typically formed as a result of the collapse of a very massive star at the end of its life cycle, black holes have extremely strong gravity fields that prevent anything - including light - from escaping once the event horizon has been crossed. The gravitational waves emitted by black holes interfere with FTL drives, making it harder for ships to escape from combat.
single.pc_broken_desc: World devastated by some catastrophic event. Whatever properties it may once have had are no longer discernible.
single.pc_bulk_matter_cache_desc: A large cache of planetary matter and gasses stored in comparatively thin containers near the outskirts of a system.
single.pc_c_giant_star_desc: These giant stars are also called carbon stars. They are a type of red giant, with an atmosphere containing more carbon than oxygen.
single.pc_city_desc: World completely engulfed by urban-industrial sprawl. Its natural lithosphere is no longer discernible from orbit.
single.pc_collapsar_desc: Collapsar is a general term, which is usually referring to cosmic objects arising from the gravitational collapse of massive bodies. Usually this happens during a supernova explosion. When the star ends its evolution in a catastrophic explosive process, it flares up, releasing a huge amount of energy and leaving a nebula behind. Later the remains can become condensed and turn into a neutron star or a black hole. Gravitational and electromagnetic waves emitted by a dying star interfere with the operation of engines and make it difficult for ships to disengage from battle.
single.pc_continental_desc: Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Active and stable hydrosphere. Great landmasses are separated by oceans, with large climate variations depending on latitude and precipitation.
single.pc_core_black_hole_desc: Supermassive Black Holes are usually found in galactic cores, and their mass ranges from a few million stellar masses to over a billion. This black hole is currently inactive, and lacks an accretion disk, which would allow for wonderful engineering projects to be undertaken in its vicinity.
single.pc_core_mined_desc: The molten inner core of a completely stripmined planet, floating silently through the coldness of space. While some minerals remain, nearly everything valuable was extracted thanks to advanced fracking techniques.
single.pc_core_quasar_desc: Supermassive Quasars are found in galactic cores, and often weigh over several hundred million solar masses. They are incredibly energetic, spin very rapidly, and are surrounded by a colossal accretion disk. Such a body would yield tremendous amounts of energy, if it could somehow be contained.
single.pc_cosmogenesis_world_desc: A colossal reservoir computing system designed to connect billions of sentient beings, organic or synthetic, via an intricate array of cables, transistors, and life support pods. The intensive strain on individual processing organs will inevitably lead to brain damage for any networked 'component.'
single.pc_crystal_asteroid_desc: A large asteroid covered in some kind of crystalline outcroppings.
single.pc_d_star_desc: These are evolved stars of low luminosity, usually referred to as white dwarfs. They are compact stars with large masses at incredibly small sizes, which results in a very high density.
single.pc_desert_desc: Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Precipitation and major bodies of surface water are relatively rare. Significant temperature variations between day and night cycles. Vegetation is scarce, but even moderate precipitation can make the desert bloom.
single.pc_disco_moon_desc: This entire moon is covered with expertly polished crystals which refract light and create marvellous auroras in the skies of nearby planets.
single.pc_egg_cracked_desc: The cracked shards of an enormous planet-sized egg.
single.pc_ehof_cplanet_desc: This colossal sphere is composed of highly energized Sentient Metal.
single.pc_ehof_habitat_desc: A large habitat composed of multiple asteroids, built by a lost and now extinct civilization. What happened to its builders is unknown.
single.pc_ehof_planet_desc: A gigantic orb of Dark Matter. The $ehof_the_compound_text$ uses these to bolster their fleets.
single.pc_equatorial_shipyard_desc: The inner part of an $name_eq_shipyard$, this ringworld specializes in extracting rare minerals from the Molten World's crust and refining them directly into alloys. Living conditions are however quite harsh.
single.pc_f_star_desc: F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarfs. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.
single.pc_f_super_star_desc: Among the most massive stars, these stars belong to the type of yellow supergiants. Those are considered a transition stage between blue and red supergiants, which can however last for a long time. A supernova explosion is extremely rare at this stage of the stars evolution.
single.pc_flat_world_desc: A peculiar artificial flat planet. Gravity is provided by cleverly-concealed graviton generators. The horizon stretches all the way to the planet's borders, making for some incredible views.
single.pc_flusion_gaia_ecu_desc: The Flusio-Arcology makes full usage of Flusion's vast natural resources. The cities of Katown, Bundengrad and Teho have been transformed into gargantuan gigacities spanning large portions of the planet and capable of housing dozens of billions of inhabitants each. The rest of the planet has been altered to ecological perfection and now harbors a variety of climates fit for every single species native to Flusion.
single.pc_food_giant_desc: A massive sheet of organic material stretches across a large portion of this planet's upper atmosphere. Winds and storms are controlled by the structure surrounding the planet, allowing massive amounts of genetically engineered plant life to grow and thrive in this planet's atmosphere, ready for harvesting.
single.pc_frozen_desc: Rocky world covered in a thick layer of permanently frozen ice. Low temperatures and a very thin atmosphere preclude the existence of life on the surface.
single.pc_fu_star_desc: FUor or FU Orionis star is a rare type of nonstationary stars of the F - G spectral class, which are at an early stage of stellar evolution. These are large stars with very strong luminosity and frequent flashes due to the constant accretion of mass from the protoplanetary disk.
single.pc_g_giant_star_desc: This type of star has a much larger radius and higher luminosity than those of main-sequence stars, albeit sharing the same surface temperature. During the process of their evolution, they can turn into both supergiants and white dwarfs
single.pc_g_star_desc: Often referred to as yellow dwarfs, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.
single.pc_g_super_star_desc: Among the most massive stars, these stars belong to the type of yellow supergiants. Those are considered a transition stage between blue and red supergiants, which can however last for a long time. A supernova explosion is extremely rare at this stage of the stars evolution.
single.pc_gaia_desc: An ideal, temperate world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and a resilient ecosystem. Optimal conditions for all known higher forms of life at different latitudes.
single.pc_gas_giant_desc: Gaseous planet with an atmosphere primarily composed of hydrogen and helium surrounding a dense core.
single.pc_giga_edge_of_eternity_desc: A planet covered with oceans kilometers deep. Global storms rage across the surface, and incredibly tall waves are a common sight. This planet's environment would be too tumultuous to allow colonization, if not for an ancient arcology complex located near the planet's southern pole.
single.pc_giga_elysium_desc: An idyllic orbital habitat designed to exert a controlling influence over the world below.
single.pc_giga_empty_space_desc: Utterly empty space devoid of any significant concentration of matter.
single.pc_giga_frameworld_desc: A sprawling complex of interconnected space stations clustered around a large central core.
single.pc_giga_frameworld_outpost_artificial_de: A habitable structure, currently watched over by a large space station. Expeditionary groups from the station regularly visit the surface, conducting surveys and undertaking light resource extraction.\n\nNo active permanent settlements can be found on the surface.
single.pc_giga_frameworld_outpost_planet_desc: A habitable world, currently watched over by a large space station. Expeditionary groups from the station regularly visit the surface, conducting surveys and undertaking light resource extraction.\n\nNo active permanent settlements can be found on the surface.
single.pc_giga_maginot_gas_giant_desc: A vast gas giant-spanning stronghold that seeks to be utterly unassailable for any enemy force.
single.pc_giga_maginot_ringworld_desc: An immense stronghold band encircling the system's sun that seeks to be utterly unassailable for any enemy force.
single.pc_giga_maginot_world_desc: A vast planet-spanning stronghold that seeks to be utterly unassailable for any enemy force.
single.pc_giga_o_star_desc: O-type stars are spectacularly bright and just as incredibly rare. These stellar behemoths represent the heaviest and hottest category of main-sequence stars, only living for a few million years before perishing in a brutal supernova. Due to their immense luminosity, planetary systems around this type of star are always sterile. Additionally, these stars' extremely intense solar winds are incredibly harmful to both lifeforms, robots and starships alike.
single.pc_giga_orbital_desc: A large ring-shaped habitat orbiting a star. It has an artificial biosphere and an atmosphere, and can house billions of inhabitants in comfortable, planet-like conditions.
single.pc_giga_orbital_site_desc: This otherwise empty site has been singled out for the construction of a $name_giga_orbital$.
single.pc_giga_planetary_computer_desc: A planet-sized computer. The entirety of its crust and mantle has been replaced with layers upon layers of gigantic processors. Pops living on its surface can perform researcher jobs with unseen efficiency and speed. Cannot run Crysis.
single.pc_giga_siegfried_world_desc: A fortress world of Katzen design, the Siegfried World is designed to be a major roadblock to any hostile empire attempting to reach the heart of the Katzenartig Imperium. These mighty fortifications are rigged to completely detonate if ever seized by enemy forces and as such are only staffed by the most nationalistic and dedicated of Katzens.
single.pc_gigabrown_dwarf_desc: A celestial body that failed to achieve nuclear fusion, halfway between a gas giant and a star. It possesses a very powerful magnetic field and an extensive moon system. This type of brown dwarf is closer to igniting than Class T ones.
single.pc_gigaignited_star_desc: This star used to be a Brown Dwarf, but extremely advanced technologies have triggered fusion reactions within its core and ignited it.
single.pc_gigaorbital_ring_desc: A large ring-shaped habitat orbiting near a planet. It has an artificial biosphere and an atmosphere, and can house billions of inhabitants in comfortable, planet-like conditions.
single.pc_gigaorbital_ring_ruined_desc: This $pc_gigaorbital_ring$ has been completely ruined by some cataclysm. It might be possible to repair it given the right technologies.
single.pc_habitable_gas_giant_desc: A gas giant whose atmosphere has been somewhat stabilized. Harsh winds are still very frequent, and the climate is very hazardous. It can house floating cities in its upper atmosphere.
single.pc_habitat_desc: An artificial deep-space arcology offering planet-like - if decidedly urban - living conditions. Hydroponics and advanced filtering technologies make it near-self-sustaining, and station-borne facilities can mine the station's host planet for raw materials.
single.pc_habitat_shielded_desc: This Habitat station is encased in some kind of impenetrable energy barrier. It blocks all scans of its interior.
single.pc_hive_desc: This entire world is a giant living organism, psionically connected with the Hive Mind that shaped it. Any beings not part of the Hive that set foot here will be attacked by the very terrain itself.
single.pc_hollow_desc:
This unusual world may seem lifeless, but deep under its surface there are huge habitable cavities with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere.

§RNot possible to terraform.§!

§RNot possible to bombard.§!
single.pc_hot_giant_desc: This gas giant is too close to its star, causing its surface to heat up to monstrous temperatures and its atmosphere to gradually evaporate. In the future, this gas giant may become a loose planet.
single.pc_ice_asteroid_desc: A larger asteroid or planetoid composed primarily of frozen H2O.
single.pc_infested_desc: The surface of this world is covered by some kind of biological contaminant.
single.pc_interstellar_habitat_desc: A vast space station built in interstellar space. It doesn't rely on a star to get its energy, and is fully self-sustaining, thanks to a massive singularity reactor. Houses billions of inhabitants. The view is kinda depressing, though.
single.pc_interstellar_ringworld_habitable_desc: A ringworld habitat built in interstellar space, around a central singularity reactor. Its surface is extremely urban and lit by massive amounts of artificial light.
single.pc_interstellar_shrouded_ringworld_habit: A ringworld habitat built in interstellar space, around a central singularity reactor. Its surface which was once a sprawling urban landscape, has been rendered nothing but an unending sea of insanity by the powers of the Shroud.
single.pc_junk_desc: A large body of magnetized space junk composed of scrap metal, satellite remnants, and recaptured megastructure parts.
single.pc_k_giant_star_desc: This type of star has a much larger radius and higher luminosity than those of main-sequence stars, albeit sharing the same surface temperature. During the process of their evolution, they can turn into both supergiants and white dwarfs
single.pc_k_star_desc: These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarfs, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.
single.pc_k_super_star_desc: These large stars belong to the type of red supergiants who left the main sequence when carbon and oxygen combustion began in their core and the gas envelope grew to enormous sizes, spreading over millions of kilometers. These stars end their lives exploding with a supernova, and the gas shell of the star gives rise to a new nebula.
single.pc_katzenland_desc: A very hot, dry and desert-like world, that underwent extreme atomic bombardment. The planet is practically lifeless, aside from microbes and small extremophile plants. Out of once vast oceans, only small lakes of irradiated water remain. The atmosphere still contains significant amounts of industrial pollutants and radioactive compounds.
single.pc_l_star_desc: These cold stars are of the brown dwarf type, which are on the verge of being able to maintain a hydrogen thermonuclear reaction in the core. Their temperature is low enough that metals could exist in the atmosphere.
single.pc_lbv_blue_star_desc: These very bright blue pulsating hypergiants are also sometimes called S Doradus stars. As a rule, they are associated with diffuse nebulae and are surrounded by expanding shells. They are extremely rare. Constant electromagnetic and thermal emissions of an unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems and damage the hull of ships, making them more vulnerable in combat.
single.pc_lbv_green_star_desc: These very bright blue pulsating hypergiants are also sometimes called S Doradus stars. As a rule, they are associated with diffuse nebulae and are surrounded by expanding shells. They are extremely rare. Constant electromagnetic and thermal emissions of an unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems and damage the hull of ships, making them more vulnerable in combat.
single.pc_lbv_red_star_desc: These very bright blue pulsating hypergiants are also sometimes called S Doradus stars. As a rule, they are associated with diffuse nebulae and are surrounded by expanding shells. They are extremely rare. Constant electromagnetic and thermal emissions of an unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems and damage the hull of ships, making them more vulnerable in combat.
single.pc_ll_foggy_desc: A temperate, habitable world with a dense atmosphere. A thick cloud layer covers the surface at all times, and the air feels soupy. Fog covers large portions of the planet's surface. No advanced lifeforms are present on this planet.
single.pc_ll_temperate_desc: This planet is habitable, but lacks any forms of life, either because it used to be a barren wasteland that was made habitable, or because life was forcefully removed from it.
single.pc_ll_torrid_desc: This world is habitable, but shows no signs of life. It is quite hot and dry, and residual ash particles are relatively common within the atmosphere. The soil is mostly made out of dark volcanic rocks. Geological activity is also quite high, with a higher number of volcanoes and other violent geological features than average.
single.pc_m_hyper_star_desc: These incredibly huge and bright stars, whose mass far exceeds the mass of any star or even supergiant, live very short and are therefore extremely rare. The life expectancy of some hypergiants is only a few hundred thousand years, after which they immediately collapse into a black hole. The strong thermal radiation of such a giant star is detrimental to the outer hull casing of ships and stations, effectively reducing their protective properties significantly.
single.pc_m_star_desc: The most common stars in the universe, often referred to as red dwarfs. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.
single.pc_m_super_star_desc: These large stars belong to the type of red supergiants who left the main sequence when carbon and oxygen combustion began in their core and the gas envelope grew to enormous sizes, spreading over millions of kilometers. These stars end their lives exploding with a supernova, and the gas shell of the star gives rise to a new nebula.
single.pc_machine_desc: Rocky world covered with artificial structures. The thin atmosphere consists mostly of industrial pollutants and is not capable of supporting biological life.
single.pc_magnetar_desc: Magnetars are neutron stars with an extremely strong magnetic field and an extremely high density. They may have a higher gravitation than a some black holes. Magnetars are capable of emitting such strong flashes of gamma and X-ray radiation, that they can damage electronic equipment located billions of kilometers from the star. The average life span of a magnetar is about 1 million years. Because of the strong magnetic field, movement around the magnetar is difficult, and the radiation emitted, disrupts the operation of reflectors, rendering the shields of ships and stations useless.
single.pc_melted_frozen_desc: A planet covered with oceans kilometers deep. Global storms rage across the surface, and incredibly tall waves are a common sight. This planet's environment is too tumultuous to allow colonization.
single.pc_metallic_hydrogen_desc: A massive ball of metallic hydrogen. Its upper atmosphere has been artificially stripped away, exposing the planet's exotic hydrogen mantle.
single.pc_microquasar_1_desc: Microquasar is a smaller version of the quasar, which is a double star system, in which the remnant of the first star, compressed into a black hole of enormous mass, is gravitationally connected with the second star, which moves in close orbit around the first component. When this occurs, the accretion of matter from the companion star to the black hole occurs, accompanied by sporadic ejections of jets of matter and X-rays.
single.pc_microquasar_2_desc: Microquasar is a smaller version of the quasar, which is a double star system, in which the remnant of the first star, compressed into a black hole of enormous mass, is gravitationally connected with the second star, which moves in close orbit around the first component. When this occurs, the accretion of matter from the companion star to the black hole occurs, accompanied by sporadic ejections of jets of matter and X-rays.
single.pc_molten_desc: Rocky world that is scorching hot. The atmosphere is thin or non-existent, and lava from the interior flows freely due to constant volcanic eruptions. This type of planet cannot sustain organic life.
single.pc_nanotech_desc: The flood has profoundly transformed this planet. Its landscape is now dominated by a dynamic sea of nanites in constant flux.
single.pc_neutron_star_desc: These incredibly dense stellar remnants are sometimes created when a massive star suffers a rapid collapse and explodes in a supernova. Although their diameter is typically as little as ten kilometers, their mass is many times greater than an average G-type star. The gravitational waves and radiation emitted by neutron stars must be carefully navigated around, slowing the sublight speed of ships.
single.pc_nova_1_desc: These cataclysmic variables are always close binary systems consisting of a white dwarf and a companion star. When the substance of the outer layers of the companion star is pulled toward the white dwarf by its gravitation, an accretion disk is formed. As a result of this process, the white dwarf is enriched in hydrogen and a thermonuclear reaction occurs, which leads to such astronomical phenomena as the appearance of a bright new star. The sharp electromagnetic emissions of the flashing star disrupt the operation of certain ship systems, making them less effective in combat.
single.pc_nova_2_desc: These cataclysmic variables are always close binary systems consisting of a white dwarf and a companion star. When the substance of the outer layers of the companion star is pulled toward the white dwarf by its gravitation, an accretion disk is formed. As a result of this process, the white dwarf is enriched in hydrogen and a thermonuclear reaction occurs, which leads to such astronomical phenomena as the appearance of a bright new star. The sharp electromagnetic emissions of the flashing star disrupt the operation of certain ship systems, making them less effective in combat.
single.pc_nuked_desc: A rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. It is currently experiencing a nuclear winter, with dense layers of sooty aerosols in the atmosphere. High levels of surface radiation. Minimal signs of life.
single.pc_o_hyper_star_desc: These incredibly huge and bright stars, whose mass far exceeds the mass of any star or even supergiant, live very short and are therefore extremely rare. The luminosity of blue hypergiants is hundreds of thousands of times greater than the luminosity of ordinary stars, these are the brightest and hottest stars. The very strong thermal radiation of such a giant star is detrimental to the outer hull casing of ships and stations, effectively reducing their protective properties significantly
single.pc_o_star_desc: The largest class O main-sequence stars are bright blue or violet-blue. These are the hottest stars, which are very rare.
single.pc_o_super_star_desc: These very young and incredibly hot stars belong to the type of blue supergiants that are at a relatively transient stage of the evolution of the star, so they are rare. As a rule, a massive star ends its existence with a supernova explosion, but some continue to evolve and eventually turn into white dwarfs.
single.pc_ocean_desc: Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and a significant hydrosphere. Oceans cover more than §Y90%§! of the surface, with scattered islands making up the remaining percentage.
single.pc_origin_birch_desc: $pc_birch_desc$\n\nThis particular $pc_birch$ is in a state of considerable disrepair, with most of its systems currently offline. The primary civilization of this world lives on a single artificial continent or Insula, and accesses space through a puncture in the outer shell.
single.pc_pouchkinn_black_hole_desc: Created by some experiment gone wrong, this literal hole in spacetime is an endlessly boiling stream of vacuum energy.
single.pc_protostar_2_desc: Protostars are stars at the final stage of their formation, up to the moment of ignition of thermonuclear reaction in the nucleus, after which the compression of the protostar ceases and it becomes a star of the main sequence. Newborn systems are oversaturated with readily available materials, from which future planets will be formed.
single.pc_protostar_desc: A former $pc_gas_giant$, now undergoing stellar fusion following the injection of a highly energetic dark matter. Studying this would provide valuable insights.
single.pc_pulsar_desc: Pulsars are highly magnetized neutron stars that emit beams of electromagnetic radiation. As the star rotates, the radiation beam is only visible when it is pointing directly at the observer. This results in a very precise interval of pulses, which sometimes is so exact that it can be used to measure the passage of time with extreme accuracy. The radiation emitted by pulsars interferes with deflector technology, rendering ship and station shields inoperable.
single.pc_red_toxic_desc: A unique type of toxic planet, entirely poisoned with strange toxic particles that stain the atmosphere a brilliant crimson.
single.pc_relic_desc: A city once stretched across this entire world. Only ancient and abandoned ruins remain now, their original inhabitants long since departed.
single.pc_rift_star_desc: In place of a star, the celestial bodies in this system orbit an ancient Astral Rift.
single.pc_ringworld_habitable_damaged_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.
single.pc_ringworld_habitable_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.
single.pc_ringworld_habitable_shrouded_desc: An immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence. Although now it has been engulfed in the tumultuous energies of the shroud, rendering it inhospitable.
single.pc_ringworld_seam_damaged_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.
single.pc_ringworld_seam_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.
single.pc_ringworld_shielded_desc: This Ring World segment is encased in some kind of impenetrable energy barrier. It blocks all scans of the surface.
single.pc_ringworld_tech_damaged_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.
single.pc_ringworld_tech_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.
single.pc_s_giant_star_desc: These giant stars are also called zirconium stars due to the presence of not a small amount of zirconium oxide and titanium oxide in their atmosphere, which makes the spectral class of these stars different from main-sequence stars.
single.pc_savannah_desc: Rocky world dominated by dry, arid plains covered by a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.
single.pc_shattered_desc: The charred, broken remnants of what was once a planet. A massive energy surge has detonated this world's core, leaving only drifting slabs of rock.
single.pc_shattered_ring_habitable_desc: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure has sustained damage - especially to some of its more advanced districts - but it does not appear irreparable.
single.pc_shrouded_desc: Our sensors are unable to penetrate the thick fog surrounding the planet. Ships that enter it do not return.
single.pc_shrouded_equatorial_shipyard_desc: The inner part of an $name_eq_shipyard$, this ringworld specializes in extracting rare minerals from the Molten World's crust and refining them directly into alloys. What little potential for life was to be found on this ring is gone now, replaced by the roiling tides of shroud energy.
single.pc_squareworld_habitable_desc: A peculiar habitat located on a squareworld. The odd sights and nature of this place fascinate many.
single.pc_squareworld_shrouded_habitable_desc: A peculiar habitat located on a squareworld. The once odd sights and nature of this place twisted and made dangerous and unruly by the chaotic energies of the shroud.
single.pc_sterile_desc: A rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and an almost complete absence of complex life forms. Extreme conditions on the surface are caused by a sharp temperature drop and an atmosphere mixed with various harmful gases from volcanic activity.
single.pc_strip_mined_desc: A hot, rocky world covered with mines and factories. Its surface is being extracted layer by layer by automated drilling units.
single.pc_tidallylocked_desc: This world is tidally locked around its star, meaning that one side always has daylight while the other is locked in eternal darkness. If life exists here, it is likely limited to the twilight-belts where the two sides meet.
single.pc_toxic_desc: A rocky planet with a thick atmosphere that is lethal to all known higher forms of life.
single.pc_toxoid_star_desc: Millennia of exposure to the Toxic Entity have caused alterations in the makeup of this star. Though once it was a fairly standard G-type star, now it emits an eerie green haze unlike any seen elsewhere in the galaxy.
single.pc_tropical_desc: Humid, rocky world with a thick nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Seasons with significant precipitation are interchanged with drier periods. Most landmasses are covered in dense vegetation.
single.pc_tt_orange_star_desc: T Tauri Stars are young stars of the spectral classes F, G, K and M, which have not yet entered the main sequence. They have a mass of less than two solar masses and are usually surrounded by a protoplanetary disc. The protoplanetary or near-star disk dissipates over the course of roughly 10 million years, partially falling into the star, partly forming planets due to accretion and partially being blown outward by stellar winds. The temperature in the core of these stars is not yet sufficient to maintain a thermonuclear reaction, which will ignite about 100 million years after the formation of the star. The main source of their energy is gravitational compression. These young systems are like a boiling cauldron, in which ships and stations are subject to wear and tear from permanent meteoric bombardement.
single.pc_tt_red_star_desc: T Tauri Stars are young stars of the spectral classes F, G, K and M, which have not yet entered the main sequence. They have a mass of less than two solar masses and are usually surrounded by a protoplanetary disc. The protoplanetary or near-star disk dissipates over the course of roughly 10 million years, partially falling into the star, partly forming planets due to accretion and partially being blown outward by stellar winds. The temperature in the core of these stars is not yet sufficient to maintain a thermonuclear reaction, which will ignite about 100 million years after the formation of the star. The main source of their energy is gravitational compression. These young systems are like a boiling cauldron, in which ships and stations are subject to wear and tear from permanent meteoric bombardement.
single.pc_tt_white_star_desc: T Tauri Stars are young stars of the spectral classes F, G, K and M, which have not yet entered the main sequence. They have a mass of less than two solar masses and are usually surrounded by a protoplanetary disc. The protoplanetary or near-star disk dissipates over the course of roughly 10 million years, partially falling into the star, partly forming planets due to accretion and partially being blown outward by stellar winds. The temperature in the core of these stars is not yet sufficient to maintain a thermonuclear reaction, which will ignite about 100 million years after the formation of the star. The main source of their energy is gravitational compression. These young systems are like a boiling cauldron, in which ships and stations are subject to wear and tear from permanent meteoric bombardement.
single.pc_tundra_desc: Cold and rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Permafrost covers most of the surface except for the more temperate equatorial regions. A stable biosphere exists but vegetation is mostly limited to mosses and lichens.
single.pc_volcanic_desc: Rocky world with a sulfur rich atmosphere and a partially liquid lithosphere. The ash and basalt covered surface is interspersed with fresh volcanic activity, lava lakes and rivers. Only extremophile life forms can be found, if any.
single.pc_w_azure_star_desc: These giant stars are also known as Wolf-Rayet stars, for which a very high luminosity and temperature are characteristic. These stars are most often found in nebulae, that resulted from the dumping of the envelope of red supergiants - the previous stage of the evolution of these stars. Constant electromagnetic emissions of the unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems of both ships and stations, making them more vulnerable.
single.pc_w_green_star_desc: These giant stars are also known as Wolf-Rayet stars, for which a very high luminosity and temperature are characteristic. These stars are most often found in nebulae, that resulted from the dumping of the envelope of red supergiants - the previous stage of the evolution of these stars. Constant electromagnetic emissions of the unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems of both ships and stations, making them more vulnerable.
single.pc_w_purple_star_desc: These giant stars are also known as Wolf-Rayet stars, for which a very high luminosity and temperature are characteristic. These stars are most often found in nebulae, that resulted from the dumping of the envelope of red supergiants - the previous stage of the evolution of these stars. Constant electromagnetic emissions of the unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems of both ships and stations, making them more vulnerable.
single.pc_w_red_star_desc: These giant stars are also known as Wolf-Rayet stars, for which a very high luminosity and temperature are characteristic. These stars are most often found in nebulae, that resulted from the dumping of the envelope of red supergiants - the previous stage of the evolution of these stars. Constant electromagnetic emissions of the unstable star disrupt the operation of protective systems of both ships and stations, making them more vulnerable.
single.pc_wh_star_desc: A once-theoretical counterpart to the black hole. A white hole emits astronomically large amounts of energy, repelling all matter. It is impossible to cross its event horizon.\n\nWhere all the energy comes from is still a mystery. It may be powered by vacuum energy, the mysterious background energy of the cosmos, or even the inflationary birthing mechanisms of whole sub-universes! No one knows the true answer...
single.pc_whc_star_desc: This structure was constructed by $ehof_the_creators$ to shield dark matter beings from Negative Mass.
single.pc_y_star_desc: The coldest brown dwarfs, which in fact can be considered very large giant planets with some stellar properties.
single.personality_fallen_empire_awoken_pouchki: It has taken millennia, but the §YUltimate Answer§! has finally been found. And now, it's time for action. This civilization's deranged Director will hold nothing back to realize their grand ambition of achieving godhood.\n\nThey will gain the equivalent of one level of all §YRepeatable Technologies§! every §Yyear§!.
single.personality_fallen_empire_pouchkinn_desc: This Fallen Empire has been focusing its research efforts on a single task for several millennia. Its founding organic species have long been relegated to lives of unending luxury while automatons and mighty megastructures work tirelessly to try and find the so-called §YUltimate Answer§!, which, according to their deranged Director, would reportedly grant access to godhood.\n\nThey will gain the equivalent of one level of all §YRepeatable Technologies§! every §Y5 years§!.
single.plantoid_bloomed_trait_tooltip:
Effects on Gaia Worlds:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$MOD_POP_BONUS_WORKFORCE_MULT$: §G+10%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$: §G+10%§!
$t$$MOD_POP_AMENITIES_USAGE_MULT$: §G-10%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$MOD_POP_HOUSING_USAGE_MULT$: §G-10%§!

single.pouchkinn_trait_ancient_knowledge_desc: The Pouchkinn have unparalleled knowledge of the universe.
single.pouchkinn_trait_deranged_desc: This leader is utterly obsessed with insane ideas that go against the very notion of sanity.
single.pouchkinn_trait_lifespan_desc: This leader has employed a mix of bioengineering and cybernetics to drastically increase their lifespan.
single.pouchkinn_trait_modified_desc: This leader is packed with custom-made implants to boost their mental and physical abilities.
single.preplanned_growth_tooltip: Pop Growth Speed: §G+30%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Pop Housing Usage: §G-10%§!
single.preset_pirate_enclave_desc: §LPirate Enclaves are home to wealthy Pirate Captains who pledge loyalty to Pirate Lord and in return gain autonomy over regional piracy operations.§!
single.reanimator_effect_desc: Controlled cloned organic §YSpace Fauna§! can be reanimated
single.scholar_subclass_tt: §GVeteran Class focused on investigating anomalies and dig sites§!
single.scorched_planet_desc: This barren world is practically devoid of atmosphere. The planet is too close to the central star of the system. During the day, unbearable heat reigns on its surface, and at night it is terribly cold.
single.shroud_touched_intro: Passage through the Shroud is not lightly taken;
single.species_trait_blokkat_desc: Blokkats are intelligent and developed creatures.
single.subclass_commander_admiral_desc: The stoic presence of a decisive Admiral steels the nerves of the crew as they engage the enemy.
single.subclass_commander_councilor_desc: Strategists are focused on the bigger picture. Instead of leading the battle up front, they prefer to maintain cohesion in the military and draw galaxy-spanning war plans.
single.subclass_commander_general_desc: The presence of a General allows for improved coordination of planetary invasions.
single.subclass_commander_governor_desc: Commissioners specialize in imposing order through force, governing planets and sectors with military rigor and a strong vision.
single.subclass_official_delegate_desc: As the public face of our empire, Delegates represent our interests in Federations and in the Galactic Community.
single.subclass_official_diplomacy_councilor_de: Ambassadors maintain our relationships with other empires, both overtly and in more subtle ways. The art of diplomacy and the subtle craft of espionage both fall under their domain.
single.subclass_official_economy_councilor_desc: The budget of our empire is in the hand of our Advisors, a class of leaders who specialize in economic theory.
single.subclass_official_governor_desc: Knowledge and skills in maintaining production quotas or material procurement come naturally to this leader.
single.subclass_scientist_councilor_desc: Statisticians are the driving force behind the management of research teams and projects. Focusing on new technologies, these individuals pursue knowledge relentlessly.
single.subclass_scientist_explorer_desc: To explore unknown worlds, catalog new species, and encounter new civilizations: this leader is the embodiment of such ideals.
single.subclass_scientist_governor_desc: Being at the forefront of science, conducting experiments, and researching new technologies to better the empire is the main concern of any determined Analyst.
single.subclass_scientist_scholar_desc: The galaxy is full of mysteries, and Scholars exist to solve them. These adventurous researchers excel in the study of dig sites, spacial anomalies and other mysteries.
single.sulfur_planet_desc: A molten world with active geological processes, the main composition of which is a variety of silicate rocks and sulfur compounds. Strong volcanism on the planet contributes to frequent changes in terrain, and due to sulfur compounds emitted by volcanic eruptions, this world acquires various shades of yellow, white, red, black and green on its surface.
single.tankbound_species_class_requirement:
Has a Species Class containing a ['trait:trait_tankbound'] portrait:
$t$$BULLET_POINT$§Y$AQUATIC$§!
$t$$BULLET_POINT$§Y$INF$§!
$t$$BULLET_POINT$§Y$NECROID$§!
$t$$BULLET_POINT$§Y$TOX$§!
single.trait_acidic_vascularity_desc: The internal fluids of this species serve as their most potent defense. Highly corrosive and lethal, these liquids ensure that any enemies regret poking holes.
single.trait_acidic_vascularity_effect: Armies §YExplode on Death§! for §G250§! Damage to Enemies\n    - Purged Pop Resource Output: §R-75%§!
single.trait_adaptive_desc: §LThis species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.§!\n
single.trait_adaptive_mutations_desc: §LBy introducing hyper-adaptive nucleotides into the genetic structure of this species, they are capable of evolutionary changes in real time.§!
single.trait_agrarian_desc: §LThis species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.§!\n
single.trait_aquatic_desc: §LThis species is perfectly adapted to living in the depths of the ocean. However, on dry land, it is like a fish out of water§!.
single.trait_aquatic_tooltip:
Housing Usage on §YOcean§! worlds and §YFlooded Habitats§!: §G-10%§!
    - $worker_and_simple_drone_cat_bonus_workforce_mult$ on §YOcean§! worlds: §G+10%§!
    - Housing Usage on non-§YWet§! worlds: §R+30%§!
    - Habitability on non-§YWet§! worlds: §R-20%§!

The §H$ap_hydrocentric$§! Ascension Perk amplifies this trait's effects.
single.trait_artificial_intelligence_desc: §LMore brains equals more brain power. Extra thinking organs have been added in strategic areas of the recipient's body to ensure maximum cognitive capacity. Even if they don't always agree.§!

single.trait_auto_mod_biological_desc: Advanced genetic strings feature epigenetic triggers that adapt to occupational demands, dynamically optimizing gene expression for the host's work environment.
single.trait_auto_mod_cyborg_desc: Universal plug-and-play connection ports allow augmentations to be replaced as needed, aligning their capabilities with current operational demands.
single.trait_auto_mod_overtuned_desc: Advanced epigenetic triggers boost physical and cognitive performance in the workplace, dramatically shortening life expectancy. After all, fading away is never as much fun as burning out.
single.trait_auto_mod_robotic_desc: This system dynamically reconfigures hardware to meet operational demands, optimizing performance for every designated task.
