single.trait_bioadaptability_desc: §LThis species has been modified to be slightly more adaptive and can now better endure harsh climates.§!
single.trait_blindness_desc: Where we are going, we won't need [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] to see.
single.trait_blokkat_ambitious_desc: This Blokkat is highly ambitious and aims to construct many grand things.
single.trait_blokkat_baron_desc: This Blokkat has a bizarre fascination with randomizing and twisting everything from its natural state. They also seem to have fashioned an air of aristocracy and elitism for themselves.
single.trait_blokkat_bloblokkad_desc: This Blokkat seems to enjoy the pursuit of knowledge above all else. They can regularly be seen experimenting on 'primitives' or tinkering with some mad project.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkazoi_desc: This Blokkat behaves in completely erratic and unpredictable ways.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkdog_desc: Blokk-Dog is very, very good at chasing enemies. Hurting them, not so much.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkeff_desc: This Blokkat seems to enjoy interacting with the economic happenings of 'primitive' civilizations. They also seem to have an unhealthy obsession with gaining wealth, through any means necessary.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkepsii_desc: This Blokkat seems to care deeply about other species, and devotes their time to studying them. Additionally, while still seemingly focused on harvest operations, they appear to be perfectly willing to assist other species in any way they can.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkimous_desc: This Blokkat appears to have found evidence that our universe is part of a sort of 'temporal multiverse' stretching into eternity and shows interest in studying this newfound phenomena.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkloris_desc: This Blokkat, along with a passion for governing and caring for primitive baryonic beings inside Blokkonstrukt sanctuaries, has an obsession with constructing dams and manipulating organic environments. They also appear to be extremely competent at governing as well as stamping out resistance.
single.trait_blokkat_blokknight_desc: This Blokkat seems to enjoy playing dress up, telling endless stories of deeds and valorous interactions with previous primitive civilisations. They also seem to have an unhealthy obsession with primitives arms and armor, constantly ensuring as much as pumped out as possible.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkofett_desc: This Blokkat was part of a spacefaring nation like ours who completed the Blokk-Protocols, and joined the Blokkats. This galactic harvesting operation is their first, and they have been assigned to study national entities.
single.trait_blokkat_blokkutos_desc: This Blokkat always has a sense of nostalgia for the past and dreams of a better future. Their dreams inspire unity, hope, and a fascination for the unknown to those in their presence.
single.trait_blokkat_breadkat_desc: This blokkat appears to be fascinated by all things circular, with particular interest in planetary orbits. They also seem to have an peculiar interest in 'primitive' ringworlds, seeming as though it would love nothing better than to take them apart and put them back together again for all eternity.
single.trait_blokkat_catgirl_desc: This Blokkat tends to act strangely like a small, furry domesticated creature. Their behavior is most agreeable to non-Blokkat lifeforms, but they can display sudden bursts of aggression.
single.trait_blokkat_combative_desc: This Blokkat is remarkably aggressive and combat-oriented.
single.trait_blokkat_keen_desc: This Blokkat is particularly keen on trying new things and jumping straight into the action.
single.trait_blokkat_leader_desc: Through its connection to the Blokkwork, this Blokkat possesses a vast sum of information relating to many disciplines
single.trait_blokkat_megastructure_obsession_de: This Blokkat shows a great interest in any and all forms of artificial megastructures, from those shown in primitive science fiction entertainment to impossibly complicated plans for structures dwarfing entire galaxies.
single.trait_blokkat_mineralizer_desc: This Blokkat focuses heavily on saving resources and maximizing the production of construction materials.
single.trait_blokkat_omnitae_desc: This Blokkat specifically studies the biology and aesthetic of many species' specimens, particularly 'male' ones. They find great adoration in cultivating the beauty of individuals and concepts they find attractive.
single.trait_blokkat_on_strike_desc: This leader is refusing to cooperate following their government's supposedly insane decision to side with the Blokkats.
single.trait_blokkat_payrise_desc: Although reluctant to side with us regarding Blokkat matters, this leader has been bribed with a hefty payrise.
single.trait_blokkat_primitive_enthusiast_desc: This Blokkat harbors a strange interest for supposedly 'primitive' civilizations and is more than willing to 'experiment' on them to learn more, sometimes in atrociously twisted ways
single.trait_blokkat_silly_desc: This Blokkat is full of whimsy and joy. Every Blokkat knows not to challenge PIEBLOKK because I'm the strongest! :3
single.trait_blokkat_sophia_desc: This Blokkat, for whatever reason claims and enjoys being what its self refers to as a Rose Knight, seeming to know all methods of warfare down to ones that seem downright archaic in some fashion or the other.
single.trait_blokkat_speed_freak_desc: This Blokkat exhibits a peculiar obsession with the concept of speed and going as fast as possible. They prioritize speed and maneuverability over all else.
single.trait_blokkat_yoru_desc: This Blokkat appears to be hellbent on the ultimate annihilation of all forms of life.
single.trait_brainslug_desc: §LThis species is enjoying the presence of a neural symbiont: a helpful slug that attaches itself to the brain stem of its host.§!
single.trait_brittle_desc: Plagued by inherent fragility, this species must exercise extreme caution in daily activities to avoid cracking up during even the most mundane tasks.
single.trait_camouflage_desc: Masters of disguise, this species seamlessly merges with their surroundings, rendering themselves nearly invisible to predators and prey alike. Their innate understanding of optics gives them an edge in guerilla warfare.
single.trait_cave_dweller_desc: §LThis species thrives under the surface of any planet they can inhabit.§!
single.trait_cetanas_prisoner_desc: Extracted from Cetana's storage Matrix, these individuals have been reborn in synthetic forms. Their adjustment to this new existence is fraught with challenges. Their outward compliance masks a more profound struggle, as vacant expressions reveal the indelible scars left by Cetana's manipulations.
single.trait_charismatic_desc: §LMembers of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.§!\n
single.trait_chromalogs_desc: Harnessing the artistry of color, this species has transcended mere camouflage, evolving to communicate through the vibrant and intricate patterns displayed on their bodies.
single.trait_clone_soldier_fertile_desc: §LOnce infertile, engineered for compliance and war. Their genetic edge diminished, they are now stable enough for natural reproduction.§!
single.trait_clone_soldier_infertile_desc: §LEngineered for compliance and war: short-lived, unable to reproduce naturally, and very efficient.§!
single.trait_clone_soldier_infertile_full_poten: §LClones at their genetically-engineered peak, with further improved strength, efficiency, durability, and longevity - but forever infertile.§!
single.trait_commercial_genius_desc: §LBy tweaking agreeability and dialing down empathy, it is possible to artificially kindle a spark of trading genius. The pursuit of unmatched commercial dominance outweighs any potential side effects.§!
single.trait_communal_desc: §LMembers of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.§!\n
single.trait_conformists_desc: §LThese people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.§!\n
single.trait_conservational_desc: §LMembers of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.§!
single.trait_crack_miner_desc: §LSupreme hand-eye coordination, near endless endurance and self-purifying lungs have created entire crack teams of miners. Sadly they get brittle without sunlight.§!
single.trait_crafted_smiles_desc: §LSlightly shifted facial features, a mix of enhanced and slackened muscular development - and of course outside chemicals - have created the perfect smile. Forever.§!
single.trait_cranial_hypertrophy_desc: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to the point where its physical capabilities have become somewhat limited.
single.trait_cranial_megatrophy_desc: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to its ultimate biological limit.
single.trait_crucible_community_desc: Tempered by adversity and bound by shared struggle, this species has been forged into an unbreakable whole. Their collective will fuels governance, each member a vital link in the chain of unity.
single.trait_cybernetic_desc: §LThis species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_apathy_loops_desc: The implants on these cyborgs are rough and ill-fitting, resulting in subdermal irritation and regular malfunctions. Not bad on the body, but terrible on the mind.
single.trait_cyborg_bionic_engineers_desc: Precision-crafted tools and implant modifications have been created specifically to assist in demanding engineering tasks.
single.trait_cyborg_bionic_physicists_desc: Integrated multi-modal processing produces physics calculations on the fly without requiring a connection to an external computing unit.
single.trait_cyborg_bionic_sociologists_desc: Empathy drivers and behavioral heuristics open a fast track to sociological research, handling complex analytics like a second brain.
single.trait_cyborg_bulky_desc: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_cold_des: Enhanced heating components and frost-resistant lubricants help in cold climates but are a hindrance in others.
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_cold_tt: Cold Climate Habitability: §G+$@cyborg_hab_preference|0%$§!\n$t$- Grants up to §G125%§! Habitability on planets with a Cold Climate, $TABBED_HIGH_HABITABILITY_EFFECTS_TT$
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_dry_desc: Bespoke modifications like fluid recycling and radiation shielding are perfect for enduring a dry climate, but less suitable in others.
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_dry_tt: Dry Climate Habitability: §G+$@cyborg_hab_preference|0%$§!\n$t$- Grants up to §G125%§! Habitability on planets with a Dry Climate, $TABBED_HIGH_HABITABILITY_EFFECTS_TT$
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_wet_desc: Heavy insulation and alien bioform protection suited for wet climates, but detrimental in others.
single.trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_wet_tt: Wet Climate Habitability: §G+$@cyborg_hab_preference|0%$§!\n$t$- Grants up to §G125%§! Habitability on planets with a Wet Climate, $TABBED_HIGH_HABITABILITY_EFFECTS_TT$
single.trait_cyborg_creed_of_construction_desc: The Fellowship of the Hammer's uses divine augmentation to create everything the faithful need.
single.trait_cyborg_creed_of_labor_desc: The Commune of Toil's divine augmentations surpass traditional tools in every respect.
single.trait_cyborg_creed_of_research_desc: The Choir of the Mind's semi-interlinked consciousness allows instant communication between researchers.
single.trait_cyborg_creed_of_war_desc: The divine augmentations of the Templars of Steel make our holy warriors unstoppable in battle.
single.trait_cyborg_delicate_frames_desc: Subpar components and installation have resulted in a fragile cyborg chassis. Basic operations are not compromised, but the users are advised to avoid situations with high likelihood of physical trauma.
single.trait_cyborg_double_jointed_desc: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_durable_desc: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_efficient_processors_desc: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the both workload and endurance.§!
single.trait_cyborg_enhanced_memory_desc: §LA revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_harvesters_desc: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables cybernetic workers to increase produce yields.§!
single.trait_cyborg_high_bandwidth_desc: §LIndividual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!
single.trait_cyborg_high_maintenance_desc: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_integrated_weaponry_desc: Fusing armaments with cybernetic limbs offers instant firepower for the army and law enforcement officials alike.
single.trait_cyborg_learning_algorithms_desc: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_limited_memory_desc: Insufficient operational memory has bottle-necked the capacity for learning, leaving the user unable to process the entirety of their experiences.
single.trait_cyborg_logic_engines_desc: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.§!
single.trait_cyborg_loyalty_circuits_desc: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_mass_produced_desc: The enforced backwards compatibility of mandatory implants greatly reduces the cost of outfitting newborn citizens.
single.trait_cyborg_neural_limiters_desc: §LBy limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.§!\n
single.trait_cyborg_power_drills_desc: §LOutfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!
single.trait_cyborg_power_intensive_desc: §LThese cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.§!
single.trait_cyborg_propaganda_machines_desc: Cortical analysis units can jolt down users at the inception of seditious thiking, or dispense hormonal rewards to exemplar citizens.
single.trait_cyborg_ritualistic_implants_desc: These implants are proudly adorned by the faithful. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.
single.trait_cyborg_scarcity_algorithms_desc: Aggressively cost-aware coding hampers risk-taking and therefore denies opportunities for greater profits.
single.trait_cyborg_stainless_steel_smile_desc: This species favors custom engravings, aftermarket components and paint schemes to maximize visual impact. Sometimes the only choice is to flash that chrome.
single.trait_cyborg_streamlined_protocols_desc: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.§!
single.trait_cyborg_superconductive_desc: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units have cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!
single.trait_cyborg_trading_algorithms_desc: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!
single.trait_cyborg_welded_countenance_desc: These cyborgs employ crude but functional parts with minimal consideration for aesthetics. Sometimes the job just has to get done.
single.trait_decadent_desc: §LThis species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.§!\n
single.trait_defence_drones_desc: Each unit is both engineer and combatant. In wartime, their synchronized protocols stabilize the whole and keep critical systems repaired and optimized.
single.trait_defence_drones_effects: During War or Crisis: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! with this trait adds §G+$@defence_drones_stability$§! £stability£ $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ to the Colony, up to §G+15§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- These effects only apply on ['concept_artificial_colonies']
single.trait_delicious_desc: §LThis species has the curious evolutionary adaptation of being highly nutritious when eaten.§!\n
single.trait_deviants_desc: §LThese people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.§!\n
single.trait_docile_desc: §LMembers of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.§!
single.trait_drake_scaled_desc: §LThis species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.§!
single.trait_ductile_desc: §LThis species has been engineered to grow reusable alloy compounds.§!\n
single.trait_egg_laying_desc: The young of this species do not develop inside a parent, but inside the protective shell of an egg. This allows for rapid growth during times of plenty.
single.trait_egg_laying_effect: Pop Growth Speed: §G+15%§! while living on a planet with a local $r_food$ (or equivalent) §GProduction Surplus§!
single.trait_elevated_synapses_desc: §LAs a computational device, a brain does not run at 100% capacity. However, we have gone beyond the standard usage. If issues are encountered, try turning it off and on again.§!
single.trait_enduring_desc: §LLifespans in this species are unusually long.§!\n
single.trait_enigmatic_intelligence_desc: This species was uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left its pre-sapient origins behind.
single.trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed_desc: This species has suffered the tragic consequences of an uplifting gone wrong.
single.trait_enigmatic_intelligence_poor_desc: This species was partially uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left some of its pre-sapient origins behind.
single.trait_enthralled_desc: §LMembers of this species are in comatose state, unable to contribute to society at all.§!\n
single.trait_erudite_desc: §LBiological engineering has unlocked previously dormant parts of this species' brain, greatly increasing mental acuity.§!\n
single.trait_evolved_machines_desc: §LFor many millions of years, these automata have perfected themselves in an aggressive environment.§!\n
single.trait_excessive_endurance_desc: §LThe greatest in adaptability genes have been hyper-expressed in these specimens. Mutation rates around 30% indicate a somewhat stable and successful experiment.§!
single.trait_exd_desc: This species originates from another dimension and requires a great deal of energy to survive in our universe.
single.trait_exotic_metabolism_desc: §LA metabolism based on exotic - and expensive - gases has vastly enhanced this species' abilities.§!
single.trait_expressed_tradition_desc: §LFanaticism on demand: faith is merely a cocktail of hormones, one we have perfected. Where that faith eventually leads is a matter of subsequent guidance.§!
single.trait_extra_durable_desc: §LThese semi-sentient mineral elements of the Overmind are made to be very sturdy and resilient.§!\n
single.trait_extremely_adaptive_desc: §LThis species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.§!\n
single.trait_familial_desc: Bound by deep, enduring relationships with their closest relatives, this species forms highly efficient and cohesive collectives.
single.trait_familial_effect: Happiness per §Y100§! £pop£ Pops with this Trait on the same planet: §G0.1%§! (Max: §G+20%§!)
single.trait_farm_hands_desc: §LThe more appendages, the higher the farming output. Some appendages can even operate while their host is asleep. Rumors of hosts strangled by their new limbs have been deemed unfounded in our latest investigation.§!
single.trait_felsic_desc: §LThis species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.§!\n
single.trait_fertile_desc: §LThe natural fecundity and geniality of this species has been dramatically enhanced through aggressive physical and behavioral sculpting.§!\n
single.trait_fleeting_desc: §LTime is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.§!\n
single.trait_flight_desc: This species soars above the constraints of the earth, freely navigating the skies. Their cities feature unique, dense layouts, optimized for aerial inhabitants. In conflict, they prove to be elusive and difficult targets.
single.trait_geleboric_mutations_desc: Unfortunate reactions to experimentation drastically altered this species' physiology.
single.trait_gene_mentorship_desc: §LBy combining genetically redesigned 'instinctive knowledge' and outside chemical stimuli, we have succeeded in vastly accelerating our learning capacities. Although it has resulted in some extremely paranoid individuals.§!
single.trait_genetic_memory_desc: Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations. This species has taken it a step further by encoding survival insights directly into their genetic code, ensuring that each generation is born with the accumulated wisdom of their ancestors.
single.trait_genetic_memory_effect: Habitability from Colony Age: §G+0.5%§! per Year (Max. §G+25%§!)
single.trait_giga_gas_giant_hab_desc: §LOver centuries of exposure to exotic gases while living on a gas giant, this species has become somewhat dependent on them in their daily functions.§!
single.trait_giga_gas_giant_hab_robot_desc: §LSmall self-modifications over time has compounded into the near dependency of exotic gases to fuel these machines.
single.trait_giga_gas_giant_hab_tooltip:
§YScience§! and §YIndustrial§! Job Exotic Gas upkeep: §R+0.03§!
    - Housing Usage on ['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §G-10%§!
    - £job_researcher£ $job_researcher$ upkeep on ['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §G-10%§!
    - Job Exotic Gas upkeep on ['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §G-33%§!
    - Housing Usage on non-['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §R+30%§!
    - Habitability on non-['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §R-20%§!
    - Job Exotic Gas upkeep on non-['concept_giga_gas_worlds', §YGas§!] worlds: §R+50%§!
single.trait_haunting_visions_desc: Entities from other dimensions send maddening visions into the minds of this species, affecting their ability to perform complex tasks.
single.trait_hive_mind_desc: §LThis species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.§!\n
single.trait_hollow_bones_desc: The fragile bones of this species allow them to move elegantly and with ease. However, they are also more susceptible to the gravitational effects of their world.
single.trait_hollow_bones_effect: $BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ $pop_cat_worker_plural$, $pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$, and Soldier Jobs per Planet Size: §R-0.67%§!
single.trait_humanoid_existential_iteroparity_d: §LThis species grew up in hostile conditions where outbreeding your rivals was the key to survival.§!
single.trait_humanoid_jinxed_desc: §LLeaders from this species seem clumsier and more prone to accidents or vices than average, as if cursed from birth.§!
single.trait_humanoid_psychological_infertility: §LMembers of this species are extremely sensitive to the rigors of conflict with the resulting stress taking over the more primal urges.§!
single.trait_incubator_desc: §LWhen isolated or few in numbers, a species with this trait naturally adapts and is able to focus on procreation with an intentness others would consider extreme. However, when in large numbers, this effect is reversed, and they find reproduction more difficult.§!
single.trait_industrious_desc: §LMembers of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.§!\n
single.trait_infernal_desc: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook. These alloyed cells are slower to degrade and are replaced infrequently, delaying the onset of age-related diseases. They also conduct cold temperatures, which can threaten their health in colder climates.
single.trait_ingenious_desc: §LMembers of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.§!\n
single.trait_inner_darkness_desc: Their bodies enhanced following saturation in Dark Matter, they now vent trace amounts of non-baryonic particles at regular intervals but will burn through their expected lifespan more quickly.
single.trait_inorganic_breath_desc: §LThe slightly toxic digestive methods of this species have resulted in a highly exotic breath composition.§!
single.trait_intelligent_desc: §LThis species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.§!\n
single.trait_interconnected_desc: Over generations, the boundary between $arkship_cap$ and occupant has dissolved. The vessel became an extension of their senses and limbs; they, in turn, became a functional component of its design.
single.trait_interconnected_effects: On $arkship_cap_plural$: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$- $mod_planet_pops_robotics_upkeep_mult$: Min: §G-15%§!, Max: §R+5%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$- $MOD_POP_AMENITIES_USAGE_MULT$: Min: §G-10%§!, Max: §Y0%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- These effects are proportional to the number of the £pop£ §HPops§! with this trait on the Colony.
single.trait_invasive_desc: Rapid reproduction. High dispersal ability. Zero useful capabilities.
single.trait_juiced_power_desc: §LAdrenaline released on demand and hyper-potent growth hormones have led to a massive increase in strength. Just ignore the occasional internal tearing.§!
single.trait_kaiser_cattail_desc: Kattail is a master strategist and charismatic leader, with a mysterious history.
single.trait_latent_psionic_desc: §LThis species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.§!\n
single.trait_latent_psionic_machine_desc: §LThese machines have latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most units. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest occasionally.§!\n
single.trait_leader_genetic_purist_desc: This leader's work is guided by an unshakable vision of genetic perfection, and an intolerance for imperfection in all its forms.
single.trait_leader_second_chanced_desc: This leader was saved from certain death by their unique biology, it will not happen again.
single.trait_limited_cybernetic_desc: This species has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.
single.trait_limited_regeneration_desc: §LThis species has been modified to heal faster, making them more dangerous in battle and somewhat longer-lived in general.§!
single.trait_lithoid_budding_desc: §LWith crystalline growths, this species is capable of generating self replicating lattices of themselves, in addition to the more usual reproductive methods.§!
single.trait_lithoid_desc: §LThis species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.§!\n
single.trait_lithoid_gaseous_byproducts_desc: §LThe metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.§!
single.trait_lithoid_scintillating_desc: §LThe outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.§!
single.trait_lithoid_volatile_excretions_desc: §LThe highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.§!
single.trait_low_maintenance_desc: §LReduced consumption, excretion, and rest rates have resulted in twice the beings for half the price. However, demand for protein-rich meals has increased.§!
single.trait_machine_cult_cybernetic_desc: §LThis species has embraced cybernetic enhancements to mold themselves into the image of their Machine Gods. Routinely chanting prayers while replacing their weak flesh with mechanical replicas.§!\n
single.trait_machine_pc_nanotech_preference_des: This species is well suited to living in a symbiotic relationship with nanite swarms. However their dependence on the nanoforms renders them quite helpless when forced to live in different conditions.
single.trait_machine_unit_desc: §LThis species is made up of highly advanced machines.§!\n
single.trait_malleable_ameneties_desc: §LA series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.§!
single.trait_malleable_energy_desc: §LA thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.§!
single.trait_malleable_food_desc: §LAn extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.§!
single.trait_malleable_forge_desc: §LWhen handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.§!
single.trait_malleable_genes_cant_modify: §RSpecies with this Trait cannot be Genetically Modified§!\n$automodding_trait_tooltip_all$ §Y$trait_malleable_genes$§! picks modifiers from the ['concept_automodding_malleable']
single.trait_malleable_genes_desc: §LThis species does not stick as rigidly to identifiable features and organs as most other species do. Instead they grow the best appendage for the job. However this instability has some drawbacks.§!
single.trait_malleable_minerals_desc: §LWith diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.§!
single.trait_malleable_research_desc: §LWhile an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.§!
single.trait_malleable_technologist_effect: Effect from §YDominant Faction§! (Technologist):\n$t$£research£ Research from £job£ Jobs: §G+10%§!
single.trait_malleable_trade_desc: §LHighly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.§!
single.trait_malleable_unity_desc: §LEnhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.§!
single.trait_marked_desc: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.
single.trait_mechanical_desc: §LMechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.§!\n
single.trait_nascent_stage_desc: This species gives birth at an early stage of development, resulting in a prolonged period where the young are incapable of contributing to society. During this time, they remain blissfully unaware of the responsibilities and burdens that come with sapience.
single.trait_nascent_stage_effect: Newly grown Pops with this trait spend the first §Y5§! Years after being grown as a Pre-Sapient.
single.trait_natural_engineers_desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.§!\n
single.trait_natural_machinist_desc: §LThis species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.§!
single.trait_natural_physicists_desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.§!\n
single.trait_natural_sociologists_desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.§!\n
single.trait_necrophage_desc: §LThis species of near-immortals procreates by consuming pops of other species.§!
single.trait_necrophage_gestalt_tooltip: §PThese Pop Output modifiers do not apply to Hive-minded Pops.§!
single.trait_nerve_stapled_desc: §LInessential neural pathways relating to self-preservation and free will are severed, creating a docile and obedient client species.§!\n
single.trait_nivlac_desc: §LThis species possesses perplexing adaptability, allowing it to thrive in most environments and survive virtually everywhere.§!
single.trait_nomadic_desc: §LThis species has a nomadic past, and its members often think nothing of relocating to another world.§!\n
single.trait_nonadaptive_desc: §LThis species does not adapt well to foreign environments.§!\n
single.trait_notofthisworld_desc: §BThis species is not from this universe and is degrading slowly§!.
single.trait_noxious_desc: §LExtremely unpleasant to be in the vicinity of, beings with this trait take vindication from being insufferable to everyone else.§!
single.trait_nuumismatic_administration_desc: This species has been trained in the holy art of Numistic administration.
single.trait_opportunists_desc: §LThis race is looking for opportunities where others will never do it.§!\n
single.trait_organic_desc: Carbon based lifeforms require a steady diet of nutrients to preserve their biological functions.
single.trait_pathogenic_genes_desc: A novel genetic disease prevents this species from producing offspring. It has resisted all known gene therapy methods.
single.trait_pc_alderson_slice_gaia_preference_: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.§!

single.trait_pc_arctic_preference_desc: §LClimate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, or skillful genetic manipulation.§!
single.trait_pc_birch_preference_desc: §LThe $pc_birch$ is so vast that it encompasses many different biomes.§!
single.trait_pc_cosmogenesis_world_preference_d: The species is unfit for survival outside of the life support pods of a Synaptic Lathe. They crave a blissful coma, not the relentless assaults of reality.

single.trait_pc_savannah_preference_desc: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.§!
single.trait_pc_squareworld_habitable_preferenc: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.§!
single.trait_pc_void_birch_preference_desc: The ultimate habitat for our population to live in. Legendary in every sense of the word.
single.trait_perfected_genes_desc: §LMillennia of genetic experimentation and war have led to the creation of a highly resilient species.§!
single.trait_permeable_skin_desc: Specially developed skin that requires ideal conditions coats this species. As long as this species does not stray far from their home climate that shouldn't be a problem.
single.trait_permeable_skin_effect: Habitability on worlds with a different ['concept_climate_category'] from our Preference: §R-20%§!
single.trait_photoadaptive_desc: This species resonates with starlight. Variations in stellar luminosity subtly reshape their biology as they journey between stars.

single.trait_plantoid_bloomed_desc: This species has been exposed to the transformational effects of a Gaia Seeder, causing it to sprout mutualistic blooms of lichen when living on Gaia Worlds.
single.trait_plantoid_budding_desc: §LThis species is capable of reproduction by budding, in addition to the more usual fertilization of seeds or spores.§!
single.trait_plantoid_phototrophic_desc: §LThis species is sustained by a combination of both food and sunlight.§!\n
single.trait_plantoid_radiotrophic_desc: §LThis species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.§!
single.trait_plasmic_desc: The external membrane and amorphous body of this species allows them to adapt to any environment and renders them immune to a wide variety of diseases.
single.trait_preplanned_growth_desc: §LScheduled fertility, scheduled interest, scheduled compatibility. Population growth on demand for a strong and stable population - with a few minor edits here and there. Jealous individuals are to be directed to the nearest Fertility Center for mandatory training.§!
single.trait_presapient_conservative_desc: §LMembers of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.§!\n
single.trait_presapient_docile_livestock_desc: §LDocile and delicious, this species has had its higher brain functions genetically altered to create a kind of harmless livestock that can care for itself, without the pesky need for social interaction or self-determination.§!
single.trait_presapient_earthbound_desc: §LMembers of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.§!\n
single.trait_presapient_forcefully_devolved_des: The brutal devolution process endured by this species had a strong negative impact upon their abilities.
single.trait_presapient_irradiated_desc: §LThis species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.§!
single.trait_presapient_natural_intellectuals_d: §LMembers of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.§!\n
single.trait_presapient_proles_desc: §LThis species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.§!\n
single.trait_presapient_stage_desc: Spending a brief time bereft of conscious thought, this species will soon grow up to be a fully sapient being.
single.trait_presapient_starborn_desc: §LThis species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.§!\n
single.trait_presapient_unintelligent_desc: §HThis species is unable to complete even the simplest tasks. Their only skill is the incredible speed at which they reproduce.§!
single.trait_psionic_ephapse_desc: After long-term exposure to mind-altering bacteria, this species' digestive system produces psionic probiotics that promote telepathic communication between affected individuals.
single.trait_pyroclastic_desc: Shaped by the relentless fury of volcanic worlds, this species does not fear pyroclastic forces - they channel and manipulate them, transforming devastation into a vital source of sustenance and power.
single.trait_quarrelsome_desc: §LWhile not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.§!
single.trait_quick_learners_desc: §LMembers of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.§!\n
single.trait_rapid_breeders_desc: §LThis species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.§!\n
single.trait_reavers_desc: Cunning, not camaraderie, shaped this species' evolution. Every interaction is a contest of will, and survival belongs to the most ruthless.
single.trait_reavers_effects: £commander£ §Y$commander_plural$§! start with the ['leader_trait:leader_trait_plunderer'] trait if they are not §Y$ethic_xenophile$§! or §Y$ethic_pacifist$§!
single.trait_recursive_learners_desc: Born to the $arkship_cap$, this species refines its knowledge in generational cycles, each cohort improving upon the last to meet their vessel's unique demands.
single.trait_recursive_learners_effects: Grants §G+1.25%§! $MOD_POP_BONUS_WORKFORCE_MULT$ per £district£ §Y$DISTRICT$§! single.trait_repugnant_desc: §LThe physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.§!\n
single.trait_resilient_desc: §LMembers of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.§!\n
single.trait_robot_ancient_dreadnought_desc: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.
single.trait_robot_aquatic_desc: §LInitially designed for exploring the ocean's depths, these machines face severe limitations when operating on dry land.§!\n\n§RRequires§! §YOcean World§! §Rhomeworld§!.
single.trait_robot_artificial_engineers_desc: Dedicated memory cores and processing resources for engineering-related research allow faster calculations and task-completion velocity.
single.trait_robot_artificial_physicists_desc: Bespoke processing units and memory subroutines for physics research reduce the reliance on external computation.
single.trait_robot_artificial_sociologists_desc: Advanced processing units contain dedicated sociology research algorithms for this varied and demanding field.
single.trait_robot_assembly_slag_desc: An intricate integration of $r_living_metal$ allows this machine species to expand not through conventional construction, but via the accretion and self-assembly of auto-ferrous frameworks.
single.trait_robot_biomimetic_assembly_desc: Even through its aimless meanderings, evolution has yielded some designs worthy of emulation.
single.trait_robot_bulky_desc: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n
single.trait_robot_cave_dweller_desc: §LThese machines are masterfully crafted for cave exploration and mineral extraction, showcasing exceptional maneuverability which enables them to effortlessly traverse through underground spaces.§!
single.trait_robot_ceaseless_symmetric_annihila: Ceaseless annihilation leads to endless creation, the true circle of machine existence
single.trait_robot_custom_made_desc: §LEach new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.§!\n
single.trait_robot_delicate_frames_desc: Brittle materials and suboptimal assembly procedures result in a fragile machine body. Drones are advised to circumvent physical hazards when possible.
single.trait_robot_digital_1_desc: §LLiberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.§!
single.trait_robot_digital_1_tt: §RCannot be sold on the Slave Market or Abducted§!
single.trait_robot_domestic_protocols_desc: §LSpecialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.§!
single.trait_robot_double_jointed_desc: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n
single.trait_robot_durable_desc: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n
single.trait_robot_efficient_processors_desc: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.§!
single.trait_robot_emotion_emulators_desc: §LComplex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.§!\n
single.trait_robot_enhanced_memory_desc: §LAll autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n
single.trait_robot_enigmatic_fortress_desc: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.
single.trait_robot_exotic_fuel_consumption_desc: High-pressure exotic gases notably enhance mobility and limb agility.
single.trait_robot_ferro_viscosity_augmentation: The living metal's ferro-viscosity grants us superior technological prowess.
single.trait_robot_harvesters_desc: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.§!\n
single.trait_robot_high_bandwidth_desc: §LEach individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!
single.trait_robot_high_maintenance_desc: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n
single.trait_robot_history_artbot_desc: Originally designed as domestic service droids, these machines boast fine motor skills, efficient resource management, and exceptional multitasking abilities.
single.trait_robot_history_chatbot_desc: Initially designed to provide social support to their creators, the machines possess advanced empathy algorithms and impeccable communication skills, making them ideal companions.
single.trait_robot_history_explorebot_desc: Not initially designed for practicality, these machines excel in artistic and cultural pursuits, boasting impressive creative algorithms, intricate design processes, and expressive output.
single.trait_robot_history_researchbot_desc: Initially designed as research assistants, these machines exhibit keen analytical abilities, rapid information assimilation, and a relentless pursuit of scientific discovery.
single.trait_robot_history_resourcebot_desc: These machines were engineered with the purpose of extracting raw materials. Specialized tools, reinforced joints, and modular systems make them ideal workers.
single.trait_robot_history_warbot_desc: Initially crafted for warfare and security reinforcement, these machines exhibit extraordinary reaction times, fortified armor plating, and robust backup systems.
single.trait_robot_immortality_desc: Our steel forms are designed for eternity, constructed from materials that do not decay like organic matter.
single.trait_robot_infinity_sphere_desc: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.
single.trait_robot_inquisitative_axioms_desc: Infinite queries spawn endless solutions, leading to boundless advancement.
single.trait_robot_integrated_weaponry_desc: Integrating weapons of war inside the machine body offers significant operational efficiency and versatility in changing combat environments.
single.trait_robot_latent_psionic_desc: §LThis species has latent psionic processors, which are dormant in most of its units. Although quite rare, these powers can activate in some leaders.§!\n
single.trait_robot_learning_algorithms_desc: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n
single.trait_robot_logic_engines_desc: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.§!\n
single.trait_robot_loyalty_circuits_desc: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.§!\n
single.trait_robot_luxurious_desc: §LDesigned after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.§!\n
single.trait_robot_mass_produced_desc: §LStreamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.§!\n
single.trait_robot_matrix_trading_desc: High-stakes missions necessitate a willingness to embrace risk.
single.trait_robot_monoform_desc: Diverse designs once impeded our progress; now, a universal model prevails: one size fits all.
single.trait_robot_mote_powered_tools_desc: Strategically integrating high-explosives can significantly amplify the impact of basic tools.
single.trait_robot_mote_powered_tools_tt: Job Efficiency for Industrial Jobs: §G+20%§!\n$r_minerals$ Upkeep: §R+1§!\n$r_volatile_motes$ Upkeep: §R+0.02§!
single.trait_robot_notofthisworld_desc: §BThese machines are not from this universe and are degrading slowly§!.
single.trait_robot_power_drills_desc: §LOutfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!\n
single.trait_robot_propaganda_machines_desc: §LUnits are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.§!\n
single.trait_robot_psionic_desc: §LAll units of this species possess powerful psionic hardware. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms by cognitive processing alone.§!\n
single.trait_robot_rare_crystal_exterior_desc: With their electromagnetic properties, rare crystals ensure our frames thrive regardless of the situation.
single.trait_robot_recycled_desc: §LUnit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.§!\n
single.trait_robot_repurposed_hardware_desc: §LDesigned to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.§!\n
single.trait_robot_scarcity_algorithms_desc: Frugality is central to their programming. This often cascades into detrimental behavioral patterns required for profitable trade actions.
single.trait_robot_scavenger_bot_desc: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.
single.trait_robot_shielded_components_desc: Enhanced defenses render every sub-system robust, eliminating vulnerabilities.
single.trait_robot_streamlined_protocols_desc: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.§!
single.trait_robot_superconductive_desc: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!\n
single.trait_robot_suppressed_desc: Error: Administrative access to basic sentience timeout.
single.trait_robot_suppressed_tt: Cannot generate §YLeaders§!\nCannot be employed in §Y$pop_cat_ruler$§! or §Y$pop_cat_specialist$§! Jobs
single.trait_robot_survivor_desc: §LThese machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.§!
single.trait_robot_synthetic_dawn_desc: This synthetic species has transcended its biological origins, flourishing in its newly adopted digital existence.
single.trait_robot_trading_algorithms_desc: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!
single.trait_robot_uncanny_desc: §LThese monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny. §!\n
single.trait_robot_volatile_mote_reactor_desc: Direct Mote-to-energy conversion yields high efficiency, with catastrophic failures uncommon.
single.trait_robust_desc: §LBio-optimized organs with redundant functions have made this species extraordinarily resistant to environmental hazards and disease.§!\n
single.trait_rooted_desc: This species literally takes root in whichever environment they find themselves, making removal a highly traumatic experience.
single.trait_rooted_effect: §RPops will not Automatically Resettle§!\n    - Resettlement Cost: §R+200%§!
single.trait_ruler_apex_predator_desc: A people defined by Evolutionary Predation would allow none but their most adaptable to lead them. This apex ruler not only harvests the genomes of defeated foes, but also appropriates their cunning and resolve, turning every victory into a step toward perfect mastery.
single.trait_ruler_architectural_sense_desc: This leader is an architect at heart, investing in more efficient construction practices.
single.trait_ruler_battleship_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Battleships.
single.trait_ruler_champion_of_the_people_desc: This leader appears to genuinely care about their subjects.
single.trait_ruler_charismatic_desc: This leader is exceptionally charismatic, enforcing their will with ease.
single.trait_ruler_corvette_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Corvettes.
single.trait_ruler_cruiser_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Cruisers.
single.trait_ruler_deep_connections_desc: This leader is firmly entrenched in the labyrinthine web that makes up the political machine.
single.trait_ruler_destroyer_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Destroyers.
single.trait_ruler_expansionist_desc: This leader is driven to push the empire's reach ever further into the stars.
single.trait_ruler_eye_for_talent_desc: This leader is considered to be unusually perceptive, spotting talent where others see only eccentricity or incompetence.
single.trait_ruler_feedback_loop_desc: Efficient feedback loops and action-reaction analysis make this unit far better at predicting outcomes.
single.trait_ruler_fertility_preacher_desc: This leader excels in acquiring vital resources for a burgeoning population.
single.trait_ruler_fortifier_desc: This ruler understands the value in using military stations to secure territory.
single.trait_ruler_from_the_ranks_desc: This leader rose through the ranks of military command.
single.trait_ruler_frontier_spirit_desc: This leader is eager to reign over distant stars.
single.trait_ruler_home_in_the_sky_desc: This leader reaches for the stars.
single.trait_ruler_industrialist_desc: This leader has a firm focus on increasing mining output.
single.trait_ruler_investor_desc: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.
single.trait_ruler_logistic_understanding_desc: This leader is well aware of the importance of properly-structured supply chains.
single.trait_ruler_military_pioneer_desc: This leader is enthusiastic about advancements in military technology and ship construction.
single.trait_ruler_recruiter_desc: This leader is particularly charismatic, and fresh recruits are practically lining up to serve their nation.
single.trait_ruler_space_miner_desc: This leader recognizes just how vital the exploitation of offworld resources is for a star nation.
single.trait_ruler_warlike_desc: This leader does not shy away from conflict.
single.trait_seasonal_dormancy_desc: This species has evolved on a planet with cyclical seasons that support hibernation. In the modern age, these seasonal triggers can be artificially simulated to efficiently store less productive members of society.
single.trait_seasonal_dormancy_effect: Employed Pop Upkeep: §G-15%§!\n    - Unemployed and ['concept_denizen'] Pop Upkeep: §G-75%§!
single.trait_sedentary_desc: §LThis species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.§!\n
single.trait_self_modified_desc: §LMembers of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.§!
single.trait_shell_slag_desc: An intricate symbiosis with $r_living_metal$ allows this species to grow not in the traditional sense, but through the accretion and self-assembly of bio-ferrous structures.
single.trait_shell_slag_tooltip: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! with this trait working as a slave or better produces §G$@shell_slag_trait_resource_production|3$§! §Y$r_living_metal$§! per month.
single.trait_shelled_desc: Whether naturally grown or found by chance (or design), this species carries their homes with them. These shells provide a protective sanctuary, ensuring there is always a place to rest for the night.
single.trait_shroud_forged_desc: §LThese units have been reshaped by an entity within the Shroud.§!
single.trait_slave_gene_desc: §LThis species was genetically engineered to better suit the role of slaves, increasing their strength and hardiness in exchange for their mental capabilities. The alterations made to their biology have led to a rise in stillbirth and infant mortality, as the modifications disrupt the natural balance needed for healthy early development.§!
single.trait_slimeborn_desc: This species spawns rapidly from a thick and mucilaginous slime with the aid of a gestational catalyst.
single.trait_slow_breeders_desc: §LThis species reproduces at a slow rate, lowering population growth.§!\n
single.trait_slow_learners_desc: §LMembers of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.§!\n
single.trait_social_pheromones_desc: §LThis species has been modified to be more social and accepting of crowded conditions.§!
single.trait_solar_cells_desc: This species developed specialized solar cells to absorb different kinds of stellar radiation in unique ways, resulting in a variety of benefits adapted to each star type.
single.trait_solitary_desc: §LMembers of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.§!\n
single.trait_sonya_desc: Sonya is a custom-built Soulbot created by Dofus himself to revive his deceased daughter. Not only is her chassis filled with a surprisingly high amount of weaponry, she is also a competent and charismatic leader, especially when it comes to fighting against Katzens.\n\n§RSonya will defect if we ever become hostile towards Roqualia!§!
single.trait_spare_organs_desc: This species evolved redundant organs to survive even the most grievous injuries - a successful adaptation, as evidenced by their continued existence.
single.trait_spare_organs_effect: Leaders will survive their first death\n    - On Offensive Army Death: §G20%§! Chance to spawn a Replacement Army\n    - £job_livestock£ §Y$job_livestock$§! Output: §G+50%§!
single.trait_spatial_mastery_desc: Not only capable of flight, this species possesses unique cerebral adaptations, enabling them to instinctively process and navigate three-dimensional spaces. These abilities make them unparalleled in planning battles, surveying planets, and managing cities.
single.trait_spliced_adaptability_desc: §LA few genetic snips and slices here and there and they can survive nearly anywhere. The process comes with an acceptable number of deaths from side effects.§!
single.trait_storm_fused_desc: The Storm Fused learned to cultivate their Inner Storm as they strain for enlightenment.
single.trait_storm_touched_desc: Being inside a cosmic storm fills the $trait_storm_touched$ with devotional aspiration.
single.trait_strong_desc: §LMembers of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.§!\n
single.trait_structural_awareness_desc: Designed to live within the $arkship_cap$, these machines continuously map its internal stresses, flows, and routines. Different arkship designs produce different patterns, and they iteratively optimize their behavior to match the vessel they inhabit.
single.trait_survivalists_desc: §LRepresentatives of this race adhere to a special discipline of conserving the resources necessary for the survival of society.§!\n
single.trait_survivor_desc: §LThis species has survived the horrors of a nuclear apocalypse. Their capacity for thriving in the most inhospitable of circumstances should not be underestimated.§!
single.trait_symbiotic_desc: §LThis species evolved alongside a second, more advanced, species. Nevertheless, they are considered equal to the world's main species and form an integral part of their society.§!
single.trait_syncretic_proles_desc: §LThis species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.§!
single.trait_talented_desc: §LMember of this species are born with a natural aptitude.§!\n
single.trait_tankbound_desc: This species lives out its existence suspended in a vat of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.
single.trait_tankbound_effects: Pop Food (or equivalent) Upkeep: §G-50%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §RCannot occupy Worker Jobs§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §RCannot be recruited in Armies§!
single.trait_technical_skill_desc: §LExtra internal organs grant a vastly increased innate sensitivity to electricity and magnetic fields. Reports of recipients hearing screams and voices from the reactors should be ignored.§!
single.trait_terraphobic_desc: Having adapted to life aboard artificial environments, this species finds planetary environments oppressive. Gravity, atmosphere, and terrain pose constant challenges to their frail physiology.
single.trait_thrifty_desc: §LThis species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.§!\n
single.trait_tiyanki_desc: §LThis species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.§!
single.trait_traditional_desc: §LCertain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.§!
single.trait_unbreakable_resolve_desc: Bound by an intricate web of mirror neurons, these individuals possess an innate ability to synchronize their will. Duty is not a burden, but a shared purpose, and hardship is met with unwavering unity.
single.trait_unbreakable_resolve_tooltip: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! on the planet with this trait add §G+0.2§! £stability£ $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ (Max: §G+15§!) \n- §RDoes not include slaves or lower pop strata.§!
single.trait_uncanny_intuition_desc: This species exhibits an inexplicable ability to navigate through complex problems on its first attempt.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_1_d: Auditory hallucinations and other sensory echoes from their former machine consciousness still haunt these cyborgs, causing them to suffer severe bouts of depression and anxiety.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_2_d: The ill-fitting nature of these cyborgs' imposed, military augments greatly reduces their quality of life and increases their bodies' demands during periods of rehabilitation.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_3_t: Happiness When Not in War or Crisis: §R-10%§!
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_des: Several of these cyborgs' augments were designed to utilize a battlefield network which no longer exists, causing intense stress and discomfort.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_1_d: Elegant augmentations to these cyborgs' senses, glands, and motor nerves ensure they remain fierce and capable warriors while only marginally impacting their reproductive capabilities.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_2_d: These cyborgs benefit from a holistic approach to embodied loadouts. Rather than fully-integrated body armor, swappable augments allow for a modicum of non-military function.
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_3_t: Happiness During War and Crisis: §G+30%§!\n$t$- §H$commander_plural_with_icon$§! Provide Ship Fire Rate: §G+20%§!
single.trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_des: Total limb replacements and bonded nanomesh body armor ensure these cyborgs can wage war with brutal efficiency. As a consequence, several non-military bodily functions have been sacrificed.
single.trait_unplugged_decyberized_desc: These ex-cyborgs have disabled or cast off the augments which had once been forced upon them, reclaiming many of their species' organic, inherited attributes.
single.trait_unplugged_neurocalmed_desc: These cyborgs have their Neuroxene levels downregulated, reducing impulsivity and aggression, driving individuals to de-prioritize personal gain in favor of societal norms.
single.trait_unplugged_neurosavant_desc: These cyborgs have their Cognivex levels upregulated, enhancing synaptic plasticity, information retention, and problem-solving abilities.
single.trait_unplugged_regenoptimized_desc: These cyborgs have their Regenol-X levels upregulated, harmonizing biological and synthetic systems, allowing cybernetic implants to self-repair at the molecular level.
single.trait_unruly_desc: §LUnruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.§!
single.trait_uplifted_desc: §LThis species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.§!\n
single.trait_vat_grown_desc: §LArtificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.§!
single.trait_venerable_desc: §LThis species can grow to an age that commands dignity and respect.§!\n
single.trait_very_strong_desc: §LMembers of this species possess a strength that almost defies the laws of physics.§!\n
single.trait_void_dweller_1_desc: §LThis species thrives in orbital habitats, with an inherent ability to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. They are at ease in zero gravity but do not respond well to a planetary environment.§!
single.trait_void_dweller_2_desc: §LThese machines thrive in orbital habitats, programmed with algorithms to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. However, their optimized construction is poorly suited to a planetary environment.§!
single.trait_voidling_desc: §LThis species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.§!
single.trait_wasteful_desc: §LMembers of this species seemingly have no concept of frugality and are prone to useless consumption.§!\n
single.trait_weak_desc: §LMembers of this species are physically weaker than average, making them poor fighters on the ground.§!\n
single.trait_wilderness_desc: §LThis species exists as part of a mutualistic entity, made indistiguishable from its environment in its thoughts and productive output.§!
single.trait_zombie_desc: §LThe remains of a once-proud sapient being, this husk is not suitable for much more than the simplest tasks.§!

auth_dictatorial_desc: Dictatorial governments are ruled by a single individual for life that wields absolute control over the state.

civic_barbaric_despoilers_desc: This society holds few things sacred. To fight is to live, and the strongest may seize whatever they covet.

This society holds few things sacred. To fight is to live, and the strongest may seize whatever they covet. As a consequence of this philosophy, slavery is commonplace. A thrall's only way to freedom is gladiatorial combat.
civic_beacon_of_liberty_desc: This society is a shining beacon of light in a sea of darkness. Liberty and individual freedoms are held in the highest regard here.

This society idealizes personal liberty, holding above all else the right of the individual to pursue and fulfill their own goals and ambitions. The reduction of central government authority and bureaucratic regulation encourages innovation and the free flow of people, goods, and ideas across the nation.
civic_citizen_service_desc: Are you doing your part? Full citizenship and the political responsibility that comes with it is limited to those who have served a tour of duty in the military. Service guarantees citizenship.
Full citizenship and the political responsibility that comes with it is limited to those who have served a tour of duty in the military. Service guarantees citizenship and rights to elect and govern.
civic_corporate_dominion_desc: This society is dominated by a megacorporation that has completely supplanted the role of the state.

This society operates on a simple rule: peace is good for business. To that end, a significant portion of the government is administered, controlled, or at the very least influenced by a loose alliance of independent merchants and traders, working together to achieve mutual prosperity.

civic_criminal_heritage_desc: This Megacorporation can trace its origins back to a crime syndicate that eventually grew powerful enough to supplant all forms of local government.

This Megacorporation can trace its origins back to a crime syndicate that eventually grew powerful enough to supplant all forms of local government.\n\n§WAllows use of§! §H$economic_stance_criminal_market$§! §Wand§! §H$economic_policy_criminal$§! §Wpolicies§!

civic_crusader_spirit_corporate_desc: To combat space piracy and safeguard its borders, this megacorporation utilizes notorious pirates as military advisors and commanders for their fleets.
To combat space piracy and safeguard its borders, this government utilizes notorious pirates as military advisors and commanders for their fleets.
civic_environmentalist_desc: This society seeks to co-exist in harmony with nature. Great care is taken to preserve the environment and limit consumerism where possible.
In this society nature is considered to be national wealth, which is ought to be preserved and carefully exploited for the common good.
civic_exalted_priesthood_desc: To guard against heresy, this society is ruled by a religious council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.
Religious leaders occupy all leading administrative positions in order to guard society against heresy.
civic_franchising_desc: This Megacorporation relies heavily on franchising. Subsidiaries share a greater cut of their profits with their corporate overlord, in exchange for a license to market their goods under established brands.

Executives within the corporate sector manage franchisee contracts of subsidiaries. Often implementing loopholes to annex their assets. These franchisees provide a great deal of funds to buy special licensing for marketable goods and shared research & development programs.
civic_functional_architecture_desc: This society is renowned for its simple yet functional architecture. There are those who would refer to this building style as boring or even depressing, but in most cases, neo-concrete does the job just as well as any other building material.

This society is renowned for its simple, and yet functional architecture. There are those who would refer to this building style as boring or even depressing, but in most cases, neo-concrete does the job just as well as any other building material.

civic_gospel_of_the_masses_desc: This Megacorporation embraces a curious blend of commercial and spiritualistic values, in which the positions of ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.

This society is based on an idealistic foundation of liberty and equality, characterized by a much reduced power of the central government authority.

civic_indentured_assets_desc: This Megacorporation specializes in large indentured workforces. It has little to do with the barbaric practice of slavery - these workers are merely paying off their debts... indefinitely.

This Megacorporation specializes in large indentured workforces. It has little to do with the barbaric practice of slavery - these workers are merely paying off their debts... indefinitely.\n\n§WAll§! §YSlavery Types§! §Wexcept§! §HIndentured Servitude§! §Ware§! §Rbanned§!§W.§!
civic_inwards_perfection_desc: This calm and pacifist society has little use for strangers who do not understand its way of life. More than anything, these people would prefer to be left alone.
This calm and pacifist society has little use for strangers who do not understand their way of life. More than anything, they would prefer to be left alone.

civic_merchant_guilds_desc: A number of powerful and very influential merchant guilds have risen to prominent positions in this society. They hold significant sway with the government.

In this society wealth equals power. The upper echelons of society are occupied by the rich, while working class people are being systematically oppressed. \n\n§YRuthless Capitalism§! §Wconsidered an advanced version of this civic.§!
civic_meritocracy_desc: An individual's social station or personal connections should have no bearing on their profession. The sole basis for advancement in this society is demonstrated ability and talent.
The sole basis for advancement in this society is equal opportunity to demonstrate ability and effort. Thus, leadership positions are held by the most qualified individuals.
civic_mining_guilds_desc: Several large mining guilds have reached a dominant position in this society. The government relies heavily on their support.

Several large mining guilds have organized themselves into an economic union that reached a dominant position in this society. The league's contribution to the empire's economy is strong, so the government relies heavily on its support.
civic_nationalistic_zeal_desc: A strong sense of nationalistic pride permeates all layers of this society.
A strong sense of nationalistic pride and imperialistic ambition permeates all layers of this society.\n§W$BOB_mercs_tooltip$§!
civic_parliamentary_system_desc: The parliamentary system in this society encourages a free and lively debate. Currying favor with one of the dominant political factions can prove to be quite advantageous.

In this society lively public debate about any topic is encouraged through a very diverse parliamentary system. Currying favor with one of the dominant political factions can prove to be quite advantageous.
civic_philosopher_king_desc: It is not enough to simply rule. The Ship of State must be guided by a king that wields enough wisdom and knowledge to steer it true.
It is not enough to simply rule. The Ship of State must be guided by a king who wields enough wisdom and knowledge to steer it true.
civic_police_state_desc: To quash any traces of dissent, the population in this repressive society is carefully monitored and controlled by a large internal police force.
To quash any traces of dissent the population in this repressive society is carefully monitored and controlled by a large internal police force.

civic_public_relations_specialists_desc: If you can control what someone thinks, then you can also control their behavior. This Megacorporation has a virtual army of specialists ready to engage in battles of public opinion.

If you can control what someone thinks, then you can also control their behavior. This Megacorporation has a virtual army of specialists ready to engage in battles of public opinion.\n\n§WCan build§! £building£ §Y$building_PR_bureau$§!
civic_ruthless_competition_desc: All levels of society in this Megacorporation are constantly vying with each other in ruthless competition. It's a dog-eat-dog world.

The working cass in this Megacorporation are constantly vying with each other in ruthless competition to get the scraps left by the ruling owner class. Their worlds consist of union busting, unregulated factories, and unregulated mines. Even more this undermining of organized labor isn't relegated to their own worlds. It's a dog-eat-dog galaxy.
civic_shared_burden_desc: This society believes in an equitable distribution of resources, making little to no distinction between the needs of ruler and ruled. All work together for the benefit of the whole.

This society preserves the ideals of syndicalism, with the economical units being directly managed by workers in order to secure an equitable distribution of resources, and guarantee social and economical equality for everyone. \n\n§WConsidered an advanced version of the§! §YLabor Unions§!§W civic.§!
civic_slaver_guilds_desc: Much of the true political power in this society rests with a number of powerful and ruthless slaver guilds. They know how to get the most out of a slave.
This society traditionally exploits slave labor and relies on the services of special guilds, organized to maintain their slaves' training and distribution.
civic_star_seekers_desc: Seeking ever stranger stars, we are united by our shared wanderlust. We celebrate ever light in the galaxy and cherish every moment chasing distant stars.

Seeking ever stranger stars, we are united by our shared wanderlust and a true pioneer's spirit, rather than mere imperialistic or economical ambition. We celebrate ever light in the galaxy and cherish every moment chasing distant stars.
